ideas.title: Solid-state GaN amplifier replaces the magnetron

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state 2.45 GHz RF amplifier array
new_nodes.detail: Transistor amplifier modules replace the thermionic tube, so there is no cathode to heat and no filament standby draw.

new_nodes.label: Gallium nitride (GaN) HEMT RF power amplification
new_nodes.detail: Wide-bandgap transistors deliver 2.45 GHz power at high conversion efficiency with near-instant start-up.

new_nodes.label: Continuously variable RF power output
new_nodes.detail: Analog power control replaces the 5-step duty-cycle cam, so the oven never cycles on and off and wastes energy in ramp-up and ramp-down.

new_edges.from: GaN solid-state 2.45 GHz RF amplifier array
GaN solid-state 2.45 GHz RF amplifier array
GaN solid-state 2.45 GHz RF amplifier array
GaN solid-state 2.45 GHz RF amplifier array

ideas.rationale: Solid-state amplification converts mains power to RF far more efficiently than a magnetron, and fine power control removes the cycling losses that M13 targets.

ideas.title: High-frequency resonant SMPS replaces the 50 Hz transformer and voltage doubler stack

new_nodes.label: Universal-input resonant high-frequency SMPS
new_nodes.detail: A ~100 kHz soft-switched converter with a small ferrite step-up transformer replaces the bulky 50 Hz magnetic-shunt transformer and diode-capacitor doubler.

new_nodes.label: Zero-voltage-switched (ZVS) resonant inverter
new_nodes.detail: Switching at the resonant point cuts transistor switching losses and allows a much smaller, lighter magnetic core.

new_nodes.label: Matches HV output to real-time magnetron demand
new_nodes.detail: The converter delivers only the power the magnetron draws instead of a fixed, always-on high-voltage output.

new_edges.from: Matches HV output to real-time magnetron demand

ideas.rationale: Switching at high frequency with soft-switched resonance wastes far less energy in the power chain, and demand-matched output stops the converter from idling at full HV.

ideas.title: Thermal-IR doneness sensing replaces the lamp and mechanical timer

new_nodes.label: Interior incandescent lamp (20-25 W)
new_nodes.detail: Existing light source, currently not modelled as its own node in the graph; it draws power for the entire cook.

new_nodes.label: Thermal-IR sensor array with miniature camera
new_nodes.detail: A low-power sensor in the door watches the food surface and shows the cook on a display or phone without any illumination.

new_nodes.label: Stops heating at target doneness
new_nodes.detail: Ends power delivery when the food reaches the set temperature, instead of running a fixed clock timer.

new_edges.from: Thermal-IR sensor array with miniature camera
Thermal-IR sensor array with miniature camera
Thermal-IR sensor array with miniature camera

ideas.rationale: Removing the lamp's constant 20-25 W draw and ending heat exactly at doneness cuts both idle and overcooking energy, which is the core of M13.

ideas.title: Phased-array beam steering replaces the turntable, roller ring and motor

new_nodes.label: Multi-port phased RF feed array in cavity walls
new_nodes.detail: Several small RF feeds in the walls steer the field electronically, so the food no longer needs to be physically rotated.

new_nodes.label: Phase-shifted RF beamforming
new_nodes.detail: Adjusting the phase of each feed moves field maxima across the cavity to even out heating.

new_nodes.label: Electronic field steering for even heating
new_nodes.detail: Spreads energy across the food without any moving parts.

new_edges.from: Multi-port phased RF feed array in cavity walls
Multi-port phased RF feed array in cavity walls
Multi-port phased RF feed array in cavity walls
new_edges.to: Electronic field steering for even heating

new_edges.from: Multi-port phased RF feed array in cavity walls
Multi-port phased RF feed array in cavity walls
Electronic field steering for even heating

ideas.rationale: Dropping the turntable motor, roller ring and rotating tray eliminates their constant drive energy and friction losses, and the electronic steering also reduces hot and cold spots, which means less overcooking and rework energy.

ideas.title: Adaptive-volume cavity: the walls slide to fit the food

new_nodes.label: Motorized sliding conductive walls (adaptive-volume cavity)

new_nodes.label: Variable-geometry resonant cavity tuning
new_nodes.detail: Changing the cavity dimensions shifts its resonance so the field stays matched to the magnetron frequency.

new_nodes.label: Energizes only the volume occupied by food
new_nodes.detail: Limits RF energy spent on heating empty air and cavity walls.

new_edges.from: Energizes only the volume occupied by food

new_nodes.detail: Single flat ceramic-glass fascia with printed touch zones replaces the knobs, push button and fascia seams where grease collects.

new_nodes.label: Capacitive touch sensing through glass
new_nodes.detail: Low-power capacitive sensors read finger proximity through a sealed, smooth glass face with no gaps.

new_nodes.label: Wipe-clean sealed control surface
new_nodes.detail: Entire control face is one smooth, wipeable surface with no crevices.

ideas.rationale: Removing the knobs, push button and seams leaves one smooth sealed surface that wipes clean in a single pass, with no grease traps.

ideas.title: Self-Cleaning Photocatalytic Cavity Liner

new_nodes.label: Titanium-dioxide photocatalytic cavity liner
new_nodes.detail: Cavity walls carry a TiO2 coating that breaks down food residue under the heat and UV-rich interior light.

new_nodes.label: Photocatalytic oxidation of food soils
new_nodes.detail: TiO2 under heat and light oxidises grease and splatter into volatile byproducts that the vent carries away.

new_nodes.label: Degrades grease and splatter on cavity walls
new_nodes.detail: Cavity residue breaks down during normal cooking, leaving little to scrub.

new_edges.to: Degrades grease and splatter on cavity walls

new_edges.from: Degrades grease and splatter on cavity walls

ideas.rationale: Residue that is oxidised during cooking never hardens into baked-on grime, so the cavity needs little or no manual cleaning.

ideas.title: Peel-Off Disposable Splatter Film

new_nodes.label: Peelable microwave-transparent splatter film
new_nodes.detail: A thin, low-loss polymer film covers the waveguide-side splatter zone and is peeled off and replaced when dirty.

new_nodes.label: Low-loss polymer film (PTFE / polyimide)
new_nodes.detail: Thin dielectric film that transmits microwaves with negligible loss and tolerates cooking temperatures.

ideas.rationale: Splatter lands on a disposable film that peels off in seconds, so the waveguide cover never needs scrubbing.

ideas.title: Magnetically Levitated Turntable

new_nodes.label: Magnetically levitated turntable plate
new_nodes.detail: Glass plate floats on a magnetic field and is driven by a coil under the floor, leaving no roller ring or drive coupler.

new_nodes.label: Magnetic levitation and induction drive
new_nodes.detail: Coils in the cavity floor levitate and rotate a magnetic-backed plate without contact points.

ideas.rationale: With no roller ring, coupler or gap around the drive, nothing collects crumbs or spills underneath the plate.

ideas.title: Solid Conductive-Glass Door Window

new_nodes.label: Full-face ITO-coated glass door window
new_nodes.detail: Smooth tempered glass with a transparent conductive coating replaces the perforated mesh and shields microwaves while staying visible.

new_nodes.label: Transparent conductive oxide shielding (ITO)
new_nodes.detail: Thin conductive coating reflects microwaves but passes visible light, so no holes are needed.

ideas.rationale: A smooth, hole-free window has no mesh openings to trap splatter, so a single wipe clears it.

ideas.title: Load-Listening Doneness

new_nodes.label: Reflected-power load sensing via waveguide coupler
new_nodes.detail: Ratio of forward to reflected RF shifts as food moisture evaporates and its dielectric load changes, giving a live state signal.

new_nodes.label: Waveguide directional coupler with detector diode
new_nodes.detail: A cheap printed coupler taps a sample of RF power from the waveguide and feeds a detector diode.

new_nodes.label: Doneness microcontroller
new_nodes.detail: A low-cost MCU trends the reflected-power curve and decides when the cook is complete.

new_nodes.label: Infers food doneness from RF load change
new_nodes.detail: Replaces guessed cook times with a measured, food-driven end point.

new_edges.to: Reflected-power load sensing via waveguide coupler

new_edges.from: Reflected-power load sensing via waveguide coupler

new_edges.to: Infers food doneness from RF load change

new_edges.from: Reflected-power load sensing via waveguide coupler
Infers food doneness from RF load change
Infers food doneness from RF load change

ideas.rationale: The food itself reports its state through the RF load, so the user gets a true 'ready' signal instead of a guessed timer.

ideas.title: Thermal Window

new_nodes.label: Uncooled microbolometer infrared imaging
new_nodes.detail: Low-cost IR sensor array maps surface temperature; ~10 µm IR passes through the mesh holes that block 12 cm microwaves.

new_nodes.label: Low-resolution thermal camera (32x24 array)
new_nodes.detail: Small IR sensor mounted behind the door mesh, viewing the turntable.

new_nodes.label: Heat-map fascia display
new_nodes.detail: Small LED matrix on the control panel that renders the thermal image in colour.

new_nodes.label: Shows live surface heat map of food
new_nodes.detail: Lets the user see hot spots, cold spots and browning progress without a lamp.

new_edges.to: Shows live surface heat map of food

new_edges.from: Shows live surface heat map of food
Shows live surface heat map of food

ideas.rationale: A heat image shows the food's actual thermal state rather than just its visible colour, so the user knows when it is ready without a burnout-prone lamp.

ideas.title: Aroma Chime

new_nodes.label: Metal-oxide semiconductor gas sensing
new_nodes.detail: A heated tin-oxide film changes resistance as volatile compounds from browning and toasting adsorb onto it.

new_nodes.label: MOX volatile-compound sensor at vent
new_nodes.detail: Cheap gas sensor placed in the vent louvre airflow to catch the aroma peak.

new_nodes.label: Piezo chime and LED ring
new_nodes.detail: Electronic tone and light that replace the mechanical striker bell.

new_nodes.label: Detects aroma peak that signals doneness
new_nodes.detail: Triggers the end-of-cook signal when cooking volatiles reach their target level.

new_edges.to: Detects aroma peak that signals doneness

new_edges.from: Detects aroma peak that signals doneness
Detects aroma peak that signals doneness

ideas.rationale: The food's own smell announces readiness, so the user is told by what the food is doing rather than by a clock.

ideas.title: Doneness Dot

new_nodes.label: Thermochromic leuco-dye microencapsulation
new_nodes.detail: Dye capsules change colour at a set temperature (about 75 °C) and are printed on a passive label.

new_nodes.label: Thermochromic mica doneness dot
new_nodes.detail: Adhesive mica-backed disc that turns dark when the food reaches serving temperature; survives microwave exposure.

new_nodes.label: Indicates food has reached safe serving temperature
new_nodes.detail: A passive, electronics-free readiness indicator placed on the food or its container.

new_edges.to: Indicates food has reached safe serving temperature

new_edges.from: Indicates food has reached safe serving temperature
Indicates food has reached safe serving temperature

ideas.rationale: A passive dot on the food turns colour at the right temperature, so the user gets an unmistakable ready signal even when the machine itself is open-loop.

ideas.title: Pulse Handle

new_nodes.label: Vibrotactile haptic feedback
new_nodes.detail: Vibration patterns convey cook-end and doneness cues through touch.

new_nodes.label: Haptic pulse pad in door handle
new_nodes.detail: Piezo or eccentric-mass actuator under the door-release button that pulses in a readiness pattern.

new_nodes.label: Delivers tactile end-of-cycle and doneness alert
new_nodes.detail: Tells the user the food is ready through touch, with no sound or sight needed.

ideas.title: Reflected-Power Thaw Sensing (Substitute the Timer Cam)

new_nodes.label: Magnetron reflected-power impedance sensing
new_nodes.detail: Monitors RF reflected back down the waveguide; load impedance changes as ice turns to water, giving a food-state signal.

new_nodes.label: Waveguide directional coupler probe
new_nodes.detail: Small coupling loop in the waveguide that reads forward and reflected power using existing RF.

new_nodes.label: Detects food thaw state without sensors in the cavity
new_nodes.detail: Converts the magnetron's own reflection into a thaw-progress estimate that ends the defrost cycle automatically.

new_edges.to: Detects food thaw state without sensors in the cavity

new_edges.from: Detects food thaw state without sensors in the cavity
Detects food thaw state without sensors in the cavity
Detects food thaw state without sensors in the cavity

ideas.rationale: It replaces the open-loop timer with a closed-loop thaw endpoint, so frozen food is defrosted to the right state in less time with no wasted power.

ideas.title: RF Plate Defrost Mode (Substitute the Magnetron)

new_nodes.label: 13.56 MHz RF capacitive-plate heating
new_nodes.detail: Food sits between solid-state RF electrodes; a longer wavelength gives uniform heating with no standing-wave hot spots.

new_nodes.label: Solid-state RF generator with electrode plates
new_nodes.detail: Low-cost transistor RF oscillator replacing the magnetron for thawing duty only.

new_nodes.label: Uniform volumetric thawing
new_nodes.detail: Heats the whole frozen mass evenly at low power, avoiding cooked edges and raw centres.

new_edges.from: Solid-state RF generator with electrode plates
Solid-state RF generator with electrode plates
Solid-state RF generator with electrode plates
Solid-state RF generator with electrode plates

ideas.rationale: A uniform, low-frequency RF field thaws frozen food faster and more evenly than a magnetron's standing-wave pattern, and a solid-state generator avoids the magnetron's wear limit.

ideas.title: Phase-Change Thaw Plate (Substitute the Glass Turntable)

new_nodes.label: Phase-change material (PCM) heat-storage plate
new_nodes.detail: Plate filled with a salt-hydrate PCM that absorbs heat at its melting point and releases it slowly to the food.

new_nodes.label: Thermal-mass PCM thaw plate
new_nodes.detail: Replaces the rotating glass tray; passively spreads microwave-derived heat across the base of frozen food.

new_nodes.label: Passive conductive thaw assist
new_nodes.detail: Supplies steady conductive heat from below, so frozen foods thaw from the bottom while RF thaws the core.

ideas.rationale: Passive thermal mass evens out the thaw and removes the motor and roller ring, so frozen blocks thaw more evenly and faster with fewer parts.

ideas.title: Load-Cell Weight Thaw Mode (Substitute the Roller Ring)

new_nodes.label: Strain-gauge load sensing
new_nodes.detail: Thin strain gauges in the cavity floor measure food mass and track mass changes during thawing.

new_nodes.label: Strain-gauge cavity floor
new_nodes.detail: Stationary floor that replaces the roller ring and carries a load-cell bridge.

new_nodes.label: Weight-based thaw dosing
new_nodes.detail: Sets the thaw duration from the food's mass and stops when the mass reading matches the thawed profile.

ideas.rationale: Knowing the mass of the food lets the appliance set the thaw time correctly on the first try, which saves time and avoids overcooking.

ideas.title: Thermochromic Thaw Window (Substitute the Interior Lamp)

new_nodes.label: Thermochromic and liquid-crystal indicator film
new_nodes.detail: Film on the door window changes colour across temperature bands, showing frozen, thawing and ready zones.

new_nodes.label: Thermochromic door window film
new_nodes.detail: Printed film replaces the 20-25 W lamp as a no-power, never-burns-out viewing aid.

new_nodes.label: Visual thaw-progress display
new_nodes.detail: Shows the user at a glance which parts of the food are still frozen.

ideas.rationale: A passive colour display tells the user when frozen food is ready for cooking, so they can judge thaw progress without opening the door or guessing the time.

ideas.title: Magnetic-Field Sealed Door (Non-Contact Choke Replacement)

new_nodes.label: Ferrite-loaded magnetic gasket with active RF absorber
new_nodes.detail: Lossy ferrite and carbon-loaded elastomer strip absorbs stray RF at the door rim, removing the need for a precise λ/4 machined slot.

new_nodes.label: Absorbs leakage RF at the door seam with no machined geometry
new_nodes.detail: Converts leaked microwave energy into heat in a sacrificial absorber, so leakage stays near zero even after the door is bumped or warped.

new_nodes.label: Self-healing conductive elastomer door seal
new_nodes.detail: Silver-filled silicone bead that re-seats itself against the frame, so the seal is never a fixed-geometry part that wears or bends.

new_edges.to: Ferrite-loaded magnetic gasket with active RF absorber
Absorbs leakage RF at the door seam with no machined geometry

new_edges.from: Absorbs leakage RF at the door seam with no machined geometry

ideas.rationale: A seal that absorbs leaked RF and repairs its own fit keeps radiation exposure low even when a child or elderly user slams, bumps, or damages the door.

ideas.title: Hot-Surface-Free Cavity via Active Cooling Skin and Glass Shell

new_nodes.label: Peltier-driven thermoelectric outer skin
new_nodes.detail: Thermoelectric layer in the wrapper pumps heat from the outer surface into the cavity-cooling loop, so the exterior never reaches burn temperature.

new_nodes.label: Keeps every external surface below touch-burn threshold
new_nodes.detail: Maintains outer surfaces under about 45 °C regardless of cooking load, removing the burn hazard for children and elderly users.

new_nodes.label: Double-walled borosilicate outer shell with vacuum gap
new_nodes.detail: Vacuum-insulated glass outer wall replaces the hot steel wrapper as the touchable surface.

new_edges.from: Double-walled borosilicate outer shell with vacuum gap
new_edges.to: Keeps every external surface below touch-burn threshold

new_edges.from: Keeps every external surface below touch-burn threshold

new_edges.to: Double-walled borosilicate outer shell with vacuum gap

new_edges.from: Double-walled borosilicate outer shell with vacuum gap

ideas.rationale: Removing hot external metal and actively pumping heat away means burns from touching the appliance become physically impossible for family members.

ideas.title: Capacitor-Free Pulsed Power Supply with Instant Discharge

new_nodes.label: Solid-state inverter magnetron driver (no HV capacitor)
new_nodes.detail: High-frequency switched-mode supply generates the magnetron voltage, storing only low-energy charge that is safe to touch.

new_nodes.label: Stored energy below lethal threshold at all times
new_nodes.detail: Limits the energy in any high-voltage node to a few millijoules, so no shock is possible after unplugging.

new_edges.from: Solid-state inverter magnetron driver (no HV capacitor)
new_edges.to: Stored energy below lethal threshold at all times

new_edges.from: Stored energy below lethal threshold at all times
Solid-state inverter magnetron driver (no HV capacitor)
Solid-state inverter magnetron driver (no HV capacitor)

ideas.rationale: Eliminating the stored-charge capacitor removes the lethal-shock hazard entirely, so the appliance is safe even when a child opens the casing.

ideas.title: Thermal Liquid-Boil Governor (Replacing Bell Timer and Power Knob Logic)

new_nodes.label: Infrared superheat sensing with dielectric-property feedback
new_nodes.detail: Non-contact IR and permittivity sensing tracks liquid temperature and throttles power before superheating.

new_nodes.label: Prevents eruptive boiling by modulating power per load
new_nodes.detail: Detects the superheated state and pulses power to keep liquids below eruption threshold.

new_nodes.label: Dielectric load sensor plate in cavity floor
new_nodes.detail: Sensor that identifies liquid mass and type, feeding the governor.

new_edges.from: Dielectric load sensor plate in cavity floor
new_edges.to: Infrared superheat sensing with dielectric-property feedback

new_edges.from: Infrared superheat sensing with dielectric-property feedback
new_edges.to: Prevents eruptive boiling by modulating power per load

new_edges.from: Prevents eruptive boiling by modulating power per load
Dielectric load sensor plate in cavity floor
Dielectric load sensor plate in cavity floor

ideas.rationale: Stopping eruptive boiling before it happens protects users from scalds, which are the most common microwave injury for young children and elderly users.

ideas.title: Transparent Metamaterial Mesh Window With Built-In Camera Monitoring

new_nodes.label: Frequency-selective surface (FSS) metamaterial window
new_nodes.detail: Patterned conductive film that is opaque to 2.45 GHz but transparent to visible light, with no perforations.

new_nodes.label: Confirms door-closed state optically and blocks RF with no holes
new_nodes.detail: Visual check plus a solid, hole-free RF barrier, letting the door be verified without any gap in shielding.

new_nodes.label: Solid-state door status sensor (capacitive/magnetic)
new_nodes.detail: Contactless sensor replaces the mechanical microswitch array, removing stuck or welded switch failures.

new_edges.to: Confirms door-closed state optically and blocks RF with no holes

new_edges.from: Confirms door-closed state optically and blocks RF with no holes

ideas.rationale: A hole-free metamaterial window and contactless door sensing remove both the leakage path and the switch-failure mode that put family members at risk of radiation exposure.

ideas.title: Temperature-Terminated Heating

new_nodes.label: Contactless IR thermopile sensor aimed at the liquid surface
new_nodes.detail: Reads surface temperature and ends heating at a chosen target such as 65 °C, replacing the timed guesswork of the dial.

new_nodes.label: Thermopile infrared temperature sensing
new_nodes.detail: Thermocouple array that converts infrared emission into a voltage, so it needs no contact with the liquid.

new_nodes.label: Ends heating at target drink temperature
new_nodes.detail: Closes the loop on temperature so the drink is hot but not scalding, whatever the volume.

new_edges.from: Contactless IR thermopile sensor aimed at the liquid surface
Contactless IR thermopile sensor aimed at the liquid surface
Contactless IR thermopile sensor aimed at the liquid surface
new_edges.to: Ends heating at target drink temperature

new_edges.from: Ends heating at target drink temperature
Contactless IR thermopile sensor aimed at the liquid surface
Ends heating at target drink temperature

ideas.rationale: Stopping at a measured drink temperature instead of after a guessed number of minutes gives a consistently hot breakfast drink for M3.

ideas.title: Nucleation Cup Base

new_nodes.label: Porous sintered-ceramic nucleation base insert
new_nodes.detail: A cup base with a controlled rough, porous surface that gives bubbles safe places to form.

new_nodes.label: Sintered porous ceramic with controlled surface roughness
new_nodes.detail: Microwave-transparent ceramic whose pore structure seeds nucleation sites so liquid boils gently.

new_nodes.label: Prevents eruptive boiling of heated milk
new_nodes.detail: Keeps milk from superheating and erupting when the user lifts the cup.

new_edges.to: Sintered porous ceramic with controlled surface roughness

new_edges.from: Sintered porous ceramic with controlled surface roughness

new_edges.to: Prevents eruptive boiling of heated milk

new_edges.from: Prevents eruptive boiling of heated milk
Prevents eruptive boiling of heated milk

ideas.title: Solid-State RF Core: No Magnetron, No Lethal HV

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state RF power amplifier array (2.45 GHz)
new_nodes.detail: Combines many low-power gallium-nitride transistor modules into ~700 W at 2.45 GHz, replacing the magnetron tube.

new_nodes.label: Extra-low-voltage DC switching supply (48 V)
new_nodes.detail: Replaces the mains transformer, HV capacitor and diode chain with a sealed low-voltage DC rail.

new_nodes.label: Wide-bandgap GaN HEMT RF amplification
new_nodes.detail: Transistors amplify 2.45 GHz directly from a low-voltage DC supply, with no cathode heating or vacuum tube.

new_nodes.label: Eliminates lethal high voltage inside the appliance
new_nodes.detail: Removes the ~4 kV circuit so no internal charge can remain after unplugging.

new_edges.to: Eliminates lethal high voltage inside the appliance
GaN solid-state RF power amplifier array (2.45 GHz)

new_edges.from: Eliminates lethal high voltage inside the appliance

ideas.rationale: By replacing the 4 kV magnetron chain with a low-voltage solid-state amplifier, the appliance can no longer deliver a lethal shock from its capacitor or transformer, which directly removes the electric-shock hazard for children and users who open the casing.

ideas.title: Cordless Appliance on an Inductive Base Pad

new_nodes.label: Foreign-object and presence detection coil
new_nodes.detail: Energises the pad only when the oven is seated and no metal object or hand is detected on it.

new_nodes.label: Resonant inductive power transfer (magnetic coupling)
new_nodes.detail: Mid-frequency magnetic coupling carries kilowatts across a few centimetres of air without exposed live contacts.

new_nodes.label: Delivers mains power with no exposed live conductors
new_nodes.detail: Keeps mains voltage on the countertop pad only, out of reach of the cavity and the appliance body.

new_edges.from: Delivers mains power with no exposed live conductors

ideas.rationale: Moving the mains connection into a sealed base pad that only energises when the oven is seated removes the exposed plug, cord and prongs that children bite, pull or touch, which are the main electric-shock entry points for families.

ideas.title: Opaque Sealed Door with Camera Window

new_nodes.label: Solid steel door panel with no perforations
new_nodes.detail: A fully solid, metal-faced door with a sealed rim, so there are no holes for microwaves to leak through or for fingers to reach.

new_nodes.label: RF-shielded miniature cavity camera
new_nodes.detail: A heat-tolerant image sensor in a metal-enclosed pocket that films the cavity through a sealed port.

new_nodes.label: Cool-touch food-view display on fascia
new_nodes.detail: A low-temperature screen on the control panel that shows live food images and replaces the hot viewing window.

new_nodes.label: Shielded CMOS imaging with RF-tight enclosure
new_nodes.detail: Image sensing behind a conductive shield that passes light data but blocks 2.45 GHz energy.

new_nodes.label: Lets the user watch food with no door opening or hot glass
new_nodes.detail: Provides cooking visibility without any radiation path or touchable hot surface on the door.

ideas.rationale: Eliminating the magnetron warm-up and its duty-cycle on/off pulsing means the oven starts heating immediately and reaches target power faster, cutting every cook by seconds to minutes.

ideas.title: Phased-Array Hot Spot Replaces the Turntable

new_nodes.label: Four-port phased antenna array with independent phase control
new_nodes.detail: Small antenna grid on the cavity walls that steers a moving field pattern electronically across the food.

new_nodes.label: Phased-array beam steering (electronic scanning)
new_nodes.detail: Adjusts the phase of each antenna port so interference peaks sweep through the cavity without any moving part.

new_nodes.label: Heats the whole load evenly in one pass
new_nodes.detail: Sweeps the field to flatten standing-wave hot and cold spots, so food cooks uniformly without rotating or stopping to stir.

new_edges.from: Four-port phased antenna array with independent phase control
Four-port phased antenna array with independent phase control
new_edges.to: Heats the whole load evenly in one pass

Four-port phased antenna array with independent phase control

ideas.rationale: Even heating in a single pass removes the need to pause, stir, or re-run partly cooked food, which is the biggest hidden time sink in the current appliance.

ideas.title: Package-Encoded Cook Program Replaces the Knobs

new_nodes.label: Cavity RFID/NFC reader loop
new_nodes.detail: Antenna loop on the cavity wall that reads the cooking profile printed on the food packaging.

new_nodes.label: Printed passive RFID cooking-profile tags
new_nodes.detail: Microwave-safe passive tags on packaging that store time, power level, and multi-stage sequences with no battery.

new_nodes.label: Loads the correct time, power, and sequence from the package
new_nodes.detail: Sets the full cooking program automatically when the package is placed in the cavity, requiring no dial turning.

new_edges.to: Loads the correct time, power, and sequence from the package

ideas.rationale: The package carries the expert cooking settings, so the user skips setting time and power entirely and the meal starts in one tap.

ideas.title: Waste-Heat Phase-Change Battery Replaces the Cooling Fan

new_nodes.label: Phase-change thermal battery (salt-hydrate pack)
new_nodes.detail: Sealed latent-heat pack bonded to the magnetron and transformer that absorbs their waste heat as it melts.

new_nodes.label: Latent-heat storage in phase-change material
new_nodes.detail: Stores large amounts of heat at a near-constant temperature and releases it slowly to warm the next load.

new_nodes.label: Pre-warms the cavity from captured waste heat
new_nodes.detail: Releases stored heat into the cavity before each cycle, so the food starts from a warmer baseline and the unit can run back-to-back cycles without a cool-down pause.

new_edges.to: Pre-warms the cavity from captured waste heat

new_edges.from: Pre-warms the cavity from captured waste heat
Pre-warms the cavity from captured waste heat

ideas.rationale: Storing and reusing the magnetron's waste heat removes the cool-down wait between uses and starts each cook from a warmer cavity, so food finishes sooner.

ideas.title: Thermal-Store Standby Microwave: Phase-Change Pack Replaces the Magnetron's Warm-Up Cycle

new_nodes.label: Latent-heat phase-change thermal store
new_nodes.detail: Paraffin or salt-hydrate pack charged by a small resistive element during off-peak hours, releasing heat on demand.

new_nodes.label: Thermal battery core
new_nodes.detail: Sealed phase-change cartridge that supplies the magnetron's filament and food-warming energy from stored heat.

new_nodes.label: Supplies cooking energy from stored heat during peak-tariff periods
new_nodes.detail: Shifts a share of cooking energy draw from mains to pre-charged thermal storage.

new_edges.to: Supplies cooking energy from stored heat during peak-tariff periods

new_edges.from: Supplies cooking energy from stored heat during peak-tariff periods

ideas.rationale: Storing off-peak energy as latent heat and releasing it during cooking reduces both grid draw at peak and the wasteful standby losses of a high-voltage power chain.

ideas.title: Solid-State RF Amplifier Replaces the Magnetron and HV Chain

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state 2.45 GHz RF amplifier
new_nodes.detail: Low-voltage gallium nitride transistor array generating 2.45 GHz RF directly from a 48 V supply.

new_nodes.label: GaN RF amplifier module
new_nodes.detail: Phased transistor modules replacing the magnetron, transformer, capacitor and diode.

new_nodes.label: Phase-steered RF delivery to food
new_nodes.detail: Electronic phase control shapes the field to target cold spots without moving parts.

ideas.rationale: Removing the high-voltage transformer, capacitor and diode eliminates the largest conversion losses and standby draw while delivering RF only where it is absorbed.

ideas.title: Food-Adaptive Cavity: Dielectric Sensing Stops Cooking at the Exact Doneness Point

new_nodes.label: Dielectric impedance sensing via waveguide probe
new_nodes.detail: Measures reflected RF power to infer moisture and temperature of food in real time.

new_nodes.label: Reflectometry sensing antenna
new_nodes.detail: Small probe in the waveguide that replaces the mechanical timer knob as the cooking decision-maker.

new_nodes.label: Terminates cooking at target doneness
new_nodes.detail: Cuts power the moment the food reaches its programmed state, avoiding overheating.

new_edges.to: Dielectric impedance sensing via waveguide probe

ideas.rationale: Stopping energy input at the moment of doneness, rather than running a fixed timer, removes wasted energy from overcooking and reheating cycles.

ideas.title: Waveguide-Free Cavity Wall: Metamaterial Lining Replaces Turntable and Mode Stirrers

new_nodes.label: Metasurface reflective cavity lining
new_nodes.detail: Engineered conductive surface pattern that spreads the field evenly across the cavity without rotation.

new_nodes.label: Metasurface cavity wall panel
new_nodes.detail: Patterned steel-backed panel replacing the turntable, roller ring, coupler and motor.

new_nodes.label: Even field distribution without mechanical rotation
new_nodes.detail: Achieves uniform heating through surface design rather than moving parts.

new_edges.to: Even field distribution without mechanical rotation

new_edges.from: Even field distribution without mechanical rotation
Even field distribution without mechanical rotation

ideas.rationale: Eliminating the turntable motor and its drive losses while keeping even heating cuts parasitic energy use and component count at once.

ideas.title: Ambient Solar-Preheat Shell: Cavity Wall Doubles as a Photothermal Collector

new_nodes.label: Selective-absorber solar coating on enamel
new_nodes.detail: Black spectrally selective coating that absorbs ambient light and heat to warm the cavity and contents before RF starts.

new_nodes.label: Photothermal cavity skin
new_nodes.detail: Outer wrapper and cavity face acting as a passive collector that preheats food.

new_nodes.label: Passive preheating of food
new_nodes.detail: Reduces the RF energy needed to bring food up to cooking temperature.

ideas.rationale: Using free ambient and kitchen light to supply part of the heating energy directly lowers the electrical energy each cooking cycle requires.

ideas.title: Drop-in Glass Sleeve Liner

new_nodes.label: Drop-in borosilicate cavity sleeve
new_nodes.detail: Removable, dishwasher-safe glass liner that fits inside the enamelled cavity and catches all spatter; microwave-transparent, so the steel shell still reflects.

new_nodes.label: Lift-out liner removes all soiling in one motion
new_nodes.detail: User lifts the sleeve out and rinses it, so the cavity walls never need wiping.

new_nodes.label: Sleeve thermal-shock and added cost
new_nodes.detail: The liner must survive rapid heating and adds a part to the BOM.

new_edges.to: Lift-out liner removes all soiling in one motion

ideas.title: Flush Conductive-Glass Door

new_nodes.label: Flush ITO-coated tempered glass door panel
new_nodes.detail: Solid, gap-free glass pane with a sub-wavelength conductive oxide film: microwaves stay in, the view stays clear, and there is no mesh to scrub.

new_nodes.label: Indium-tin-oxide transparent conductive coating
new_nodes.detail: Thin conductive oxide film that reflects RF while passing visible light.

new_nodes.label: Wipe-flat window with no mesh crevices
new_nodes.detail: The door window can be cleaned with one swipe of a cloth.

new_nodes.label: ITO film cost and scratch sensitivity

ideas.title: Living Window: Glass-Clear Door with Embedded Doneness Sensing

new_nodes.label: Transparent conductive oxide (ITO) film on door glass
new_nodes.detail: Thin optically clear film that doubles as a capacitive/RF sensing electrode, letting the door itself detect moisture and steam changes.

new_nodes.label: Door-integrated doneness sensor layer
new_nodes.detail: Invisible sensing film laminated into the window that reads dielectric change as food heats.

new_nodes.label: Senses food state and reports doneness
new_nodes.detail: Converts dielectric and humidity change into a readable 'done' signal, closing the feedback loop.

new_nodes.label: Electrochromic glass
new_nodes.detail: Glass that changes tint on command, shown as a solid, low-power, no-bulb status display.

new_edges.to: Transparent conductive oxide (ITO) film on door glass
Senses food state and reports doneness

new_edges.from: Senses food state and reports doneness

ideas.rationale: It replaces the bulb and the open-loop guessing with a door that shows the food's actual state, so users know when it is ready without watching or relying on a timer.

ideas.title: Ding-Free Scent Bell: Aroma-Triggered Completion Cue

new_nodes.label: Metal-oxide gas sensor (MOS) array
new_nodes.detail: Low-cost volatile organic compound sensor that rises in signal as food browns or steams.

new_nodes.label: Scent-triggered completion emitter
new_nodes.detail: Small aroma cartridge or fan that releases a distinct smell (e.g., toasted bread) when doneness is reached.

new_nodes.label: Signals doneness through smell
new_nodes.detail: Replaces the audible ding with an olfactory alert that works even if the user is in another room.

ideas.rationale: Replacing the mechanical bell with a sensor-driven scent signal tells the user the food is actually ready, not just that a timer ran out.

ideas.title: Sound of Steam: Acoustic Doneness Listener

new_nodes.label: MEMS microphone with spectral analysis
new_nodes.detail: Tiny microphone that listens to the boiling and sizzling sound signature inside the cavity.

new_nodes.label: Detects food state from sound
new_nodes.detail: Recognises the change from bubbling to quiet, or from sizzle to crackle, as a sign of doneness.

ideas.rationale: Listening to the food itself gives feedback on its real state, replacing a fixed countdown with a signal the user can trust.

ideas.title: Thermal Ghost: Infrared Doneness Map on the Turntable

new_nodes.label: Low-cost thermopile infrared array
new_nodes.detail: Thermal sensor that maps surface temperature of food across the turntable.

new_nodes.label: Phone-linked thermal display
new_nodes.detail: Shows a live color heat map of the food on a phone or small status screen.

new_nodes.label: Shows real-time heat map of food
new_nodes.detail: Lets the user see which parts are hot and which are still cold, without opening the door.

new_edges.to: Shows real-time heat map of food

new_edges.from: Shows real-time heat map of food
Shows real-time heat map of food

ideas.rationale: Showing the heat distribution as a live map gives users direct feedback on exactly when and where the food is ready, removing the need to guess.

ideas.title: Self-Tasting Cavity: Doneness Verdict by Smell and Surface Probe

new_nodes.label: Retractable microwave-safe surface probe
new_nodes.detail: A thin probe that touches the food surface and reads moisture and temperature.

new_nodes.label: Replaces the countdown with a readiness verdict
new_nodes.detail: Stops the cook when the probe reports the food is done, instead of counting down a set time.

new_edges.to: Replaces the countdown with a readiness verdict

new_edges.from: Replaces the countdown with a readiness verdict
Replaces the countdown with a readiness verdict
Replaces the countdown with a readiness verdict

ideas.rationale: A probe reads the food directly, so the user gets a true doneness verdict instead of a timer guess, which replaces the mechanical clock as the main cue.

ideas.title: Phase-Sensing Dial (butter knows when it's ready)

new_nodes.label: Capacitive phase-sensing dial
new_nodes.detail: Electrode pair reads the permittivity shift as butter goes solid to liquid and ends heating at the target phase, replacing the power/time dial.

new_nodes.label: Dielectric permittivity sensing
new_nodes.detail: Measures how a fat's dielectric loss changes on melting, giving a phase signal without a thermometer.

new_nodes.label: Auto-terminates heating at target phase state
new_nodes.detail: Closed-loop stop so butter melts fully without browning, spattering or overshooting.

new_edges.to: Auto-terminates heating at target phase state

new_edges.from: Auto-terminates heating at target phase state
Auto-terminates heating at target phase state

ideas.title: Holeless Window

new_nodes.label: Holeless ITO door panel
new_nodes.detail: Borosilicate glass sandwiching a transparent indium-tin-oxide film, so the door has no perforations to fray, crack or leak.

new_nodes.label: Transparent conductive film shielding (ITO/graphene)
new_nodes.detail: A film with low enough sheet resistance to reflect 2.45 GHz while transmitting most visible light.

new_nodes.label: Carbon-silicone RF absorber gasket
new_nodes.detail: A lossy elastomer rim that absorbs leaking RF across the door gap, replacing the precision quarter-wave slot.

new_nodes.label: Lossy-dielectric RF absorption
new_nodes.detail: Carbon-loaded polymer converts stray microwave energy to negligible heat at the seal.

ideas.rationale: A continuous conductive window with no holes and a lossy gasket keeps radiation sealed in while removing the openings and seal geometry that wear, misalign and leak over a family appliance's life.

ideas.title: Presence Sentinel

new_nodes.label: 60 GHz mmWave presence radar
new_nodes.detail: A sensor module behind the control panel that detects hands, limbs or a child's face within about 5 cm of the door gap.

new_nodes.label: Millimetre-wave Doppler and range sensing
new_nodes.detail: Contactless motion and distance detection that works through plastic housings and has no moving parts.

new_nodes.label: Cuts RF before a body reaches the door
new_nodes.detail: Pre-emptive shutdown that acts before the door is opened, not after.

new_edges.to: Cuts RF before a body reaches the door

new_edges.from: Cuts RF before a body reaches the door

ideas.rationale: Detecting a hand or child near the door and cutting RF before anyone reaches the opening removes the exposure window that mechanical interlocks leave open, protecting children and elderly users from radiation and burns.

ideas.title: Solid-State Resonant Inverter

new_nodes.label: GaN resonant switch-mode inverter (20-40 kHz)
new_nodes.detail: A compact high-frequency power stage that replaces the mains transformer, HV capacitor and diode doubler to drive the magnetron.

new_nodes.label: Gallium-nitride soft-switched resonant conversion
new_nodes.detail: High-frequency conversion whose stored high-voltage energy is kept far below the shock threshold by design.

new_nodes.label: Stored HV energy is inherently below shock threshold
new_nodes.detail: Makes after-switch-off danger intrinsic to the circuit rather than managed by a bleeder resistor.

new_edges.to: Stored HV energy is inherently below shock threshold

new_edges.from: Stored HV energy is inherently below shock threshold
Stored HV energy is inherently below shock threshold

ideas.rationale: Removing the lethal stored charge at its source, instead of relying on a bleeder resistor that can fail, makes the appliance safe to touch even when unplugged or opened, which directly protects against electric shock.

ideas.title: Heat-Pipe Cold Skin

new_nodes.label: Sealed heat-pipe radiator back panel
new_nodes.detail: Vapour-chamber heat pipes carry magnetron heat to a rear fin array, so there is no fan and no front or side louvres.

new_nodes.label: Passive two-phase heat-pipe transport
new_nodes.detail: Phase-change heat transfer with no moving parts that keeps external surfaces below about 50 °C.

new_nodes.label: Keeps all user-facing surfaces below burn threshold
new_nodes.detail: Removes the hot exhaust plume and the hot louvre surfaces that burn hands and faces.

new_edges.to: Keeps all user-facing surfaces below burn threshold

new_edges.from: Keeps all user-facing surfaces below burn threshold
Keeps all user-facing surfaces below burn threshold

ideas.rationale: Moving heat out the back through sealed heat pipes eliminates the hot exhaust and louvre surfaces that cause burns to curious toddlers and frail elderly users, while also removing the fan that could jam or shock.

ideas.title: Arc Sentinel Solid-State Breaker

new_nodes.label: Optical arc sensor and solid-state breaker
new_nodes.detail: A photodiode and RF detector in the cavity cut magnetron drive in under 1 ms when a spark or metal arc appears, replacing the fusible ceramic link.

new_nodes.label: Photonic arc detection with SiC solid-state current limiter
new_nodes.detail: Optical and RF sensing paired with a silicon-carbide switch that interrupts current without a melting element.

new_nodes.label: Interrupts arcing within microseconds
new_nodes.detail: Stops sparks from metal objects or food debris before they become a fire or burn hazard.

new_edges.from: Optical arc sensor and solid-state breaker
Optical arc sensor and solid-state breaker
Optical arc sensor and solid-state breaker
new_edges.to: Photonic arc detection with SiC solid-state current limiter

new_edges.from: Photonic arc detection with SiC solid-state current limiter
Optical arc sensor and solid-state breaker
Optical arc sensor and solid-state breaker
Optical arc sensor and solid-state breaker

ideas.rationale: Detecting and breaking arcs in microseconds, rather than waiting for a fuse to blow, stops the sparks from metal objects that can ignite a fire or deliver a shock, protecting the whole household.

ideas.title: Phased-Array Beam Sweep (no turntable)

new_nodes.label: Phased-array emitter grid in cavity walls
new_nodes.detail: Solid-state emitters steer the RF field electronically, replacing the rotating glass tray, roller ring and motor.

new_nodes.label: Phased-array beamforming
new_nodes.detail: Controlling relative phase between emitters moves hot spots around the cavity without any moving parts.

new_nodes.label: Sweeps energy across food with no moving parts
new_nodes.detail: Delivers the even-heating job of the turntable electronically, so food is not left in one spot.

new_edges.from: Phased-array emitter grid in cavity walls
Phased-array emitter grid in cavity walls
new_edges.to: Sweeps energy across food with no moving parts

new_edges.from: Sweeps energy across food with no moving parts
Phased-array emitter grid in cavity walls
Phased-array emitter grid in cavity walls
Sweeps energy across food with no moving parts

ideas.rationale: Even, rotation-free heating avoids overcooked edges and cold centres, so less time at high heat keeps vitamins intact and food needs no added fat to cook evenly.

ideas.title: Self-Steaming Sealed Cavity (steam instead of dry heat)

new_nodes.label: Self-steaming cavity vessel
new_nodes.detail: A sealed, lidded vessel traps steam released from the food's own moisture plus a small water mist, replacing dry air.

new_nodes.label: Microwave-transparent steam-vent valve
new_nodes.detail: A pressure-relief valve holds the cavity near 100 C so food cooks in moist heat.

new_nodes.label: Steam-cooks food with no added fat
new_nodes.detail: Replaces dry heating and oil-based cooking with moist heat that retains water-soluble nutrients.

new_edges.to: Steam-cooks food with no added fat

new_edges.from: Steam-cooks food with no added fat
Steam-cooks food with no added fat

ideas.rationale: Moist steam heat removes the need for oil or frying and limits nutrient loss from dry, high-temperature cooking, so it serves the healthy-diet need directly.

ideas.title: Closed-Loop Nutrient Sensor (replaces timer and power knobs)

new_nodes.label: Multispectral NIR food-state sensor
new_nodes.detail: Reads moisture, surface temperature and starch or sugar change in the food and stops heating at a target doneness.

new_nodes.label: Near-infrared spectroscopy with chemometric doneness models
new_nodes.detail: Maps spectral signatures of food to nutrient-optimal doneness, replacing guesswork with measurement.

new_nodes.label: Closes the loop: stops heating at nutrient-optimal doneness
new_nodes.detail: Ends each cook when the food reaches its target state, instead of relying on a timer dial and power setting.

new_edges.to: Near-infrared spectroscopy with chemometric doneness models

new_edges.from: Near-infrared spectroscopy with chemometric doneness models

new_edges.to: Closes the loop: stops heating at nutrient-optimal doneness

new_edges.from: Closes the loop: stops heating at nutrient-optimal doneness
Closes the loop: stops heating at nutrient-optimal doneness

ideas.rationale: Stopping at the point of target doneness prevents the overcooking that destroys heat-sensitive vitamins and wastes food, so it supports nutrient retention.

ideas.title: Frequency-Agile Solid-State RF Synthesizer (magnetron and HV chain replaced)

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state RF synthesizer array
new_nodes.detail: Low-voltage gallium-nitride amplifiers generate tunable RF from about 1 to 6 GHz, replacing the magnetron and its 4 kV supply.

new_nodes.label: Gallium-nitride RF power amplifier
new_nodes.detail: Transistor amplifiers run from low-voltage DC, removing the lethal high-voltage stage.

new_nodes.label: Tunes frequency to each food's dielectric profile
new_nodes.detail: Selects the frequency that heats moisture-bound regions and avoids overheating fat-rich pockets.

new_edges.to: Tunes frequency to each food's dielectric profile

new_edges.from: Tunes frequency to each food's dielectric profile
Tunes frequency to each food's dielectric profile

ideas.rationale: Matching frequency to each food's dielectric properties heats lean moisture selectively and limits fat overheating, which helps keep nutrients and reduces fat-related harm.

ideas.title: Oil-Free Crisping Ceramic Liner

new_nodes.label: SiC ceramic susceptor liner
new_nodes.detail: A microwave-absorbing silicon-carbide lining heats to about 250 C and radiates infrared to brown food surfaces.

new_nodes.label: Silicon-carbide microwave susceptance
new_nodes.detail: Lossy ceramic absorbs microwave energy and converts it to surface heat without any metal arcing.

new_nodes.label: Browns and crisps food surfaces without frying oil
new_nodes.detail: Produces the crisp, golden surface that normally requires added fat or deep-frying.

new_edges.to: Browns and crisps food surfaces without frying oil

new_edges.from: Browns and crisps food surfaces without frying oil
Browns and crisps food surfaces without frying oil

ideas.rationale: Crisp texture without frying or oil sprays removes added fat from the food, so people can enjoy familiar textures while eating a lower-fat diet.

ideas.title: Weight-Sensing Auto-Defrost Turntable

new_nodes.label: Strain-gauge load cell
new_nodes.detail: Thin metal foil bridge in the roller ring measures food mass and infers how much frozen load is present.

new_nodes.label: Load-cell roller ring
new_nodes.detail: Replaces the plain roller ring; reads tray weight and triggers defrost duration automatically.

new_nodes.label: Auto-sets defrost time from food mass
new_nodes.detail: Removes the user's need to guess minutes and power level for frozen food.

new_edges.to: Auto-sets defrost time from food mass

new_edges.from: Auto-sets defrost time from food mass
Auto-sets defrost time from food mass

ideas.rationale: Replacing the guessed timer and power knob with a weight-driven defrost cycle lets frozen food be thawed correctly in one press, directly serving M4.

ideas.title: 27 MHz Solid-State RF Defrost Module

new_nodes.label: 27 MHz solid-state RF amplifier
new_nodes.detail: Low-voltage transistor RF source; the lower frequency penetrates deeper into frozen blocks than 2.45 GHz.

new_nodes.label: Solid-state RF defrost oscillator
new_nodes.detail: Small module that replaces the magnetron and HV transformer chain for the defrost mode only.

new_nodes.label: Deep, uniform volumetric thawing
new_nodes.detail: Penetrates the core of frozen food evenly, reducing cooked edges and cold centres.

ideas.rationale: A low-frequency solid-state source thaws frozen cores more uniformly and cheaply than a magnetron, which is the real bottleneck for M4.

ideas.title: Fan-Driven Mode Stirrer Replaces Turntable

new_nodes.label: Metal mode-stirrer vane
new_nodes.detail: Rotating metal fan blade inside the cavity, driven by the existing cooling-fan shaft, reshapes the standing-wave pattern.

new_nodes.label: Stirred-field mode mixing
new_nodes.detail: Continuously varies the field pattern so hot and cold spots shift during defrosting.

ideas.rationale: Stirring the field with the existing fan motor evens out frozen-food thawing while removing the turntable motor and roller ring, which cuts cost.

ideas.title: Thermochromic Thaw Tray

new_nodes.label: Thermochromic ink
new_nodes.detail: Printed ink that changes colour at about 0 °C, marking where the frozen food has thawed.

new_nodes.label: Thermochromic turntable coating
new_nodes.detail: Glass tray coating that shows thawed and frozen zones, replacing the lamp for defrost feedback.

new_nodes.label: Visual defrost-progress feedback
new_nodes.detail: User sees which parts are still frozen without opening the door.

ideas.rationale: Giving users a visual read on which parts have thawed helps them finish defrosting quickly, and the coating never burns out unlike the lamp.

ideas.title: Capacitive Electrode Defrost Plates

new_nodes.label: Parallel-plate RF electrode pair
new_nodes.detail: Two aluminium plates above and below the food; the RF field heats food through capacitive coupling, not a waveguide.

new_nodes.label: Capacitive RF dielectric heating
new_nodes.detail: Heats frozen food by applying RF across a dielectric load, which is well suited to thawing.

ideas.rationale: Electrode plates couple RF straight into the frozen food, which needs no waveguide or cavity and thaws the core more uniformly than a standing-wave cavity.

ideas.title: Acoustic Doneness Listener

new_nodes.label: MEMS microphone with on-device crackle and boil classifier
new_nodes.detail: A sub-$1 acoustic sensor tracks sizzle fade and steam bubbling, and a tiny classifier infers doneness from the sound.

new_nodes.label: Cavity acoustic sensor
new_nodes.detail: A microphone behind the door seal, shielded from magnetron noise, that listens to the food.

new_nodes.label: Detects doneness from cooking sound
new_nodes.detail: Replaces the fixed countdown with state-based detection of when the food is actually ready.

new_edges.to: MEMS microphone with on-device crackle and boil classifier

ideas.rationale: The microwave listens to the food and announces doneness, so the user gets feedback on the food's state rather than a guessed time.

ideas.title: Self-Opening Door Pop-Release

new_nodes.label: Spring-loaded solenoid door-ajar latch
new_nodes.detail: A latch that releases the door a few millimetres at cycle end, using no power to hold.

new_nodes.label: Self-opening door latch
new_nodes.detail: Pops the door ajar about 15 mm with a soft click when cooking finishes.

new_nodes.label: Gives tactile and visual end-of-cycle signal
new_nodes.detail: The signal can be felt and seen from across the room, so it works for hearing-impaired users and in loud kitchens.

new_edges.to: Gives tactile and visual end-of-cycle signal

new_edges.from: Gives tactile and visual end-of-cycle signal

ideas.rationale: The bell is replaced by a physical door that opens itself, so the user feels and sees that the food is ready without needing to hear anything.

ideas.title: Thermal Glow Door

new_nodes.label: Low-resolution LWIR thermopile array (32x24)
new_nodes.detail: An inexpensive infrared sensor array that maps surface temperature of the food with no visible light needed.

new_nodes.label: Microwave-screened IR window with heat-map display
new_nodes.detail: A small infrared-transparent, microwave-blocking window that feeds a colour heat map to the door display.

new_nodes.label: Shows cold spots and hot spots in the dark
new_nodes.detail: Reveals which parts of the food are still cold, working without any lamp.

new_edges.from: Microwave-screened IR window with heat-map display
Microwave-screened IR window with heat-map display
new_edges.to: Shows cold spots and hot spots in the dark

new_edges.from: Shows cold spots and hot spots in the dark
Microwave-screened IR window with heat-map display
Microwave-screened IR window with heat-map display
Microwave-screened IR window with heat-map display

ideas.rationale: Replacing the burnout-prone lamp with a thermal camera gives the user a live picture of food temperature, which shows when the food is ready in a way a bulb cannot.

ideas.title: Thermochromic Lid Dot

new_nodes.label: Leuco-dye thermochromic ink with 75 C transition
new_nodes.detail: A printed ink that changes colour irreversibly when the food reaches a safe serving temperature.

new_nodes.label: Disposable thermochromic lid dot
new_nodes.detail: A paper-thin dot printed on the container lid that turns from blue to red when the dish is done.

new_nodes.label: Passive per-dish doneness indicator
new_nodes.detail: Each dish signals its own readiness, so one oven serves many dishes with separate signals.

new_edges.to: Leuco-dye thermochromic ink with 75 C transition

ideas.rationale: The appliance stops guessing and the food itself declares when it is ready, using a colour change the user can read at a glance.

ideas.title: Fibre-Optic Core Probe

new_nodes.label: Fibre-optic sensing
new_nodes.detail: Optical sensing that uses glass fibres to measure temperature without any electrical or metallic parts.

new_nodes.label: Fibre-optic temperature sensing (Fabry-Perot)
new_nodes.detail: A glass-fibre sensor tip whose optical response shifts with temperature, unaffected by microwave fields.

new_nodes.label: Non-metallic fibre-optic core probe
new_nodes.detail: A glass probe pushed into the food's centre that reports core temperature to the controller.

new_nodes.label: Measures food core temperature in real time
new_nodes.detail: Replaces the guessed countdown with a direct reading of how cooked the centre of the food is.

new_edges.to: Measures food core temperature in real time

new_edges.from: Measures food core temperature in real time
Measures food core temperature in real time

ideas.rationale: A probe that reads the food's core temperature tells the user exactly when the food is ready, replacing time guesses with a direct measurement.

ideas.title: Solid-state GaN phased-array heater

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state RF amplifier array (2.45 GHz)

ideas.title: Self-Sensing Thaw via Reflected RF Loss

new_nodes.label: Reflected-power sensor on magnetron feed
new_nodes.detail: Reads RF reflected back from the cavity and the magnetron anode current, replacing the timer knob and temperature guessing.

new_nodes.label: Dielectric loss-state detection (frozen vs. thawing)
new_nodes.detail: Water's loss factor jumps sharply as ice melts near 0 °C, so the change in reflected power signals thaw progress without any food probe.

new_nodes.label: Closed-loop auto-defrost that stops at uniform thaw
new_nodes.detail: Adjusts duty cycle from the loss signal and ends the cycle when the food is evenly thawed.

new_edges.to: Closed-loop auto-defrost that stops at uniform thaw

new_edges.from: Closed-loop auto-defrost that stops at uniform thaw
Closed-loop auto-defrost that stops at uniform thaw
Closed-loop auto-defrost that stops at uniform thaw

ideas.rationale: Measuring the thaw state directly lets the oven defrost frozen food quickly and stop at the right moment, without the user guessing times or power levels.

ideas.title: 27 MHz Solid-State Electrode Thaw

new_nodes.label: Solid-state 27 MHz RF oscillator (LDMOS/GaN)
new_nodes.detail: Low-frequency RF with a wavelength of about 11 m penetrates frozen blocks deeply and produces fewer standing-wave hot spots than 2.45 GHz.

new_nodes.label: Parallel-plate RF electrode shelves
new_nodes.detail: Capacitive electrodes above and below the food replace the magnetron, waveguide and mica cover.

new_nodes.label: Volumetric thaw from the inside out
new_nodes.detail: Heats the whole frozen block at once so the surface does not cook while the centre stays frozen.

new_edges.to: Volumetric thaw from the inside out

new_edges.from: Volumetric thaw from the inside out
Volumetric thaw from the inside out

ideas.rationale: Lower-frequency RF heats frozen food deeply and evenly, which speeds up thawing and removes the magnetron's lifetime limit.

ideas.title: Steam-Condensation Thaw Tray

new_nodes.label: Sealed water-steam tray on cavity floor
new_nodes.detail: A small water reservoir that the microwave field turns into steam, so the cavity fills with condensing vapour instead of dry air.

new_nodes.label: Latent-heat transfer by steam condensation
new_nodes.detail: Steam condensing on cold surfaces releases about 2260 kJ/kg, thawing food faster and more evenly than dry heating.

new_nodes.label: Uniform surface-to-core thaw via condensing steam
new_nodes.detail: Vapour reaches every exposed surface, so thawing is even with no dry hot spots.

new_edges.to: Sealed water-steam tray on cavity floor

new_edges.from: Sealed water-steam tray on cavity floor
Sealed water-steam tray on cavity floor
new_edges.to: Uniform surface-to-core thaw via condensing steam

new_edges.from: Uniform surface-to-core thaw via condensing steam
Uniform surface-to-core thaw via condensing steam
Sealed water-steam tray on cavity floor
Sealed water-steam tray on cavity floor

ideas.rationale: Condensing steam delivers latent heat to every frozen surface, so food thaws quickly and evenly without any extra hardware beyond a water tray.

ideas.title: Static Ferrite Thermal Spreader Bed

new_nodes.label: Stationary ferrite-loaded thermal spreader plate
new_nodes.detail: A fixed plate that absorbs some RF and conducts the heat across the food's base, filling the cold spots of a static cavity.

new_nodes.label: Conductive heat spreading from a lossy solid
new_nodes.detail: The microwave-heated plate becomes a conduction source that smooths out the field's hot and cold zones.

new_nodes.label: Equalised thaw with no moving parts
new_nodes.detail: Gives even defrosting without rotation, so the motor, roller ring and coupler are no longer needed.

new_edges.to: Conductive heat spreading from a lossy solid

new_edges.from: Conductive heat spreading from a lossy solid

new_edges.to: Equalised thaw with no moving parts

new_edges.from: Equalised thaw with no moving parts
Equalised thaw with no moving parts

ideas.rationale: A fixed heat-spreading plate evens out the thaw and removes the motor and turntable hardware, cutting cost while improving defrost uniformity.

ideas.title: Package-Tag Auto-Defrost (RFID Knobless Control)

new_nodes.label: In-cavity RFID/NFC reader
new_nodes.detail: Reads a passive tag printed on the frozen-food package and replaces both the timer and power knobs.

new_nodes.label: Passive RFID defrost-profile lookup
new_nodes.detail: The tag carries food type and weight, and the oven pulls a matching power ratio and time curve automatically.

new_nodes.label: Package-driven defrost programme
new_nodes.detail: Sets time and power automatically from the food, so the user only places the package and presses start.

ideas.rationale: Reading the food's defrost profile from its package gives a fast, correct thaw with no guesswork, and the tags are cheaper than the knobs and cam switches they replace.

ideas.title: Waveguide Mode Stirrer Replaces the Turntable

new_nodes.label: Waveguide-mounted mode stirrer (metal vane fan)
new_nodes.detail: A small motor-driven metal vane sits inside the waveguide mouth, scattering RF so hot spots even out without any part in the cavity.

new_nodes.label: Keeps cavity floor flat and crevice-free
new_nodes.detail: Removes the glass tray, roller ring and coupler, where crumbs and grease collect and are hard to reach.

new_nodes.label: Rotating mode stirrer (RF field scrambling)
new_nodes.detail: Moving conductive vanes shift the standing-wave pattern over time, averaging out hot and cold spots.

new_edges.to: Keeps cavity floor flat and crevice-free

new_edges.from: Keeps cavity floor flat and crevice-free

ideas.rationale: Moving the stirring action into the waveguide leaves the cavity floor smooth and gap-free, so wiping it clean takes seconds.

ideas.title: UV-A Photocatalytic Cavity Lit by a Self-Cleaning LED

new_nodes.label: UV-A and white LED light engine
new_nodes.detail: A solid-state LED emitting white light plus a UV-A band, replacing the 20-25 W incandescent lamp.

new_nodes.label: Titania (TiO2) photocatalytic cavity coating
new_nodes.detail: A thin nano-TiO2 layer on the cavity walls breaks down grease films under the UV-A glow.

new_nodes.label: Self-degrades grease films on cavity walls
new_nodes.detail: Photocatalysis oxidises splatter into CO2 and water, so most residue never needs scrubbing.

new_nodes.label: Photocatalytic oxidation (TiO2 under UV-A)
new_nodes.detail: UV-A photons excite TiO2, creating radicals that oxidise organic residues on the surface.

new_nodes.label: Solid-state LED lighting with UV-A emitter
new_nodes.detail: Semiconductor emitters that are cheap, long-lived and emit a chosen spectrum.

new_edges.to: UV-A and white LED light engine

new_edges.from: UV-A and white LED light engine

new_edges.from: Solid-state LED lighting with UV-A emitter

ideas.title: Flush Laminated Door and Ferrite Gasket Seal

new_nodes.label: Flush laminated mesh-glass door panel
new_nodes.detail: Tempered glass with a fine conductive mesh laminated inside, sitting flush with no recesses or perforations.

new_nodes.label: Ferrite-loaded silicone RF gasket
new_nodes.detail: A flat, lossy elastomer seal that absorbs stray microwaves at the door rim instead of relying on a grooved choke.

new_nodes.label: Presents a smooth, wipe-clean door face
new_nodes.detail: Eliminates mesh openings and choke grooves where splatter and grease lodge.

new_nodes.label: Lossy-dielectric RF absorption gasket
new_nodes.detail: Ferrite-filled elastomer absorbs leaking RF at the door gap, replacing the quarter-wave resonant slot.

new_edges.to: Presents a smooth, wipe-clean door face

new_edges.from: Presents a smooth, wipe-clean door face

ideas.rationale: A flush, perforation-free door and a flat seal remove the holes and grooves where grease collects, so the whole door wipes in one pass.

ideas.title: Sealed Capacitive Touch Panel with Solid-State Power Control

new_nodes.label: Sealed capacitive touch membrane
new_nodes.detail: A flush glass-front control panel with capacitive keys, no knobs and no gaps.

new_nodes.label: Solid-state power controller (microcontroller with IGBT/triac)
new_nodes.detail: Sets power continuously and runs the countdown timer electronically, replacing the cam switches and motor.

new_nodes.label: Provides sealed controls with no crevices
new_nodes.detail: Timer and power are set through a surface that wipes clean and has no moving parts to seize.

new_nodes.label: Capacitive touch sensing
new_nodes.detail: Detects a finger through a sealed glass or plastic surface using changes in capacitance.

new_nodes.label: Microcontroller-based PWM power control
new_nodes.detail: Digital pulse-width modulation sets magnetron power with fine steps and no cam.

new_edges.to: Provides sealed controls with no crevices

new_edges.from: Provides sealed controls with no crevices

ideas.rationale: A flush touch surface with no knobs or cam switches leaves nothing for grease and crumbs to lodge in, so the control panel wipes clean with one cloth.

ideas.title: Disposable Microwave-Safe Cavity Liner

new_nodes.label: Disposable microwave-safe cavity liner
new_nodes.detail: A molded paper-based or PET film liner that lines the cavity floor and walls and is discarded after use.

new_nodes.label: Contains and removes spills in one step
new_nodes.detail: Mess lands on the liner, which is lifted out and binned, leaving bare steel untouched.

new_nodes.label: Heat-resistant PET and paper microwave film
new_nodes.detail: Food-safe, microwave-transparent film rated for the heat of normal cooking cycles.

new_nodes.label: Liner scorching at high power
new_nodes.detail: Film can char or arc near metal edges at full power, and liners must stay food-safe.

new_edges.from: Heat-resistant PET and paper microwave film

new_nodes.label: Ceramic crisp plate (replaces glass turntable)

new_nodes.label: Sears and crisps food surface without added oil

new_edges.to: Sears and crisps food surface without added oil

new_edges.from: Sears and crisps food surface without added oil

ideas.title: Solid-State Phased-Array Heating

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state 2.45 GHz amplifier array
new_nodes.detail: A low-voltage array of gallium-nitride RF amplifiers on a PCB, feeding phased antennas, replaces the magnetron, the step-up transformer, and the HV doubler.

new_nodes.label: Gallium-nitride RF power amplifiers
new_nodes.detail: Wide-bandgap transistors generate 2.45 GHz RF directly from low-voltage DC with fine control of output power.

new_nodes.label: Phased-array beam steering
new_nodes.detail: Adjusting the phase of each antenna moves the field pattern through the cavity so energy lands on the food and not on the empty space.

new_nodes.label: Delivers RF energy only where the food absorbs it
new_nodes.detail: Phase-steered delivery concentrates power on the load and avoids energizing idle cavity volume and standing-wave nulls.

new_edges.from: Delivers RF energy only where the food absorbs it

ideas.rationale: Solid-state amplification removes the transformer's core losses and the HV standby and bleeder losses, while phase-steered delivery directs energy into the food and shortens cook times.

ideas.title: Reflected-Power Doneness Sensing

new_nodes.label: Directional-coupler reflectometer load sensor
new_nodes.detail: A directional coupler on the waveguide measures reflected RF, and firmware uses the change in load impedance to detect when the food reaches target temperature and stop the cycle.

new_nodes.label: Dielectric load-impedance sensing
new_nodes.detail: The food's complex permittivity changes as it heats, so the reflected-power signature tracks cooking progress without a probe.

new_nodes.label: Ends cooking when food reaches target state
new_nodes.detail: Terminates RF output at the actual doneness point rather than after a fixed guessed time.

new_edges.to: Ends cooking when food reaches target state

ideas.rationale: Stopping RF output at the actual doneness point eliminates the energy wasted by overcooking and by fixed timers that run past completion.

ideas.title: Thermoelectric Self-Powered Cooling

new_nodes.label: Thermoelectric generator cooling bank
new_nodes.detail: Bismuth-telluride thermoelectric modules clamped to the magnetron fins and transformer harvest a few watts from waste heat to drive a brushless low-speed fan and the control electronics, replacing the mains-powered fan motor.

new_nodes.label: Seebeck thermoelectric generation
new_nodes.detail: A temperature difference across a semiconductor junction produces a voltage, which turns waste heat into usable electrical power.

new_nodes.label: Self-powers cooling from waste heat
new_nodes.detail: Harvests the appliance's own heat to run its cooling and control loads, so they draw nothing from the mains.

ideas.rationale: Converting the magnetron's waste heat into the power that runs its own fan turns a parasitic load into a recovered energy source, cutting the appliance's net mains draw.

ideas.title: Adaptive-Volume Cavity Bulkhead

new_nodes.label: Sliding conductive bulkhead
new_nodes.detail: A stamped steel shutter with a quarter-wave choke edge slides to shrink the usable cavity to the food footprint, replacing the fixed 20 L of mostly empty volume.

new_nodes.label: Matches energized volume to food size
new_nodes.detail: Limits the field to the region that contains the food, so less RF energy is spent on empty space and standing-wave nulls are reduced.

ideas.rationale: Replacing manual dial-setting with a single scan of the package removes the setup step entirely and gives exact timing that the mechanical timer cannot deliver, so every meal starts faster.

ideas.title: Phase-Steered Electronic Stirring

new_nodes.label: Twin-feed phase-steered RF antenna array
new_nodes.detail: Two or more coherent feeds with programmed phase offsets replace the turntable, roller ring and motor.

new_nodes.label: Phased-array RF beam steering
new_nodes.detail: Relative phase control of coherent RF sources moves the standing-wave hot spots across the cavity electronically.

new_nodes.label: Electronic field stirring
new_nodes.detail: The energy maximum sweeps through the food without any moving parts, so the food does not need to be rotated or stirred by the user.

ideas.rationale: Even heating without a turntable removes the stop-and-stir step and the extra cook time needed to compensate for cold spots, so food is ready sooner.

ideas.title: Solid-State Low-Voltage RF Core

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state 2.45 GHz RF amplifier
new_nodes.detail: Gallium-nitride transistors generate 2.45 GHz RF directly from a low-voltage DC supply, with no oil-filled transformer or kV multiplier.

new_nodes.label: Extra-low-voltage DC bus (48 V SELV)
new_nodes.detail: Mains is rectified and stepped down to a safety extra-low voltage inside the enclosure, so no lethal voltage exists anywhere in the appliance.

new_nodes.label: GaN RF power module array (700 W)
new_nodes.detail: Parallel solid-state modules replace the magnetron, transformer, capacitor and diode chain.

new_nodes.label: Phased patch-antenna array
new_nodes.detail: Antennas radiate straight into the cavity, and phase steering shifts the field pattern to reduce standing-wave hot spots.

new_nodes.label: Delivers 700 W of microwave energy with no kilovolt circuit present
new_nodes.detail: Removes the electric-shock hazard at source instead of guarding against it.

ideas.rationale: Removing the kilovolt transformer, capacitor and diode chain eliminates the lethal-charge and high-voltage shock hazard at source, so no child or user can ever reach dangerous voltage inside the appliance.

ideas.title: Rectenna Leak Sentinel

new_nodes.label: Rectenna leakage-sensing ring
new_nodes.detail: Schottky-diode pickup antennas around the door rim continuously measure stray 2.45 GHz energy and detect leaks from any cause.

new_nodes.label: Solid-state RF kill gate
new_nodes.detail: A fast transistor switch in the magnetron drive cuts RF output within a few milliseconds when the sentinel trips.

new_nodes.label: RF rectification detection (Schottky detector)
new_nodes.detail: Microwave energy is rectified into a DC voltage that a simple comparator reads as a leakage level.

new_nodes.label: Detects microwave leakage from any cause and cuts power in milliseconds
new_nodes.detail: Covers cracked seals, misaligned doors and tampered switches, which a mechanical interlock cannot detect.

new_edges.to: Detects microwave leakage from any cause and cuts power in milliseconds

new_edges.from: Detects microwave leakage from any cause and cuts power in milliseconds

ideas.rationale: A sensor that measures actual radiation leakage, rather than relying on a switch that only checks the door position, protects family members from microwave exposure even when the seal or interlock has failed.

ideas.title: Cool-Skin Aerogel Shell

new_nodes.label: Aerogel-insulated double-wall composite skin
new_nodes.detail: A thin polymer outer shell with a silica-aerogel layer and an air gap replaces the hot steel wrapper and holds external surfaces well below burn threshold.

new_nodes.label: Silica aerogel thermal insulation
new_nodes.detail: Nanoporous silica insulates so effectively that the outer skin stays cool even when the cavity is at full heat.

new_nodes.label: Phase-change material thermal buffer
new_nodes.detail: Paraffin-based panels absorb excess heat during long cooks and release it slowly, flattening surface temperature peaks.

new_nodes.label: Keeps every reachable outer surface below 45 C during operation
new_nodes.detail: Removes the burn risk from touching the body, handles, or vents during and after cooking.

new_nodes.label: ITO-coated borosilicate door window (flush, no holes)
new_nodes.detail: A solid glass panel with a transparent conductive coating reflects 2.45 GHz while transmitting visible light, so no perforations are needed.

new_nodes.label: Transparent conductive oxide film (indium tin oxide)
new_nodes.detail: A thin ITO layer is optically clear but conductive enough to act as a microwave reflector across the whole door.

new_nodes.label: Shows food with no apertures for RF to leak through
new_nodes.detail: Provides visibility and containment with the door surface itself, not a mesh of holes.

ideas.title: Scan-and-Go Packaging

new_nodes.label: NFC tag printed on food packaging
new_nodes.detail: Passive tag stores cook time, power level and food type for each meal at a fraction of a cent.

new_nodes.label: Passive NFC backscatter reading
new_nodes.detail: Fascia reader energises the tag over 13.56 MHz and decodes its data.

new_nodes.label: Auto-sets time and power from package
new_nodes.detail: Tap the package to the fascia and the oven runs the correct cycle with no knobs to turn.

ideas.title: Instant-On Solid-State Heat

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state 2.45 GHz RF amplifier
new_nodes.detail: Transistor modules combine to about 700 W with no cathode or filament to warm up.

new_nodes.label: Gallium-nitride RF power amplification
new_nodes.detail: High-efficiency wideband transistors amplify a 2.45 GHz signal from a low-voltage source.

new_nodes.label: 48 V switch-mode DC supply
new_nodes.detail: Compact ferrite-core converter replaces the 2 kV transformer, capacitor and diode stack.

new_nodes.label: High-frequency switch-mode power conversion
new_nodes.detail: Megahertz-range switching shrinks the magnetics and removes the lethal stored charge.

new_nodes.label: Instant-on continuous power
new_nodes.detail: Full power arrives in milliseconds with linear power control instead of on/off cycling.

ideas.rationale: Solid-state power hits full heat the instant the door closes, so every reheat skips the magnetron warm-up and on/off cycling.

ideas.title: Electronic Hotspot Steering

new_nodes.label: Phased patch-antenna array on cavity walls
new_nodes.detail: Four to eight feed patches with individual phase shifters aim the field at cold spots.

new_nodes.label: Electronic beam steering via phase control
new_nodes.detail: Relative phase between feeds sweeps the hot zone across the food in under a second.

new_nodes.label: Heats every zone without moving the food
new_nodes.detail: An electronic field sweep replaces the 5 rpm mechanical rotation.

new_nodes.label: Graphene-ceramic susceptor plate
new_nodes.detail: Microwave-absorbing plate that reaches about 250 °C in under a minute and sears food from below.

new_nodes.label: Microwave susceptor heating via lossy coating
new_nodes.detail: RF energy is absorbed by a lossy film and re-radiated as contact heat into the food surface.

new_nodes.label: Browns and crisps food during reheat
new_nodes.detail: Surface contact heat gives a crisp base within the same short cycle as the reheat.
