new_nodes.detail: Metal-oxide gas sensor at the exhaust port rises in signal as food vapour peaks, marking doneness.

new_nodes.label: Ends cycle at doneness, not a guessed time
new_nodes.detail: Cuts power when the vapour curve plateaus, avoiding overheating and wasted minutes.

ideas.title: Steam-Crisp Sear Plate (Oil-Free Browning)

new_nodes.label: Infrared emissive ceramic sear plate
new_nodes.detail: Thin ceramic plate absorbs stray microwave energy and re-radiates it as infrared, browning food surfaces without added oil.

new_nodes.label: Surface browning without frying oil
new_nodes.detail: Creates Maillard-style crust on the food exterior so users need no oil or breading to get crisp results.

new_nodes.label: Ceramic sear plate insert
new_nodes.detail: Removable plate at the cavity floor that doubles as a browning element.

ideas.rationale: Replacing fat-based frying with an oil-free infrared crust lets families get crisp, appealing food while cutting added fat, directly serving M12.

ideas.title: Nutrient Vault: Sealed Low-Oxygen Steam Cavity

new_nodes.label: Preserves vitamins by limiting oxygen and leaching
new_nodes.detail: Sealed, pressurised steam environment cuts vitamin C oxidation and water-soluble nutrient loss.

new_nodes.label: Pressure-rated sealed steam cavity
new_nodes.detail: Cavity with a gasketed lid and self-venting valve that holds steam at controlled pressure.

new_nodes.label: Steam-retention lid valve
new_nodes.detail: Replaces the open vent louvres with a pressure-regulating valve that keeps steam in the food zone.

new_edges.to: Preserves vitamins by limiting oxygen and leaching

new_edges.from: Preserves vitamins by limiting oxygen and leaching

ideas.rationale: Sealing in steam instead of letting it escape cuts oxidative and leaching nutrient loss, so vegetables keep more vitamins with no added fat.

ideas.title: Fat-Sensing Fry-less Cooker

new_nodes.label: Dielectric permittivity sensing
new_nodes.detail: Measures food dielectric loss in real time to infer moisture and fat content.

new_nodes.label: Closed-loop doneness and fat-aware cooking
new_nodes.detail: Adjusts power and time to stop at target doneness, avoiding overcooking and fat-rich reheats.

new_nodes.label: Embedded dielectric probe plate
new_nodes.detail: Pair of contactless electrodes in the cavity wall reading the food's dielectric signature.

ideas.rationale: Sensing food state replaces the mechanical timer guesswork, so food is cooked to target doneness without excess reheating or fat-heavy workarounds.

ideas.title: Transparent Glass Nutrition Window Cavity

new_nodes.label: Transparent conductive oxide mesh glass
new_nodes.detail: Microwave-shielding but visible-light-transparent glass lets users see food without a lamp or cavity holes.

new_nodes.label: Transparent cavity viewing wall
new_nodes.detail: Full-visibility cavity wall replacing the perforated door and interior lamp.

new_nodes.label: Visual doneness checking
new_nodes.detail: Lets users watch food and stop cooking at the right moment, avoiding burnt or dried-out food.

ideas.rationale: Clear viewing prevents overcooking that destroys nutrients and adds fat through rescue reheating, supporting healthier results.

ideas.title: Ferrite-Free Clockwork Nutrient Timer

new_nodes.label: Piezo-resonant rotation sensing
new_nodes.detail: Replaces the rotating tray motor and roller ring with a vibration-driven spinner that uses less energy and fewer moving parts.

new_nodes.label: Even heating with less energy waste
new_nodes.detail: Rotates food evenly so it cooks through without long re-heats that degrade nutrients.

new_nodes.label: Vibrating base plate spinner
new_nodes.detail: Vibrates the tray base to rotate it, removing the motor, coupler and roller ring.

new_edges.to: Even heating with less energy waste

new_edges.from: Even heating with less energy waste

ideas.rationale: Even, shorter cooking cycles preserve heat-sensitive nutrients, and a simpler spinner reduces cost so healthier cooking reaches more households.

ideas.title: Steam-Sniffing End Point

new_nodes.label: Environmental & chemical sensing
new_nodes.detail: Detection of gases, humidity and volatile compounds in air.

new_nodes.label: Humidity and VOC gas sensor in cavity exhaust
new_nodes.detail: Rising steam and aroma compounds mark the moment food reaches readiness.

new_nodes.label: Steam-sensing end-point module
new_nodes.detail: Replaces the clockwork timer as the thing that decides when cooking stops.

new_nodes.label: Detects food readiness from steam and aroma
new_nodes.detail: Ends cooking when the food itself signals it is done, not when a clock runs out.

new_edges.from: Humidity and VOC gas sensor in cavity exhaust

new_edges.to: Humidity and VOC gas sensor in cavity exhaust
Detects food readiness from steam and aroma

new_edges.from: Detects food readiness from steam and aroma

ideas.rationale: Replacing the blind timer with a sensor that reads the food's own steam tells the user when the food is actually ready, which directly answers M8.

ideas.title: Sonified Cooking

new_nodes.label: Temperature-to-pitch sonification
new_nodes.detail: A cavity thermistor drives a tone whose pitch rises as the food heats.

new_nodes.label: Progress tone generator
new_nodes.detail: A small speaker that plays a continuous cooking tone in place of a single bell strike.

new_nodes.label: Gives continuous audible progress, not only an end alert
new_nodes.detail: The user can hear how far along cooking is without looking or waiting for a final ding.

new_edges.to: Gives continuous audible progress, not only an end alert

new_edges.from: Gives continuous audible progress, not only an end alert

ideas.rationale: A tone that tracks real temperature gives the user a continuous sense of how close the food is to ready, which serves M8 far better than one bell at the end.

ideas.title: Thermochromic Heat-Map Door

new_nodes.label: Thermochromic film on door glass
new_nodes.detail: A colour-changing film shows the surface temperature pattern of the food through the window.

new_nodes.label: Thermal readout door panel
new_nodes.detail: Door window that shows a colour heat map of the food in place of the lamp light.

new_nodes.label: Shows where and how hot the food is at a glance
new_nodes.detail: The user sees cold spots and hot spots without any light source inside the cavity.

new_edges.to: Shows where and how hot the food is at a glance

new_edges.from: Shows where and how hot the food is at a glance

ideas.rationale: Colour that shows temperature directly tells the user whether the food is hot all the way through, serving M8 while removing the bulb that burns out.

ideas.title: Wristband Done-Ping

new_nodes.label: Bluetooth Low Energy done-alert link

new_nodes.label: Delivers a silent haptic alert to the user's wearable

new_nodes.label: Omni-wheel chassis with self-docking base
new_nodes.detail: The microwave sits on a low-profile chassis with omni-wheels, drives itself to a docking bay, and can be called to the user's chair or sofa.

ideas.title: Solid-state GaN amplifier replaces the magnetron and HV chain

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state RF power amplifier at 2.45 GHz
new_nodes.detail: Gallium-nitride transistors generate 2.45 GHz RF directly from a low-voltage DC rail, with no heated cathode or 4 kV supply.

new_nodes.label: High-frequency switch-mode low-voltage DC supply
new_nodes.detail: A ~48 V SMPS replaces the iron-core HV transformer, voltage doubler and bulky capacitor.

new_nodes.label: GaN amplifier module array
new_nodes.detail: Modular 100 W transistor amplifiers combined into a 700 W-equivalent output with no warm-up time.

new_nodes.label: Continuous analogue power control
new_nodes.detail: Sets power as a continuous level, removing the wasted on/off duty-cycle losses.

new_edges.from: GaN solid-state RF power amplifier at 2.45 GHz

new_edges.to: GaN solid-state RF power amplifier at 2.45 GHz

new_edges.from: GaN solid-state RF power amplifier at 2.45 GHz

ideas.rationale: Solid-state amplifiers driven by a low-voltage switch-mode supply convert mains power to RF more efficiently than the transformer-magnetron chain, and continuous modulation removes the energy lost to duty cycling.

ideas.title: Phased-array feed replaces the turntable motor and roller ring

new_nodes.label: Phased-array feed panel
new_nodes.detail: Four to eight solid-state feed antennas in the cavity floor, each with an electronically controlled phase.

new_nodes.label: Electronic beam steering (phased-array antennas)
new_nodes.detail: Phase shifts between feeds sweep the standing-wave pattern so hot spots move without moving the food.

new_nodes.label: Even heating without rotating the food
new_nodes.detail: Distributes microwave energy across the load electronically, with no rotating mass.

new_edges.from: Even heating without rotating the food

new_edges.to: Even heating without rotating the food

ideas.rationale: Removing the 5 rpm motor, its friction losses and the rotating mass, while steering the field electronically, shortens reheat times and cuts energy wasted in cold spots.

ideas.title: Shape-memory tunable-volume cavity replaces the fixed 20 L box

new_nodes.label: Shape-memory alloy thermal actuation
new_nodes.detail: Nickel-titanium wires contract when warmed by the cavity itself, moving walls with no motor.

new_nodes.label: Variable-volume resonant cavity
new_nodes.detail: A cavity whose metal walls shift to fit the food, keeping the resonant volume near the load size.

new_nodes.label: Shape-memory-alloy bellows walls
new_nodes.detail: Pleated steel side walls that fold inward as the cavity heats and return when cooled.

new_nodes.label: Confines microwave energy to a food-sized volume
new_nodes.detail: Limits the excited air and metal volume to what the food occupies.

new_edges.to: Confines microwave energy to a food-sized volume

new_edges.from: Confines microwave energy to a food-sized volume

ideas.rationale: Heating only the volume the food occupies cuts the thermal mass and idle field energy that a fixed 20 L cavity wastes on every cycle.

ideas.title: Waste-heat reclaim with heat pipes replaces the cooling fan and vents

new_nodes.label: Heat-pipe phase-change heat transport
new_nodes.detail: Sealed copper heat pipes move magnetron waste heat passively to useful surfaces with no fan.

new_nodes.label: Heat-pipe manifold on magnetron fins
new_nodes.detail: Sealed heat pipes carry the roughly one-third of input power the magnetron wastes to a warming shelf.

new_nodes.label: Passive thermal warming shelf
new_nodes.detail: Underside plate that keeps plates, mugs and milk warm after cooking.

new_nodes.label: Reclaims waste heat for useful warming
new_nodes.detail: Turns heat that would be vented into warming for drinks and plates.

new_edges.to: Reclaims waste heat for useful warming

new_edges.from: Reclaims waste heat for useful warming

ideas.rationale: Recycling the magnetron's waste heat into a warming shelf puts energy that was vented back to work, and removing the fan cuts its electrical draw.

ideas.title: Food-state gas sensing replaces the mechanical timer

new_nodes.label: Metal-oxide gas and humidity sensing
new_nodes.detail: Low-cost MOX and humidity sensors detect the vapour curve that food gives off as it heats.

new_nodes.label: Gas and humidity sensor array (e-nose)
new_nodes.detail: Small sensor cluster in the cavity roof that ends cooking when the food reaches its target state.

new_nodes.label: Senses food state and ends cooking automatically
new_nodes.detail: Closes the feedback loop so power stops when the food is done, not when a timer runs out.

new_edges.to: Senses food state and ends cooking automatically

new_edges.from: Senses food state and ends cooking automatically

ideas.rationale: Ending power the moment food reaches its target state eliminates the overshoot and waste of fixed timers, so energy is spent only on the cooking the food needs.

ideas.title: Mains-Free Contactless Interlock via Field-Sensing Door

new_nodes.label: Capacitive proximity sensing of door position
new_nodes.detail: Electrode in door frame detects the dielectric change of a closed door, replacing mechanical switch actuation.

new_nodes.label: Solid-state RF kill switch
new_nodes.detail: Semiconductor gate that cuts magnetron drive in microseconds, replacing the three mechanical microswitches.

new_nodes.label: Detects a child or hand in the gap before the door opens
new_nodes.detail: Proximity field stops RF before any body part reaches the aperture.

new_edges.from: Capacitive proximity sensing of door position
Detects a child or hand in the gap before the door opens

ideas.rationale: Removing mechanical switches and replacing them with proximity sensing stops RF before a hand can enter the gap, protecting children and the elderly from radiation and burns.

ideas.title: Self-Discharging Capacitor Replaced by Passive Resistive Mesh

new_nodes.label: Distributed resistive discharge film
new_nodes.detail: Thin resistive coating across the HV capacitor and HV leads bleeds charge to safe levels in seconds without a dedicated bleeder component.

new_nodes.label: Resistive discharge film
new_nodes.detail: Printed film replaces the internal bleeder resistor and its failure mode.

new_nodes.label: Guarantees safe voltage on any fault
new_nodes.detail: Charge is removed even if the bleeder open-circuits.

new_edges.from: Guarantees safe voltage on any fault
Guarantees safe voltage on any fault

ideas.rationale: A distributed discharge film removes the single-point failure of the bleeder resistor, so a lethal charge cannot survive a fault and reach a curious child or an elderly user.

ideas.title: Transparent Plasma-Free Cavity Using Conductive Glass Mesh

new_nodes.label: Indium-tin-oxide coated borosilicate window
new_nodes.detail: Transparent conductive film reflects microwaves while passing visible light, removing the perforated mesh.

new_nodes.label: Transparent conductive door window
new_nodes.detail: Full-face window that seals RF without holes or sharp metal edges.

new_nodes.label: Removes sharp mesh edges and cuts snag hazards
new_nodes.detail: Smooth glass face has no exposed metal to scratch or arc.

new_edges.from: Removes sharp mesh edges and cuts snag hazards

ideas.rationale: A continuous conductive glass face removes the mesh that children can poke fingers through and that snags clothing, and it reduces the metal-arcing risk that comes with exposed edges.

ideas.title: Thermochromic Surface Replacing Mechanical Thermal Cutouts

new_nodes.label: Thermochromic outer-surface indicator
new_nodes.detail: Heat-sensitive ink changes colour as surfaces approach burn temperature, giving a visual warning independent of any cutout.

new_nodes.label: Thermochromic burn-warning panel
new_nodes.detail: Printed panel on the wrapper warns users before contact is hazardous.

new_nodes.label: Warns of surface burn hazard
new_nodes.detail: Visual cue alerts users before touch burns occur.

ideas.rationale: A colour-changing surface warns elderly users and parents about burn-hot surfaces, adding a passive safety layer that does not rely on a single snap-disc failing safe.

new_nodes.label: Ultrasonic seal monitor
new_nodes.detail: Transducer pair in the door rim checks gap integrity.

new_nodes.label: Verifies door seal before RF is allowed

ideas.title: Listen-to-the-Milk Sensor

new_nodes.label: Piezo listening sensor & buzzer
new_nodes.detail: One cheap piezo disc listens for the simmer and rumble of milk nearing boil, then sounds the end-of-cycle chirp.

new_nodes.label: Acoustic boil-onset detection
new_nodes.detail: Threshold logic on the piezo signal detects pre-boil acoustic signatures, replacing a countdown.

new_nodes.label: Sound-triggered stop at simmer
new_nodes.detail: Cuts power at the first sign of simmer rather than after a guessed time.

ideas.rationale: Listening for the onset of simmer stops the heater at the right moment for milk, so the user gets hot milk without a guessed timer or a boil-over.

ideas.title: Nucleation Turntable

new_nodes.label: Nucleation-textured ceramic turntable
new_nodes.detail: Microwave-transparent ceramic plate with a micro-pitted surface that gives bubbles nucleation sites.

new_nodes.label: Fired micro-pit surface nucleation
new_nodes.detail: Controlled surface roughness seeds bubbles at normal boiling, so liquids cannot eruptively superheat.

new_nodes.label: Controlled bubble seeding in liquids
new_nodes.detail: Gives liquids a place to nucleate bubbles, so milk boils gently instead of erupting.

ideas.rationale: Seeding bubbles on the turntable itself removes the superheat trap that makes milk erupt, so the drink is hot and safe to lift at breakfast.

ideas.title: Mug-Sized Resonant Well

new_nodes.label: Mug-sized resonant well
new_nodes.detail: A coaxial cylinder about the size of a breakfast mug; the cup slots into it and the cylinder is the cavity.

new_nodes.label: Scaled cylinder mode tuning
new_nodes.detail: Cylinder diameter scaled to the 12.2 cm wavelength gives a predictable mode with fewer standing-wave hot spots.

new_nodes.label: Single-serve hot-milk function
new_nodes.detail: Heats one mug of milk per cycle with a small, fast-filling field.

ideas.rationale: A cavity sized to one mug heats a breakfast drink quickly and evenly, and it needs no 20 L box on the counter.

ideas.title: Solid-State Breakfast Engine

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state 2.45 GHz amplifier
new_nodes.detail: A transistor RF amplifier on a PCB replaces the vacuum magnetron.

new_nodes.label: 24 V switch-mode power brick
new_nodes.detail: A low-voltage supply replaces the HV transformer, capacitor and diode, so no lethal charge is stored.

new_nodes.label: GaN HEMT RF amplification
new_nodes.detail: Semiconductor RF amplification at 2.45 GHz with no cathode to wear out.

new_nodes.label: Switch-mode DC-DC conversion
new_nodes.detail: Efficient low-voltage conversion from mains to the RF stage.

new_nodes.label: Continuous power modulation
new_nodes.detail: Sets the output level continuously instead of by on/off cycling.

ideas.rationale: Removing the kilovolt chain and the vacuum tube gives instant start and smooth power control, so milk can be warmed gently without the on/off surging that scorches or boils it.

ideas.title: Cup-Tag Breakfast Mode

new_nodes.label: NFC milk-cup tag
new_nodes.detail: A passive NFC sticker moulded into the mug base that encodes volume and target temperature for a few cents.

new_nodes.label: Passive NFC near-field reading
new_nodes.detail: A reader in the cavity floor identifies the tag with no battery or mechanics.

new_nodes.label: Vessel-set power and time
new_nodes.detail: The vessel's tag sets power and duration automatically, replacing the power knob.

new_nodes.label: Thermochromic milk-temperature ring
new_nodes.detail: A ring on the mug turns from white to red at about 65 °C, showing when the milk is ready.

new_nodes.label: Leuco-dye thermochromism
new_nodes.detail: Reversible colour-change dye that changes state at a set temperature with no power.

new_nodes.label: Colour-coded milk temperature
new_nodes.detail: Shows milk temperature at a glance without any electronics.

ideas.rationale: Putting the recipe on the cup means the user just places the mug and taps, and a colour ring confirms the milk is ready, with no dials or guesswork.

ideas.title: Induction Butter Bowl Replaces the Magnetron

new_nodes.label: Induction coil in cavity floor
new_nodes.detail: Flat spiral coil under the cavity floor drives eddy currents in any ferrous or stainless mixing bowl placed on it.

new_nodes.label: Electromagnetic induction heating
new_nodes.detail: Alternating magnetic field induces eddy currents in a conductive vessel, which heats it directly.

new_nodes.label: Heats the metal vessel directly, not the food
new_nodes.detail: Heat is generated in the bowl itself, so the butter melts from the container up with no RF leakage.

new_nodes.label: Induction heating & inverter power electronics
new_nodes.detail: High-frequency inverter drive of resonant coils.

new_edges.to: Heats the metal vessel directly, not the food

new_edges.from: Heats the metal vessel directly, not the food

ideas.rationale: Melting butter directly in a conductive bowl needs no RF energy escaping the cavity, so a parent can melt butter safely and quickly in the same container used for mixing the cake batter.

ideas.title: Magnetically Coupled Stirring Paddle Replaces the Turntable

new_nodes.label: Magnetic stirring paddle
new_nodes.detail: Sealed PTFE-coated paddle in the bowl, driven through the cavity floor by a ferrite magnetic coupling.

new_nodes.label: Stirs melting ingredients to prevent hot spots
new_nodes.detail: Continuous stirring moves the melt and removes cold and hot pockets that standing waves leave behind.

new_nodes.label: Magnetic coupling (permanent-magnet drive)
new_nodes.detail: Torque transmitted through a sealed barrier by aligned magnetic fields, with no shaft penetrating the cavity.

new_nodes.label: Magnetic drive & mixing mechanics

ideas.title: Graphene Film Heater Replaces the High-Voltage Magnetron Chain

new_nodes.label: Low-voltage graphene film heater
new_nodes.detail: Thin flexible graphene-polymer heating film laminated to the cavity floor, powered at 12 to 24 V DC.

new_nodes.label: Conducts heat to the bowl base by contact
new_nodes.detail: Heat conducts from the film into the bottom of any cookware, melting butter gently and evenly.

new_nodes.label: Resistive (Joule) heating in graphene films
new_nodes.detail: Current through a conductive film produces uniform low-voltage heat.

new_nodes.label: Carbon nanomaterials & thin-film heating
new_nodes.detail: Printed or laminated conductive carbon films used as heating elements.

ideas.title: Thermochromic Door Window Shows Butter Melt State

new_nodes.label: Thermochromic glass-film door window
new_nodes.detail: Door window coated with a film that changes colour at melting temperature, showing progress at a glance.

new_nodes.label: Shows melt progress visually
new_nodes.detail: A colour change signals when butter is fully liquid, so no one has to open the door and check.

new_nodes.label: Thermochromic leuco-dye films
new_nodes.detail: Dye layers that change colour reversibly at a set temperature.

new_nodes.label: Functional coatings & optical materials
new_nodes.detail: Temperature-responsive optical coatings on glass.

ideas.rationale: A colour-changing window that marks the melt point lets parents see butter reach liquid without opening the door, reducing mistakes in the cake prep step of M17.

ideas.title: Cook-to-Done Sensing Replaces the Timer Dial

new_nodes.label: Multi-sensor food-state fusion (IR thermopile array + humidity + gas VOC sensing)
new_nodes.detail: Reads surface temperature, moisture loss and aroma change to estimate doneness in real time.

new_nodes.label: Doneness sensor module
new_nodes.detail: Small sensor head behind the door mesh that replaces the mechanical timer knob and cam switch.

new_nodes.label: Stops cooking automatically when food is done
new_nodes.detail: Closed-loop control that ends the cycle at the correct moment, so the user never guesses a time.

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state RF amplifier array
new_nodes.detail: Dozens of small transistor amplifiers generate 2.45 GHz with no cathode, no high voltage and no warm-up.

new_nodes.label: Solid-state RF amplifier module (GaN)
new_nodes.detail: Replaces the magnetron, HV transformer, HV capacitor and rectifier with low-voltage electronics.

new_nodes.label: Continuous, instant-on power from 0 to 100%
new_nodes.detail: Starts at full power in milliseconds and modulates power smoothly without on/off cycling.

ideas.title: Phased-Array Beam Steering Replaces the Turntable

new_nodes.label: Phased-array RF beam steering
new_nodes.detail: Multiple emitters with controlled phase shift move hot spots across the cavity electronically.

new_nodes.label: Phased emitter ring (cavity wall array)
new_nodes.detail: Emitters on the cavity walls replace the glass tray, roller ring and turntable motor.

new_nodes.label: Even heating without rotation or stirring

new_nodes.label: Alerts the user wherever they are in the home

new_nodes.detail: Transistor-based RF power stage that replaces the magnetron and its high-voltage chain, running from low-voltage DC.

new_nodes.label: GaN RF power module array
new_nodes.detail: Stacked low-voltage amplifier modules with PWM power control, replacing the magnetron, transformer, capacitor and diode.

new_nodes.label: Instant-on microwave pulses with sub-second start
new_nodes.detail: Energy starts and stops in milliseconds, so there is no warm-up and no wasted seconds at the end of a cycle.

new_edges.from: Instant-on microwave pulses with sub-second start

new_edges.to: Instant-on microwave pulses with sub-second start

ideas.rationale: Instant-on solid-state power removes magnetron warm-up and high-voltage hazards, so a reheat starts the moment the user presses start.

new_nodes.label: RF reflectometry for food permittivity sensing
new_nodes.detail: Measures how much of the injected 2.45 GHz energy is absorbed versus reflected to estimate food mass and temperature.

new_nodes.label: Reflectometer antenna pair in cavity wall
new_nodes.detail: Two small sensing probes in the existing steel cavity that read the load's RF signature.

new_nodes.label: Automatic heating time from load signature
new_nodes.detail: Sets the reheat duration and power level without any user input, replacing the timer knob and power knob.

ideas.title: Frequency-Sweep Stirring Instead of Turntable

new_nodes.label: Frequency-agile RF sweep (2.40-2.50 GHz)
new_nodes.detail: Rapidly sweeping the source frequency shifts the standing-wave pattern so hot and cold spots move around.

new_nodes.label: Solid-state frequency-sweep driver
new_nodes.detail: Electronic oscillator that replaces the rotating tray, roller ring and motor as the source of even heating.

new_nodes.label: Electronic field stirring
new_nodes.detail: Spreads energy evenly across the food with no moving parts, so the tray no longer has to rotate.

ideas.rationale: Removing the turntable means no tray to load, wash or wait for, so food goes straight from the fridge into the cavity.

ideas.title: Multi-Patch Antenna Feed Replaces Waveguide

new_nodes.label: Stamped-steel patch antenna array
new_nodes.detail: Flat printed or stamped radiating patches fitted into the cavity walls, fed directly from the RF source.

new_nodes.label: Four-corner patch antenna feed
new_nodes.detail: Four stamped patches at the cavity corners that replace the waveguide duct and its mica cover.

new_nodes.label: Multi-angle RF injection
new_nodes.detail: Energy enters from four directions at once, which reduces shadowing and hot spots.

ideas.rationale: Injecting energy from several points in the cavity heats a plate in one pass, cutting the reheat time and removing the splatter-prone mica cover.

ideas.title: Susceptor Ceiling for Instant Browning

new_nodes.label: Microwave-to-infrared ceramic susceptor
new_nodes.detail: A ceramic plate that absorbs microwave energy and re-radiates it as infrared, browning the surface of food.

new_nodes.label: Ceramic IR susceptor ceiling panel
new_nodes.detail: A cheap ceramic panel fixed to the cavity roof, replacing the need for a separate grill element.

new_nodes.label: Surface browning in microwave mode
new_nodes.detail: Crisps and browns food surfaces at the same time as the core heats, so no second cooking step is needed.

ideas.rationale: Browning in the same cycle lets a busy user get a crisp reheated meal without preheating a second appliance.

ideas.title: Seamless Hydroformed Cavity

new_nodes.label: Seamless hydroformed steel cavity with 12 mm radiused corners
new_nodes.detail: One deep-drawn steel shell with no spot-weld seams or corner pockets where grease and crumbs collect.

new_nodes.label: Hydroforming / deep drawing of cold-rolled steel
new_nodes.detail: Single-piece forming replaces multi-panel stamping and spot welding of the cavity.

ideas.title: Ceiling Mode-Stirrer Replaces the Turntable

new_nodes.label: Sealed ceiling mode-stirrer paddle
new_nodes.detail: A metal fan hidden behind a ceiling cover that scatters the microwave field so food needs no rotation.

new_nodes.label: Rotating mode stirrer in cavity ceiling
new_nodes.detail: Stirs the RF field to smooth hot and cold spots without a moving tray.

new_edges.to: Rotating mode stirrer in cavity ceiling

ideas.rationale: Eliminating the glass tray, roller ring and its motor removes the hardest-to-reach grime pocket and the tray that must be lifted out and washed.

ideas.title: Disposable Peel-Off Splatter Film

new_nodes.label: Roll-fed disposable splatter film
new_nodes.detail: Microwave-transparent polyimide film that covers the waveguide opening and is peeled off when soiled.

new_nodes.label: Roll-fed microwave-transparent polymer film
new_nodes.detail: High-temperature film (e.g. polyimide) that passes RF and resists splatter.

ideas.rationale: Replacing the fixed mica cover with a peel-off film means the splattered surface is thrown away instead of scrubbed, which serves M11.

new_nodes.label: Flush borosilicate door with ITO conductive film and flat gasket
new_nodes.detail: Smooth, holeless glass door whose transparent conductive coating blocks RF, with a flat wipeable gasket in place of the choke groove.

new_nodes.label: Indium tin oxide (ITO) transparent conductive coating
new_nodes.detail: Thin conductive film that reflects microwaves while passing visible light.

ideas.title: Microwave Steam-Soak Self-Clean Cycle

new_nodes.label: Steam-softens baked-on residue for wiping
new_nodes.detail: Microwaves boil water in a bowl to steam the cavity so dried splatter loosens and wipes off.

new_nodes.label: Steam-soak preset on the timer knob
new_nodes.detail: A marked timer position that runs a fixed-power steam cycle with no extra controls.

new_nodes.label: Microwave-driven steam generation from water
new_nodes.detail: Dielectric heating of water in a bowl produces steam that condenses on the cavity walls.

new_edges.from: Steam-soak preset on the timer knob
Steam-soak preset on the timer knob

ideas.rationale: Turning the microwave's own heat into a built-in steam-soak cycle replaces scrubbing with a single timer setting followed by a wipe, which serves M11.

ideas.title: Ice-Sensing Closed-Loop Defrost

new_nodes.label: Dielectric-impedance sensing plate
new_nodes.detail: Two electrodes in the cavity floor read the food's loss tangent, which shifts sharply when ice turns to water.

new_nodes.label: Detects ice-to-water transition in real time
new_nodes.detail: Ends each defrost phase at the exact moment the food is thawed, without a timer or user guess.

new_nodes.label: Adaptive power modulation from impedance feedback
new_nodes.detail: Sets duty cycle continuously from sensor readings instead of a fixed 5-step cam.

new_edges.from: Adaptive power modulation from impedance feedback
Adaptive power modulation from impedance feedback

ideas.rationale: By detecting the ice-to-water transition directly, the oven stops defrosting at the right moment, so frozen food thaws fast without overcooking the edges.

ideas.title: Solid-State Frequency-Sweep Defrost Amplifier

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state RF amplifier with frequency-sweep driver
new_nodes.detail: Low-voltage transistor amplifier sweeping 2.40-2.50 GHz so standing waves never settle into fixed hot and cold spots.

new_nodes.label: Low-voltage GaN power amplification
new_nodes.detail: Generates RF at tens of volts DC, removing the 2 kV transformer and 4 kV doubler chain.

new_nodes.label: Uniform field sweep for even thawing
new_nodes.detail: Continuously shifting frequency distributes energy across the cavity, so the thaw front advances evenly.

ideas.rationale: A frequency-swept solid-state source removes the high-voltage chain and spreads energy evenly, so frozen blocks thaw uniformly and faster with no lethal capacitor or magnetron wear.

ideas.title: Phased-Array Steered Field Replacing the Turntable

new_nodes.label: Four-element phased antenna array in cavity walls
new_nodes.detail: Antennas in the cavity walls steer the beam toward the coldest part of the food, with no moving parts.

new_nodes.label: Electronically steers energy to cold spots
new_nodes.detail: Phase offsets move the hot zone around the food, replacing mechanical rotation.

new_nodes.label: Phased-array beam steering
new_nodes.detail: Relative phase control of RF feeds shapes the field pattern in real time.

ideas.rationale: Steering the beam to cold spots eliminates the slow rotating-tray method, so a frozen roast thaws evenly from all sides in much less time.

ideas.title: Supercapacitor Burst Defrost

new_nodes.label: Supercapacitor energy buffer with DC-DC converter
new_nodes.detail: A supercapacitor bank stores energy from the wall and releases bursts of up to 1.5 kW into the magnetron during defrost.

new_nodes.label: Delivers peak power above mains rating
new_nodes.detail: Stored energy lets the magnetron run at high power briefly, speeding the thaw without a larger outlet.

new_nodes.label: Supercapacitor energy storage
new_nodes.detail: High-cycle electrochemical capacitors buffer energy between mains and load.

ideas.rationale: Buffering mains energy in supercapacitors lets the magnetron burst to high power during defrost, so a frozen block thaws in minutes on any standard socket.

ideas.title: RFID Thaw-Profile Packaging

new_nodes.label: Passive RFID tag printed on food packaging
new_nodes.detail: A printed tag stores the product's dielectric profile, weight, and recommended thaw curve.

new_nodes.label: Automatically sets defrost program from package
new_nodes.detail: The oven reads the tag and applies the manufacturer's thaw program, so no settings are needed.

new_nodes.label: Passive RFID (near-field, 13.56 MHz)
new_nodes.detail: Battery-free tags are read by a coil antenna in the oven door.

ideas.rationale: Reading a thaw profile from the package removes guesswork, so a busy parent gets a correctly defrosted meal in one touch.

ideas.title: Ice-Loss Sensing Thaw (no timer)

new_nodes.label: Reflected-power pickup loop
new_nodes.detail: Small coupling loop in the waveguide reads reflected RF, which shifts as frozen food changes from ice to liquid water.

new_nodes.label: Ice-to-water loss-transition sensing
new_nodes.detail: Ice absorbs little 2.45 GHz energy while thawing water absorbs strongly, changing the load the magnetron sees.

new_nodes.label: Detects thaw endpoint automatically
new_nodes.detail: Ends defrost at the ice-to-water transition so the user never has to set a time.

ideas.rationale: It stops defrost the moment food crosses from ice to water, so frozen food thaws fast without the cooked edges that a guessed timer causes.

ideas.title: Solid-State Thaw Module (no high-voltage chain for defrost)

new_nodes.label: Solid-state 2.45 GHz thaw amplifier
new_nodes.detail: GaN RF amplifier on a 24 V supply gives 100-150 W of continuously adjustable 2.45 GHz for defrost mode.

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state RF amplification
new_nodes.detail: Gallium-nitride transistors amplify a 2.45 GHz signal, with output set smoothly by gate bias instead of on/off cycling.

new_nodes.label: Delivers continuous low-power RF thaw
new_nodes.detail: Steady gentle RF input across the whole thaw, with no high-voltage rail involved.

ideas.rationale: Continuous, smoothly adjustable RF replaces on/off cycling, so frozen food thaws at a steady rate without the cooked edges that cycling causes.

ideas.title: Silicon-Carbide Thaw Plate (no turntable motor)

new_nodes.label: Silicon-carbide thaw plate
new_nodes.detail: Static lossy ceramic plate under the food absorbs stray RF, warms, and conducts heat into the frozen underside.

new_nodes.label: Lossy-ceramic susceptor heating
new_nodes.detail: Silicon carbide absorbs microwaves and converts them to heat that spreads by direct contact.

new_nodes.label: Conducts heat into frozen underside
new_nodes.detail: Adds contact heating so the bottom of the block thaws alongside the RF-heated surface.

ideas.rationale: A motorless plate that heats from below as well as absorbing microwaves thaws the cold underside of frozen blocks that rotation alone leaves frozen.

ideas.title: Waste-Heat Convective Thaw (cooling exhaust does the work)

new_nodes.label: Warm-air thaw duct
new_nodes.detail: Sheet-steel duct routes the magnetron fan's exhaust into a slow 50 °C air loop around the food during defrost.

new_nodes.label: Magnetron waste-heat recovery
new_nodes.detail: Recovers the several hundred watts the magnetron dissipates as heat and reuses it as warm air.

new_nodes.label: Warms air for convective thaw
new_nodes.detail: Gentle warm-air bath thaws food surfaces and edges while the RF is off.

ideas.rationale: It thaws the outer layers of frozen food with heat the magnetron would otherwise vent, giving defrost a free boost while the RF is off.

ideas.title: Thaw-Tag Packaging (the package tells the oven what to do)

new_nodes.label: Thaw reader coil
new_nodes.detail: Coil under the cavity floor reads a passive tag on the frozen package and sets time and power from it.

new_nodes.label: Printed thaw tag
new_nodes.detail: Passive printed RFID/NFC tag on frozen packs encodes weight and a thaw profile for pennies.

new_nodes.label: Passive RFID backscatter
new_nodes.detail: Tag harvests power from the reader field and replies by load modulation, needing no battery.

new_nodes.label: Reads thaw profile from package
new_nodes.detail: Sets the thaw program automatically from the food label, with no knobs needed.

ideas.rationale: A tag on each frozen pack sets the correct defrost program automatically, so the user just loads the food and the oven thaws it at the right power and time.

ideas.title: Flip-to-Start Sand Glass

new_nodes.label: Sand-glass cooking timer
new_nodes.detail: Sealed hourglass in a cradle on the front panel; flipping it starts cooking and the draining sand shows time left, sized for a typical 3-minute reheat.

new_nodes.label: Tilt-sensing flip switch
new_nodes.detail: A small tilt switch in the cradle detects the flip and closes the start circuit, with no motor or cam needed.

new_nodes.label: Sand-empty optical sensor
new_nodes.detail: A light-gap sensor at the glass neck detects the last grains and signals the end of cooking.

new_nodes.label: Shows remaining time as draining sand
new_nodes.detail: Replaces the numeric countdown with a physical gauge that needs no reading.

ideas.rationale: Flipping an hourglass is a gesture everyone already knows, and watching the sand drain shows exactly how much time is left with no digits, dials or numbers to learn.

ideas.title: Door-Pop Done Signal

new_nodes.label: Door-pop spring latch
new_nodes.detail: A pre-tensioned spring behind the latch pushes the door 2-3 cm ajar when released, so the door itself announces that cooking has ended.

new_nodes.label: Cook-end release solenoid
new_nodes.detail: A small solenoid switched by the end-of-cycle circuit pulls the latch to release the spring.

new_nodes.label: Stored-spring mechanical release
new_nodes.detail: Compressed spring energy opens the door with no electronics and no sound.

new_nodes.label: Steam burst when door pops
new_nodes.detail: Hot steam vented at pop-open can scald a face or hands if the user is leaning in.

ideas.rationale: A door that springs open by itself needs no sound or reading to understand, so 'done' becomes a physical event that anyone, including people who cannot hear or see the display, can notice.

ideas.title: Drawer That Starts On Close

new_nodes.label: Front sliding drawer
new_nodes.detail: A cavity drawer on rails with a handle; pulling it out opens the oven and pushing it shut is the only action needed to cook.

new_nodes.label: Magnetic detent with drawer-closed switch
new_nodes.detail: Magnets hold the drawer shut and a closed-position switch starts the magnetron after the interlock check.

new_nodes.label: Starts cooking when drawer closes
new_nodes.detail: Closing the drawer is the start command, so no start key has to be found or learned.

new_nodes.label: Accidental start with drawer half-closed
new_nodes.detail: A drawer left partly shut may trigger the switch and start cooking unintentionally.

ideas.rationale: Pushing a drawer in and pulling it out are motions every person already makes, so the microwave needs no button to find, no start key to learn and no door to figure out.

ideas.title: Tag-Set Power Reader

new_nodes.label: Food-package RFID tag
new_nodes.detail: A printed NFC label on ready meals, butter and milk cartons that carries the heating power and time as data.

new_nodes.label: Cavity RFID reader pad
new_nodes.detail: A small reader antenna behind the cavity wall that reads any tagged package placed inside.

new_nodes.label: Passive 13.56 MHz NFC reading
new_nodes.detail: The tag is powered by the reader's field and needs no battery, so tags cost pennies and need no maintenance.

new_nodes.label: Sets power and time automatically from packaging
new_nodes.detail: Replaces the power and time dials with the settings the food maker printed.

new_nodes.label: Untagged homemade food gets no settings
new_nodes.detail: Home-cooked and loose food has no tag, so a plain single-start fallback is still needed.

new_edges.to: Sets power and time automatically from packaging

new_edges.from: Sets power and time automatically from packaging
Sets power and time automatically from packaging

new_edges.to: Untagged homemade food gets no settings

ideas.rationale: Placing a packaged meal in the microwave sets its own power and time, so the user never has to know what 'level 3' or 'two minutes' means.

ideas.title: One-Touch Auto-Stop Sensing

new_nodes.label: One-touch heat pad
new_nodes.detail: A single large soft-touch pad replacing the fascia's dials and buttons; one press starts cooking.

new_nodes.label: Turntable load cell
new_nodes.detail: A strain-gauge cell under the roller ring weighs the food to estimate quantity and set the starting power.

new_nodes.label: Cavity IR thermopile
new_nodes.detail: A non-contact infrared sensor on the cavity roof reads food surface temperature and stops heating when the target is reached.

new_nodes.label: Closed-loop weighing and IR sensing
new_nodes.detail: Sensor data drive power and stop decisions in real time, replacing open-loop timing.

new_nodes.label: Auto-stops when food is ready
new_nodes.detail: Ends cooking from the sensed food state, so no timer or power setting is needed.

new_nodes.label: Foil and metal fool the sensors
new_nodes.detail: Metal and foil give wrong IR and weight readings, so the pad must refuse them safely.

new_edges.to: Foil and metal fool the sensors

ideas.rationale: A single touch with no dials, numbers or timing decisions lets the machine work out how long and how hot the food needs, so the user cannot set it wrong.

ideas.title: Electric-Field Thaw Plates

new_nodes.label: 27.12 MHz capacitive RF heating (electric-field dielectric loss)
new_nodes.detail: An ISM-band RF field between two plates heats frozen blocks volumetrically and penetrates far deeper than 2.45 GHz.

new_nodes.label: Solid-state 27 MHz RF generator
new_nodes.detail: A low-cost MOSFET oscillator replaces the magnetron tube and its high-voltage feed.

new_nodes.label: Parallel-plate RF electrode pair
new_nodes.detail: Two stamped steel shelves replace the waveguide duct and mica cover and form the field-applying capacitor.

new_nodes.label: Volumetric thawing of ice blocks throughout their thickness
new_nodes.detail: Defrost energy reaches the centre of thick frozen blocks at the same time as the surface.

new_edges.to: 27.12 MHz capacitive RF heating (electric-field dielectric loss)
Volumetric thawing of ice blocks throughout their thickness

new_edges.from: Volumetric thawing of ice blocks throughout their thickness
Volumetric thawing of ice blocks throughout their thickness

ideas.rationale: Swapping 2.45 GHz microwaves for 27 MHz electric fields thaws thick frozen blocks throughout their volume, removing the cold-centre wait that slows microwave defrosting.

ideas.title: Food-Sensing Melt Governor

new_nodes.label: Reflected-power load sensing via directional coupling
new_nodes.detail: Ice and liquid water load the magnetron differently, so a cheap diode tap on the waveguide reveals the melt transition.

new_nodes.label: Closed-loop melt governor
new_nodes.detail: A microcontroller and diode detector replace the 5-step cam switch and set duty cycle from live load feedback.

new_nodes.label: Detects ice-to-water transition and throttles power automatically
new_nodes.detail: Power drops the moment meltwater appears, before the edges start to cook.

new_edges.to: Reflected-power load sensing via directional coupling
Detects ice-to-water transition and throttles power automatically

new_edges.from: Detects ice-to-water transition and throttles power automatically
Detects ice-to-water transition and throttles power automatically

ideas.rationale: Instead of guessing thaw times with a fixed cam, a load-sensing loop detects when ice turns to water and cuts power, so the core thaws quickly without cooking the edges.

ideas.title: Mode Stirrer Instead of Turntable

new_nodes.label: Mode stirring with rotating conductive paddle
new_nodes.detail: A moving metal vane continuously reshapes the cavity's standing-wave pattern, averaging out hot and cold spots.

new_nodes.label: Rotating steel mode stirrer
new_nodes.detail: A stamped steel fan blade above the food replaces the glass turntable, roller ring and coupler, and is driven by the existing motor.

new_nodes.label: Spreads defrost energy over the whole load without moving the food
new_nodes.detail: Frozen blocks receive the field from many directions at once, so cold spots disappear.

new_edges.to: Mode stirring with rotating conductive paddle
Spreads defrost energy over the whole load without moving the food

new_edges.from: Spreads defrost energy over the whole load without moving the food
Spreads defrost energy over the whole load without moving the food

ideas.rationale: Keeping the food still while a metal stirrer reshapes the field lets frozen blocks absorb energy evenly, cutting the cold-spot re-heating that slows defrosting, at a fraction of the turntable's cost.

ideas.title: Solid-State Continuous Thaw

new_nodes.label: Solid-state RF amplification on a low-voltage DC bus (GaN/LDMOS)
new_nodes.detail: Semiconductor transistors amplify 2.45 GHz RF from a 48 V rail, with no high-voltage transformer, capacitor or diode.

new_nodes.label: Solid-state 2.45 GHz RF amplifier module
new_nodes.detail: A transistor stage with a patch feed into the existing waveguide replaces the magnetron and the entire HV chain.

new_nodes.label: Continuous variable-power thaw with no on/off cycling
new_nodes.detail: Power becomes a smooth dial, so defrost runs at a steady gentle rate instead of in bursts.

new_edges.to: Solid-state RF amplification on a low-voltage DC bus (GaN/LDMOS)
Continuous variable-power thaw with no on/off cycling

new_edges.from: Continuous variable-power thaw with no on/off cycling
Continuous variable-power thaw with no on/off cycling

ideas.rationale: Continuous solid-state power lets defrost run at a steady, gentle rate that thaws the core evenly instead of surface-cooking during on-bursts.

ideas.title: Self-Heating Core Spike

new_nodes.label: Microwave-absorbing thaw spike
new_nodes.detail: A ferrite- or SiC-loaded, food-safe polymer spike pushed into a frozen block heats itself in the field and conducts heat into the core.

new_nodes.label: Embedded lossy-solid heating (inside-out conduction)
new_nodes.detail: A lossy solid absorbs microwaves and releases heat from within the frozen mass instead of waiting for surface conduction.

new_nodes.label: Delivers heat to the frozen core from the inside out
new_nodes.detail: Bypasses the slow surface-to-core conduction that is the main delay in thawing large blocks.

new_edges.to: Delivers heat to the frozen core from the inside out

new_edges.from: Delivers heat to the frozen core from the inside out
Delivers heat to the frozen core from the inside out

ideas.rationale: A self-heating spike drives heat into the frozen core from inside the block, so the centre thaws alongside the surface and the whole defrost finishes sooner.

ideas.title: Solid-State GaN Melt Source

new_nodes.label: GaN HEMT solid-state 2.45 GHz amplifier
new_nodes.detail: Transistor RF amplifier driven from low-voltage DC, with no vacuum tube and no kV supply.

new_nodes.label: GaN amplifier module array (8 x 50 W)
new_nodes.detail: Replaces the magnetron, HV transformer, capacitor and diode stack with low-voltage modules on one board.

new_nodes.label: Continuous linear power control
new_nodes.detail: Output is set by drive level rather than duty cycling, so butter melts at a steady 10-30 W.

ideas.title: Electronic Hot-Spot Sweep

new_nodes.label: Electronically phased antenna array
new_nodes.detail: Multiple RF feeds with controlled phase shift steer the field maximum around the cavity with no moving parts.

new_nodes.label: Phased feed-horn array (4 flush wall antennas)

new_nodes.label: Electronic hot-spot sweep
new_nodes.detail: Moves the heating hot spot 1-10 times per second, flattening standing waves for an even butter melt.

ideas.title: Melt-to-State Thermal Hold

new_nodes.label: Downward IR thermopile array (8x8)
new_nodes.detail: A few-dollar sensor reads the butter surface temperature every second and feeds the controller.

new_nodes.label: Thermopile IR sensing with PID control
new_nodes.detail: Closed-loop control of RF output driven by measured surface temperature.

new_nodes.label: Target-state hold control
new_nodes.detail: The user picks a state such as soft or fully melted, and the oven holds it with no timer or 5-step cam.

new_edges.to: Thermopile IR sensing with PID control

ideas.title: Susceptor Browning Plate

new_nodes.label: SiC ceramic microwave susceptor
new_nodes.detail: Silicon-carbide ceramic absorbs microwaves and re-radiates heat into the food's underside.

new_nodes.label: SiC susceptor baking plate

new_nodes.label: Radiant base browning
new_nodes.detail: Adds radiant heat from below to create the crust that microwaves cannot make alone.

ideas.title: Tap-to-Cook Food Tags

new_nodes.label: Passive food-pack tag
new_nodes.detail: Aluminium-free printed coil on each ready meal or food pack, encoding its time and power profile; no battery.

new_nodes.label: Tap pad on fascia
new_nodes.detail: Flat reader behind the front panel; the user taps the pack to it before loading the cavity.

new_nodes.label: Just-Heat key
new_nodes.detail: Single unlabelled key for home-cooked food that heats at one fixed profile.

new_nodes.label: Passive 13.56 MHz inductive coupling
new_nodes.detail: Reader field powers the tag and reads its stored program over a few centimetres.

new_nodes.label: Near-field RFID and NFC
new_nodes.detail: Short-range inductive data links used by contactless tags.

new_nodes.label: Reads cooking program from pack
new_nodes.detail: Sets duration and power automatically, so no timer or power level is chosen by hand.

new_nodes.label: Untagged home-cooked food
new_nodes.detail: Food without a tag has no program and needs the fallback key.

ideas.rationale: The food pack carries its own program, so the user only taps and loads and never has to read, learn, or set a timer or power level.

ideas.title: Thermal-Eye Auto-Stop

new_nodes.label: Thermopile IR sensor
new_nodes.detail: Low-cost infrared sensor in a shielded door-frame port, reading food surface temperature through the mesh window.

new_nodes.label: Infrared thermography
new_nodes.detail: Blackbody emission from food read as temperature without contact or RF exposure.

new_nodes.label: Stops heating at target food temperature
new_nodes.detail: Closed-loop cut-off replaces guessing minutes on a dial.

new_nodes.detail: Microencapsulated dye changes colour at a fixed temperature with no power, no bulb and no wiring.

new_nodes.label: Shows food-temperature state as a colour readable through the mesh

new_nodes.detail: A sub-dollar microphone behind a sub-wavelength grille listens to sizzle, bubbling and popping inside the cavity.

new_nodes.label: Acoustic doneness classification

new_nodes.label: Piezo buzzer with synthesized voice prompt
new_nodes.detail: A solid-state piezo replaces the spring-hammer bell and can say 'ready' for low-vision users.

new_nodes.label: Detects food state from sound signature

ideas.title: Pop-Up Doneness Pin: a wax plunger that tells you when it's done

new_nodes.label: Wax-release doneness pin
new_nodes.detail: A microwave-transparent polymer pin with a paraffin plug and spring-loaded plunger; the plug melts near 70 °C and the plunger pops up, with no power needed.

new_nodes.label: Paraffin phase-change thermal actuation
new_nodes.detail: The solid-to-liquid volume change of wax releases a spring with no electronics, and the pin works in conventional ovens too.

new_nodes.label: Gives tactile and visual end-of-cook signal from food temperature
new_nodes.detail: The pin's physical rise can be felt or seen, and it reports the food's own interior temperature rather than elapsed time.

new_nodes.detail: Three strain-gauge pads under the turntable replace the plain roller-ring bearing and read total mass in real time.

new_nodes.label: Strain-gauge weighing bridge
new_nodes.detail: Wheatstone-bridge strain gauges convert small load changes into a digital mass reading at a few cents per gauge.

new_nodes.label: Tracks evaporative mass loss as a doneness proxy
new_nodes.detail: Moisture leaving the food as steam is tracked, and the cook ends at a target percentage loss rather than a guessed time.

new_nodes.detail: Transistor amplifiers generate 2.45 GHz RF directly from low-voltage DC, with no vacuum tube, cathode or kV rail.

new_nodes.label: Modular GaN RF amplifier tiles (8 x 90 W)
new_nodes.detail: Identical low-cost tiles on the cavity wall replace the single magnetron, HV transformer, capacitor and diode.

new_nodes.label: Low-voltage 48 V switch-mode power supply
new_nodes.detail: A compact resonant SMPS replaces the copper-heavy transformer and voltage-doubler stack.

new_nodes.label: Instant-on continuous power ramp
new_nodes.detail: Full RF output within milliseconds with fine power steps, with no magnetron warm-up and no duty-cycle cam.

ideas.title: Self-sensing auto-stop replaces timer and power knobs

new_nodes.label: Microwave reflectometry dielectric load sensing
new_nodes.detail: The ratio of forward to reflected RF power changes with food permittivity, revealing mass, moisture and temperature without a probe.

new_nodes.label: Directional-coupler sensor and MCU on the RF feed
new_nodes.detail: A printed coupler plus microcontroller replaces the clockwork timer, the 5-step cam knob and the bell.

new_nodes.label: Auto-terminates heating at target temperature
new_nodes.detail: Each cycle stops at the measured end point, so there is no guessing, no restarting and no scorched edges.

ideas.title: Electronic field stirring replaces the turntable motor and roller ring

new_nodes.label: Phased-array RF beam steering
new_nodes.detail: The relative phase and amplitude of coherent feeds set a moving standing-wave pattern in software.

new_nodes.label: Coherent multi-feed solid-state array
new_nodes.detail: Several phase-locked solid-state feeds on the cavity wall. Free-running magnetrons cannot be phase-steered, so this array is the enabler.

new_nodes.label: Electronic field stirring across the full cavity
new_nodes.detail: Hot and cold spots shift in software, so there is no rotation delay, no dead zone and no roller wear.

ideas.title: Crisp-plate susceptor replaces the glass turntable tray

new_nodes.label: Carbon-loaded ceramic susceptor heating
new_nodes.detail: A lossy ceramic absorbs microwaves, reaches 200 C or more within minutes and conducts heat into the food base.

new_nodes.label: Flat carbon-loaded ceramic susceptor plate
new_nodes.detail: One static, dishwasher-safe plate replaces the glass tray and adds browning and crisping in the same cycle.

new_nodes.label: Same-cycle browning and crisping
new_nodes.detail: Pizza, fries and pastry get a finished surface without a second toaster or oven step.

ideas.rationale: Crisping in the same cycle restores a reheated slice rather than leaving it soggy, so a busy user needs no second appliance or second step.

ideas.title: Shallow single-plate cavity replaces the 20 L box

new_nodes.label: Shallow stamped-steel reflector cavity (~4 L)
new_nodes.detail: A flat cavity stamped from sheet steel, sized to a few wavelengths, replaces the deep 20 L enamelled box and fits a drawer or under-cabinet space.

new_nodes.label: Single-portion field concentration
new_nodes.detail: The field is concentrated on one plate instead of spread through a large box, so one serving reaches temperature in less time.

ideas.rationale: A cavity sized to one plate concentrates the same magnetron power on the meal and fits the desk or dorm of the student and office worker, so a single portion reaches serving heat sooner.

ideas.title: Solid-State 27 MHz Electrode Thaw

new_nodes.label: Solid-state LDMOS/GaN RF amplification at 27.12 MHz
new_nodes.detail: Low-voltage (about 50 V DC) transistor amplifier in the ISM band, with no cathode and no HV chain.

new_nodes.label: Quasi-static parallel-plate capacitive RF heating
new_nodes.detail: Food forms the dielectric between two plates, and the field penetrates tens of cm into frozen blocks.

new_nodes.label: 27 MHz RF amplifier module
new_nodes.detail: Compact solid-state module replaces the magnetron, HV transformer, capacitor and diode.

new_nodes.label: Dual RF electrode plates
new_nodes.detail: Stamped steel shelf plates replace the waveguide duct and mica cover.

new_nodes.label: Volumetric deep RF thaw of frozen blocks
new_nodes.detail: Heats the whole block through its thickness, removing standing-wave hot and cold spots.

new_edges.to: Solid-state LDMOS/GaN RF amplification at 27.12 MHz
Volumetric deep RF thaw of frozen blocks
Volumetric deep RF thaw of frozen blocks

new_edges.from: Volumetric deep RF thaw of frozen blocks
Volumetric deep RF thaw of frozen blocks

ideas.rationale: A low-frequency solid-state RF field penetrates thick frozen blocks volumetrically and evenly, aiming for a faster and safer thaw than surface-limited 2.45 GHz duty-cycling while removing the HV chain and waveguide.

ideas.title: Curie-Point Self-Limiting Thaw Plate

new_nodes.label: Curie-point self-limiting magnetic-loss susceptor
new_nodes.detail: Ferrite alloy absorbs microwaves until its Curie point, then self-limits near 50 deg C.

new_nodes.label: Curie-point thaw plate
new_nodes.detail: Dishwasher-safe metal plate replaces the glass turntable and conducts heat up into the frozen block.

new_nodes.label: Self-limiting conductive thaw from below
new_nodes.detail: Contact heat thaws the underside while the plate ceiling prevents cooked or runaway edges.

ideas.rationale: A self-limiting Curie-point plate conducts heat up into the frozen block, speeding the thaw without hot spots, cooked edges, or any turntable motor or roller ring.

ideas.title: Load-Sensing Adaptive Thaw Controller

new_nodes.label: Magnetron load-sense controller
new_nodes.detail: Small board reads the magnetron's existing anode-current and reflected-power signals, with no extra sensor.

new_nodes.label: Load-impedance sensing of ice-to-water state
new_nodes.detail: Thawed water loads the cavity differently from ice, shifting operating current and reflected power.

new_nodes.label: Auto-sets duty cycle from real-time thaw state
new_nodes.detail: Raises power while ice remains and cuts back as soon as liquid patches appear.

new_edges.to: Auto-sets duty cycle from real-time thaw state

new_edges.from: Auto-sets duty cycle from real-time thaw state
Auto-sets duty cycle from real-time thaw state

ideas.rationale: Reading the magnetron's own load signal lets the appliance push power while ice remains and back off the moment liquid appears, so frozen food thaws as fast as is safe without the user guessing a setting.

ideas.title: Steam Latent-Heat Thaw Cartridge

new_nodes.label: Resistive steam generator cartridge
new_nodes.detail: Sealed water cartridge with a cheap resistive heater, replacing the magnetron as the heat source.

new_nodes.label: Steam-condensation latent-heat transfer
new_nodes.detail: Steam condensing on frozen surfaces releases about 2260 kJ/kg of latent heat.

new_nodes.label: Latent-heat thaw by steam condensation
new_nodes.detail: Condensing steam wets and heats every exposed face of the frozen food at once.

new_nodes.label: Perforated steam manifold
new_nodes.detail: Stamped steel manifold distributes steam around the cavity, replacing the waveguide duct.

ideas.rationale: Condensing steam releases latent heat across every exposed face of frozen food, aiming for a faster thaw than dry heat while swapping the magnetron for a cheap resistive heater.

ideas.title: Piezo Acoustic Core Thaw

new_nodes.label: Piezoelectric ultrasonic transduction at 20-40 kHz
new_nodes.detail: Piezo ceramics turn a low-voltage drive into acoustic waves that heat frozen cores through internal losses.

new_nodes.label: Piezo ultrasonic transducer array
new_nodes.detail: Low-cost piezo discs bonded to the cavity floor replace the magnetron and its antenna.

new_nodes.label: Acoustic volumetric thaw of frozen cores
new_nodes.detail: Sound energy penetrates the frozen mass from inside, with no microwave field to leak or arc.

new_edges.to: Acoustic volumetric thaw of frozen cores

new_edges.from: Acoustic volumetric thaw of frozen cores
Acoustic volumetric thaw of frozen cores

ideas.rationale: Acoustic energy heats frozen food from the inside using low-voltage piezo elements, aiming for a quick thaw of cores with no magnetron, HV chain, or RF arcing risk.

ideas.title: Steam Sniffer Doneness

new_nodes.label: Metal-oxide humidity and aroma sensing
new_nodes.detail: Cheap resistive MOX sensor reads exhaust moisture and volatile aroma; a rise-then-plateau curve marks doneness.

new_nodes.label: Exhaust humidity-aroma sensor
new_nodes.detail: Sensor sits in the vent louvre airflow (C27) and replaces the timer cam, with a lower BOM cost than a cam switch.

new_nodes.label: Detects doneness from exhaust moisture and aroma
new_nodes.detail: Closed-loop end-point detection that replaces counting minutes.

new_edges.to: Detects doneness from exhaust moisture and aroma

new_edges.from: Detects doneness from exhaust moisture and aroma
Detects doneness from exhaust moisture and aroma

ideas.rationale: The microwave sniffs the steam leaving the food, so it knows when the food is ready and rings the bell at that moment instead of after a guessed number of minutes.

ideas.title: Reflected-Power Echo Doneness

new_nodes.label: Directional-coupler reflected-power sensing
new_nodes.detail: A printed coupler taps a fraction of forward and reflected RF in the waveguide; the ratio shifts as food dielectric properties change.

new_nodes.label: Waveguide reflectometer tap
new_nodes.detail: Coupler plus Schottky detector diode on waveguide duct C5, costing cents and needing no contact with the food.

new_nodes.label: Infers food dielectric state from reflected RF power
new_nodes.detail: Reads how much energy the food absorbs versus reflects, tracking drying and cooking progress.

new_edges.to: Infers food dielectric state from reflected RF power

new_edges.from: Infers food dielectric state from reflected RF power
Infers food dielectric state from reflected RF power

ideas.rationale: The food talks back to the magnetron: as its moisture and temperature change, the RF energy bouncing back changes too, so the microwave can announce doneness without any sensor touching the food.

ideas.title: Sizzle Listener and Piezo Chime

new_nodes.label: MEMS audio with on-board pattern recognition
new_nodes.detail: Low-power microphone and tiny DSP classify popping, bubbling and the fade of sizzle.

new_nodes.label: Cavity MEMS microphone
new_nodes.detail: A low-cost microphone on the cavity ceiling hears the sound profile of food reaching done; the fan pauses briefly to listen.

new_nodes.label: Detects doneness from cooking sounds
new_nodes.detail: Acoustic end-point detection that works regardless of cooking duration.

new_nodes.label: Piezo chime beeper
new_nodes.detail: Solid-state piezo replaces the spring-hammer bell and plays a distinct done-tone pattern.

new_edges.to: MEMS audio with on-board pattern recognition

new_edges.from: MEMS audio with on-board pattern recognition

ideas.rationale: Food announces its own doneness through sound, so the microwave listens for that moment and then chimes, giving a signal matched to the food rather than to the clock.

ideas.title: Weigh-to-Done Roller Ring

new_nodes.label: Strain-gauge weighing bridge
new_nodes.detail: Bonded strain gauges in a Wheatstone bridge sense load changes to about half a gram.

new_nodes.label: Load-sensing roller ring
new_nodes.detail: Roller ring C11 carries strain gauges under the turntable, so tray plus food mass is tracked continuously while it still supports rotation.

new_nodes.label: Tracks food moisture loss by weight
new_nodes.detail: Cooking ends at a target percentage of water lost rather than at a fixed time.

new_edges.to: Tracks food moisture loss by weight

new_edges.from: Tracks food moisture loss by weight
Tracks food moisture loss by weight

ideas.rationale: Water leaving the food is weight leaving the food, so the turntable itself reports how far cooking has progressed and rings when the target moisture loss is reached.

new_nodes.label: Passive thermopile infrared sensing

ideas.title: Ears, Not Clock

new_nodes.label: MEMS microphone + doneness classifier chip
new_nodes.detail: A sub-dollar mic and microcontroller listen for popcorn pops slowing, sizzle fading or boil onset, replacing the clockwork.

new_nodes.label: Infers food doneness from cooking sound
new_nodes.detail: Closes the loop by sensing the food's own audio cues instead of counting down a fixed time.

new_nodes.label: On-device sound-pattern classification
new_nodes.detail: Spectral features and a tiny model run locally, with no network or cloud needed.

new_edges.to: Infers food doneness from cooking sound

new_edges.from: Infers food doneness from cooking sound
Infers food doneness from cooking sound
Infers food doneness from cooking sound

ideas.rationale: Listening to the food's own pops, sizzles and bubbles replaces a guessed countdown with a closed-loop readiness cue, which is exactly what M8 asks for.

ideas.title: Door Pops Itself Open

new_nodes.label: Spring-loaded door ajar latch
new_nodes.detail: A cam-released spring nudges the door open a few centimetres when the cycle ends; it opens only after the magnetron has shut off, so the interlock logic is unchanged.

new_nodes.label: Signals end by physically opening the door gap
new_nodes.detail: A tactile and visual cue that cannot be silenced and is noticed across a kitchen.

new_nodes.label: Cam-triggered spring release
new_nodes.detail: Reuses the timer cam's existing trip action to fire a spring, with no striker, speaker or metal bell.

new_edges.to: Signals end by physically opening the door gap

new_edges.from: Signals end by physically opening the door gap
Signals end by physically opening the door gap

ideas.rationale: A door that physically springs ajar when the food is ready is a feedback channel the user cannot mute or miss, so the end-of-cycle signal reaches people who are not listening.

ideas.title: Lamp-Less Readiness Ring

new_nodes.label: Single-pixel IR thermopile behind sealed port
new_nodes.detail: A few-dollar thermopile behind a tiny IR-transparent port reads the surface temperature of the food facing it.

new_nodes.label: LED readiness ring on door frame
new_nodes.detail: A solid-state ring outside the cavity glows blue (cold), amber (heating) or green (ready), with no bulb to burn out.

new_nodes.label: Reads food surface temperature without contact
new_nodes.detail: Passive infrared sensing gives the machine the readiness signal it lacks today.

new_nodes.label: Shows food temperature state as colour
new_nodes.detail: Converts the sensed temperature into a glance-readable state visible from across the room.

new_nodes.label: Thermopile infrared sensing
new_nodes.detail: Detects blackbody emission; it is passive and non-contact, so it adds no RF or radiation hazard.

new_nodes.label: Solid-state LED outside the cavity
new_nodes.detail: The light source moves out of the microwave field, and LEDs last far longer than a 20-25 W filament.

ideas.title: Fog-to-Clear Door Glass

new_nodes.label: Humidity-responsive fog-to-clear door glass
new_nodes.detail: A hydrochromic film behind the existing mesh turns opaque while steaming and clears as steam tails off; the mesh still provides the shielding.

new_nodes.label: Shows steam activity as a visible readiness cue
new_nodes.detail: The window itself becomes a steam gauge, and the user reads clear as steaming has stopped.

new_nodes.label: Hydrochromic polymer film
new_nodes.detail: A humidity-driven opacity switch that is passive, needs no electronics and is transparent to microwaves.

new_edges.to: Shows steam activity as a visible readiness cue

new_edges.from: Shows steam activity as a visible readiness cue
Shows steam activity as a visible readiness cue

ideas.rationale: Turning the door window into a steam gauge gives an always-on, power-free readiness cue the user can read at a glance, needing no sensor and only the interpretation that clear means steaming has stopped.

ideas.title: Plate That Gets Lighter

new_nodes.label: Load-cell glass turntable
new_nodes.detail: Three strain-gauge cells under the glass platter read mass, and cooking ends when a set fraction of the food's water weight has left.

new_nodes.label: Infers doneness from moisture-driven mass loss
new_nodes.detail: Mass lost as water evaporates tracks real cooking progress rather than elapsed time; it works best for foods that lose water, such as reheated, baked or popped foods.

new_nodes.label: Strain-gauge weighing
new_nodes.detail: Sub-dollar load cells and a small ADC, with readout via a slip ring or the drive hub's bearing.

new_edges.to: Infers doneness from moisture-driven mass loss

new_edges.from: Infers doneness from moisture-driven mass loss
Infers doneness from moisture-driven mass loss

ideas.rationale: Weighing the plate turns a fixed clock into a measure of actual moisture loss, so cooking ends when the food has really progressed, which serves M8 better than elapsed time.

ideas.title: Solid-state GaN RF source replaces the magnetron

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state 2.45 GHz amplifier array
new_nodes.detail: Dozens of low-power GaN transistor cells on one board, combined into the waveguide and fed from a 48 V DC rail.

new_nodes.label: GaN HEMT RF power amplification
new_nodes.detail: Wide-bandgap transistors amplify 2.45 GHz directly, efficient at partial power with no cathode to heat or wear out.

new_nodes.label: Instant-on RF with zero idle loss
new_nodes.detail: RF is produced only when commanded and at the power the load needs, with no warm-up or standby heating of a cathode.

new_edges.to: Instant-on RF with zero idle loss

new_edges.from: Instant-on RF with zero idle loss

ideas.rationale: Solid-state amplifiers convert mains power to RF with less loss than a 4 kV high-voltage chain plus magnetron and draw almost nothing while idle, directly cutting the energy wasted per cook.

ideas.title: Load-matched cavity with sliding RF-choke bulkheads

new_nodes.label: Sliding conductive bulkhead set
new_nodes.detail: Two motor-driven metal panels that slide to fit the cavity around the load, shrinking the resonant volume to the food.

new_nodes.label: Quarter-wave choke seal on sliding joints
new_nodes.detail: Choke grooves at the panel edges keep RF inside while the walls move, with no contact arcing.

new_nodes.label: Load-sized resonant containment
new_nodes.detail: Keeps microwaves confined to a resonant volume matched to the food, giving higher field density on small loads.

new_edges.to: Quarter-wave choke seal on sliding joints

new_edges.from: Quarter-wave choke seal on sliding joints
Quarter-wave choke seal on sliding joints

ideas.rationale: Matching the resonant volume to the load raises field density where the food sits, so small meals heat in less time and the magnetron runs for fewer seconds per cook.

ideas.title: Energy-dose cooking replaces the timer knob and power cam

new_nodes.label: Energy-dose controller
new_nodes.detail: Microcontroller integrates net RF power over time and stops at the energy the food needs, based on mass and start temperature.

new_nodes.label: Thermopile and humidity doneness sensor
new_nodes.detail: Infrared array and humidity sensor track surface temperature and steam release to confirm doneness.

new_nodes.label: Directional-coupler RF power metering
new_nodes.detail: Forward and reflected power sampled at the waveguide give exact delivered energy and flag mismatch losses.

new_nodes.label: Heat to a target energy dose
new_nodes.detail: Stops RF when the food has absorbed the energy it needs, instead of after a fixed clock time or duty-cycle step.

new_edges.to: Heat to a target energy dose

new_edges.from: Heat to a target energy dose

ideas.rationale: Ending heat at the energy the food actually absorbs removes the overshoot and reheating that fixed timers waste, so each cook uses only the energy it needs.

ideas.title: Thermoelectric exhaust harvester drives the turntable

new_nodes.label: Thermoelectric generator ring in vent louvre
new_nodes.detail: Bismuth telluride modules clamped between the hot exhaust duct and a finned cold plate, generating 1-3 W from vented heat.

new_nodes.label: Waste-heat-powered turntable drive
new_nodes.detail: Low-torque permanent-magnet drive running at 5 rpm on harvested DC, replacing the mains-fed motor.

new_nodes.label: Seebeck thermoelectric conversion
new_nodes.detail: A temperature difference across semiconductor legs drives charge carriers, converting exhaust heat to DC with no moving parts.

new_nodes.label: Turns vent heat into drive power
new_nodes.detail: Recovers heat the vent already releases and converts it into electricity for mechanical work.

new_edges.from: Thermoelectric generator ring in vent louvre
Thermoelectric generator ring in vent louvre
new_edges.to: Turns vent heat into drive power

new_edges.from: Thermoelectric generator ring in vent louvre
Turns vent heat into drive power

ideas.rationale: Powering the turntable from heat the vent already throws away turns a grid-fed motor into a recovered-energy load, so every cook reclaims some energy that would otherwise escape.

ideas.title: Battery-buffered DC bus replaces the 50 Hz HV transformer

new_nodes.label: LiFePO4 buffer pack with boost converter
new_nodes.detail: Small battery charged at a steady 200 W from the wall and discharged in 700 W bursts through a boost stage to the HV supply.

new_nodes.label: Battery-buffered DC bus with bidirectional converter
new_nodes.detail: Decouples the wall from the RF load so mains current stays flat regardless of cooking power level.

new_nodes.label: Flattens wall draw to a low average
new_nodes.detail: Holds grid draw near a constant low level, cutting peak demand and wiring losses.

new_edges.from: LiFePO4 buffer pack with boost converter
LiFePO4 buffer pack with boost converter
new_edges.to: Battery-buffered DC bus with bidirectional converter

new_edges.to: Flattens wall draw to a low average

new_edges.from: LiFePO4 buffer pack with boost converter
