ideas.title: Solid-state GaN RF engine replaces magnetron and high-voltage chain

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state 2.45 GHz power amplifier array
new_nodes.detail: Gallium-nitride transistor modules on a shared low-voltage bus generate the RF that the magnetron currently makes.

new_nodes.label: GaN HEMT RF power amplification

ideas.title: Magnetron-free 27 MHz capacitive thaw

new_nodes.label: 27.12 MHz capacitive RF thawing
new_nodes.detail: Frozen load sits between electrode plates; the roughly 11 m wavelength gives no standing-wave hot spots and deep, uniform penetration.

new_nodes.label: Solid-state 27 MHz RF generator
new_nodes.detail: A low-voltage LDMOS or GaN oscillator with a matching network replaces the magnetron, HV transformer, capacitor and diode stack.

new_nodes.label: Insulated RF electrode plate pair
new_nodes.detail: Top and bottom plates inside the cavity, with the grounded cavity walls acting as the return path.

new_nodes.label: Uniform through-thickness thawing of frozen blocks
new_nodes.detail: Capacitive RF loss heats low-loss frozen food evenly from core to surface without rotation.

new_edges.to: Uniform through-thickness thawing of frozen blocks

ideas.rationale: Capacitive 27 MHz heating thaws frozen blocks through their full thickness with no standing-wave hot spots, so the core thaws as fast as the edges.

ideas.title: Reflected-power thaw sensing with automatic shutoff

new_nodes.label: Reflected-power load-state sensing
new_nodes.detail: Frozen and thawed food absorb 2.45 GHz energy very differently, so reflected power in the waveguide shifts sharply at the thaw transition.

new_nodes.label: Directional coupler and diode power detector
new_nodes.detail: A cheap microstrip coupler on the waveguide feeds a diode detector read by a microcontroller, replacing the clockwork timer and cam.

new_nodes.label: Automatic thaw-state detection and shutoff
new_nodes.detail: Closed-loop defrost holds low power until the reflected-power knee is detected, then stops.

ideas.rationale: Sensing the thaw transition ends defrost at the right moment, removing guesswork so frozen food thaws quickly without overcooking the edges.

ideas.title: Phased-array turntable-free field steering

new_nodes.label: Phased-array RF beam steering
new_nodes.detail: Relative phase between two to four feed antennas moves the standing-wave pattern, so hot zones sweep across the load electronically.

new_nodes.label: Four-port solid-state phased feed
new_nodes.detail: Solid-state phase shifters and amplifier modules replace the 5 rpm turntable motor, roller ring and coupler.

new_nodes.label: Electronic sweep of RF hot zones
new_nodes.detail: Moves the field peak across frozen blocks with no moving parts, eliminating cold centres.

new_edges.to: Electronic sweep of RF hot zones

Electronic sweep of RF hot zones

ideas.rationale: Electronically steered hot zones sweep frozen blocks evenly without a turntable, so cold centres no longer force repeated defrost-and-check cycles.

ideas.title: Ultrasonic piezo thaw with no RF field (wild)

new_nodes.label: Ultrasonic 20-40 kHz acoustic thawing
new_nodes.detail: Piezo-driven vibration in the frozen block generates internal friction and speeds heat transfer at ice-water interfaces.

new_nodes.label: Piezo transducer plate with 24 V driver
new_nodes.detail: A cheap ceramic transducer under the food tray replaces the entire high-voltage RF power chain.

new_nodes.label: Acoustic thawing with no RF field
new_nodes.detail: Vibrational energy drives thaw without any microwave field present.

new_nodes.label: Ultrasound attenuates in ice and block-scale thaw is unproven
new_nodes.detail: Penetration and thaw time for dense frozen blocks need validation before any claim is made.

ideas.title: Magnetron waste-heat thaw plate (frozen food as heat sink)

new_nodes.label: Heat-pipe transport of magnetron waste heat
new_nodes.detail: Sealed heat pipes move the several hundred watts of waste heat from the magnetron and transformer into the cavity floor, with no fan needed.

new_nodes.label: Sintered alumina ceramic
new_nodes.detail: Low-loss ceramic that is nearly microwave-transparent and conducts heat far better than glass.

new_nodes.label: Passive heat-pipe loop to cavity floor
new_nodes.detail: A passive heat pipe replaces the cooling fan and vent louvres, and the frozen food acts as the heat sink.

new_nodes.label: Alumina ceramic turntable
new_nodes.detail: A microwave-transparent, thermally conductive plate replaces the glass turntable and carries heat into the food base.

new_nodes.label: Thawing by conduction from waste heat
new_nodes.detail: Waste heat that is normally vented is conducted into the underside of the frozen food.

new_nodes.label: Heat sink weakens as food thaws and risks magnetron overheat
new_nodes.detail: As the food warms the sink weakens, so the magnetron must be throttled by sensing or a thermistor.

Detects food state from cooking sounds

ideas.rationale: Pops and sizzles fall silent in a recognisable way as food finishes, so the oven tells the user when it is ready without anyone needing to look through the door.

ideas.title: Steam-reed whistle (bell replaced by a passive airflow whistle)

new_nodes.label: Aeroacoustics and fluid dynamics
new_nodes.detail: Sound generated by airflow over reeds and edges, with no power source.

new_nodes.label: Airflow-driven reed whistle
new_nodes.detail: A thin reed sings when vented steam exceeds a threshold velocity, like a kettle whistle without the pressure.

new_nodes.label: Steam-reed whistle in vent
new_nodes.detail: Replaces the spring-hammer bell; it sounds only when food is actually steaming.

new_nodes.label: Alerts on steaming or boiling
new_nodes.detail: Signals readiness from the food's own vapour rather than elapsed time.

ideas.rationale: The alarm is triggered by the food's vapour reaching the boiling stage rather than by a clock, so the user hears readiness as it happens.

ideas.title: Load-sense readiness (magnetron reads the food, timer retired)

new_nodes.label: Magnetron power-draw sensing
new_nodes.detail: A low-value shunt on the magnetron supply tracks how much energy the food absorbs as it changes.

new_nodes.label: Load-sense board (shunt and comparator)
new_nodes.detail: Replaces the cam timer and motor with a shunt resistor, a comparator, and a bell trigger.

new_nodes.label: Food-profile knob
new_nodes.detail: Selects a calibrated load curve per food type (reheat, popcorn, defrost) instead of minutes.

new_nodes.label: Infers readiness from RF load
new_nodes.detail: Judges doneness from the food's changing energy absorption.

ideas.rationale: The oven stops guessing minutes and reads how the food is absorbing energy, ringing the bell when the food reaches its readiness curve.

ideas.title: Progress needle on the knob (countdown numerals replaced by a steam-driven gauge)

new_nodes.label: Bimetal coil thermal indicator
new_nodes.detail: A bimetal coil in the vent winds as steam warms it, turning a needle across a cold-to-ready scale.

new_nodes.label: Knob-face progress needle
new_nodes.detail: A needle printed across the knob dial shows continuous progress toward readiness, readable at a glance.

new_nodes.label: Shows continuous progress toward readiness
new_nodes.detail: Replaces a countdown with a live fraction of the way to done.

ideas.rationale: The user sees how far along the food is at a glance, so they can judge doneness and intervene instead of waiting for a single end-of-timer ding.

ideas.title: Breeze-Stirred Butter Bowl

new_nodes.label: Airflow-driven mode stirrer
new_nodes.detail: Cooling-fan exhaust spins a vane that reshuffles the standing-wave pattern, so no stirrer motor is needed.

new_nodes.label: Air-driven mode-stirrer vane
new_nodes.detail: Metal-tipped plastic-hub vane on a bearing in the cavity roof, shielded under the mica cover.

new_nodes.label: Stirs microwave field to even out butter melt
new_nodes.detail: Spreads energy across a fixed bowl so butter melts without cold spots, replacing turntable rotation.

new_edges.to: Stirs microwave field to even out butter melt

new_edges.from: Stirs microwave field to even out butter melt
Stirs microwave field to even out butter melt

ideas.rationale: Replacing the turntable motor, roller ring and glass tray with a fan-driven mode stirrer gives an evenly melted bowl of butter with no extra motor, so the M17 prep step needs no hand stirring or turning.

ideas.title: Thermal-Eye Butter Gauge

new_nodes.label: Non-contact infrared thermopile sensing
new_nodes.detail: Thermopile converts infrared emitted by the food surface into a temperature reading without touching it.

new_nodes.label: IR thermopile array sensor (8x8 MEMS)
new_nodes.detail: Low-cost thermal sensor in the cavity roof behind a small IR-transparent window; reads butter surface temperature.

new_nodes.label: Senses butter surface temperature to show melt state
new_nodes.detail: Shows soft, melting or melted on the control fascia so the user knows when to stop.

new_edges.to: Senses butter surface temperature to show melt state

new_edges.from: Senses butter surface temperature to show melt state
Senses butter surface temperature to show melt state
Senses butter surface temperature to show melt state

ideas.rationale: Replacing the burnable bulb with a thermal sensor shows the user exactly when butter has softened or melted, turning a visual guessing game into a readout for the M17 prep step.

ideas.title: Melt-to-Target Probe Dial

new_nodes.label: NTC thermistor temperature-targeting control
new_nodes.detail: A thermistor reading feeds a microcontroller that pulses RF to hold a set temperature instead of a set time.

new_nodes.label: Ceramic-tipped NTC butter probe
new_nodes.detail: Thin ceramic-tipped thermistor pushed into the butter to read its core temperature.

new_nodes.label: Microcontroller duty controller
new_nodes.detail: Single low-cost MCU with a solid-state relay replaces the cam timer, cam switches and synchronous motor.

new_nodes.label: Holds a target temperature by pulsing RF
new_nodes.detail: One target dial (for example 35 C for butter) replaces separate time and power settings.

new_edges.to: Holds a target temperature by pulsing RF

ideas.rationale: Setting a single target temperature instead of time and power gives the user butter at the exact melt point without guesswork, which simplifies the M17 prep step.

ideas.title: Solid-State Melt Pod

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state RF amplifier at 2.45 GHz
new_nodes.detail: Gallium-nitride transistors amplify a 2.45 GHz signal at low voltage, with no vacuum tube and no cavity magnetron.

new_nodes.label: Low-voltage switch-mode DC conversion
new_nodes.detail: Compact switched supply converts mains to low-voltage DC, avoiding kV AC and kV DC stages.

new_nodes.label: GaN RF power module (about 150 W)
new_nodes.detail: Solid-state 2.45 GHz source sized for melting and warming loads rather than bulk cooking.

new_nodes.label: 48 V switch-mode power supply
new_nodes.detail: Replaces the HV transformer, the 2.1 kV capacitor and the rectifier diode with one low-voltage supply.

new_nodes.label: Generates on-demand 2.45 GHz RF from low voltage
new_nodes.detail: Delivers microwave energy with no high-voltage chain and no tube wear-out.

ideas.rationale: A low-voltage solid-state source removes the lethal high-voltage chain and tube wear, giving a safer and simpler small-power melter for the butter and chocolate prep steps of M17.

ideas.title: Vapour Sniffer Doneness Sensor

new_nodes.label: Exhaust vapour sensor pair
new_nodes.detail: Two cheap sensors on the vent-louvre airflow read the steam and aroma curve; a flattening plateau marks done.

new_nodes.label: Metal-oxide and humidity sensing
new_nodes.detail: A tin-oxide film changes resistance with volatile organics; a polymer capacitor tracks humidity.

new_nodes.label: Vapour-based doneness detection
new_nodes.detail: Ends cooking from what the food is releasing, not from elapsed clock time.

ideas.rationale: It gives the user direct evidence from the food itself, the flattening vapour curve, that it is ready, replacing a guessed clock time.

ideas.title: Turntable Metronome Ding

new_nodes.label: Roller-ring knock tab
new_nodes.detail: A moulded tab on the roller ring strikes a ledge once per revolution, so the turntable ticks every 12 seconds.

new_nodes.label: Cam-shifted double-knock tab
new_nodes.detail: A timer-shaft cam swings a stiffer tab into the path at end-of-cycle, turning the tick into a double-knock.

new_nodes.label: Mechanical rhythm from existing rotation

ideas.title: Load-Tracking Cavity Glow

new_nodes.label: Electrodeless plasma glow capsule
new_nodes.detail: A sealed sulfur or noble-gas capsule on the cavity wall lights when the magnetron field excites it, with no filament, socket or wiring.

new_nodes.label: Microwave-excited plasma discharge

new_nodes.label: Shows cooking progress through glow

ideas.title: Spring-Release Pop-Up Done Pin

new_nodes.label: Spring-release food probe

new_nodes.label: Pop-up door button flag
new_nodes.detail: The released plunger drives a red tab up through the door-release button so it visibly and tactilely pops up.

new_nodes.label: Shape-memory polymer release
new_nodes.detail: A passive phase change frees stored spring energy at a set temperature, with no battery or electronics.

new_nodes.label: Physical done-signal via pop-up flag
new_nodes.detail: The food's core temperature is shown by a pop-up that can be seen and felt without a display or sound.

ideas.rationale: A passive pop-up that rises when the food's core reaches done tells the user by sight and touch, with no battery, display or bell required.

ideas.title: Waveguide Echo Readiness Sensor

new_nodes.label: Waveguide echo coupler diode
new_nodes.detail: A coupling loop and a cheap Schottky detector on the waveguide sample the reflected RF, and the echo curve flattens as the food reaches end-point.

new_nodes.label: Directional-coupler reflected-power sensing
new_nodes.detail: Magnetron load pulling and reflection shift as food dielectric loss changes with temperature and state.

new_nodes.label: Echo-based readiness detection
new_nodes.detail: The magnetron's own reflected power signals doneness, so no extra sensing cavity or display is needed.

ideas.rationale: The reflected-power curve flattens as the food reaches end-point, giving readiness information from hardware that already exists in the waveguide.

ideas.title: Instant-On Solid-State RF Engine

new_nodes.label: Semiconductor power devices (GaN HEMT)
new_nodes.detail: Wide-bandgap transistors that amplify RF at 2.45 GHz without a vacuum tube.

new_nodes.label: GaN HEMT RF power amplification at 2.45 GHz
new_nodes.detail: Solid-state amplifier chains with per-stage power control, with no cathode, filament or high voltage.

new_nodes.label: Solid-state GaN RF amplifier module
new_nodes.detail: Replaces the magnetron and reaches full 700 W output in milliseconds with no warm-up.

new_nodes.label: Millisecond power on/off and continuous power modulation
new_nodes.detail: Power is a dialled signal rather than a duty cycle, so the oven starts heating the instant the door closes.

new_nodes.label: Heatsink load of 700 W solid-state RF stage
new_nodes.detail: The amplifier transistors need a heatsink or fan at high RF output, adding bulk and noise.

new_edges.to: GaN HEMT RF power amplification at 2.45 GHz

new_edges.from: GaN HEMT RF power amplification at 2.45 GHz

new_edges.to: Millisecond power on/off and continuous power modulation

new_edges.from: Millisecond power on/off and continuous power modulation
Millisecond power on/off and continuous power modulation

new_edges.to: Heatsink load of 700 W solid-state RF stage

ideas.rationale: Removing the magnetron warm-up and on/off cycling means the oven delivers food energy from the first second, which directly shortens a busy household's reheat.

ideas.title: Inverter High-Voltage Supply Replaces the Transformer Chain

new_nodes.label: High-frequency inverter switch-mode conversion
new_nodes.detail: Chops rectified mains at tens of kHz so a small ferrite core replaces the bulky 50 Hz iron transformer.

new_nodes.label: Inverter HV supply module (universal input)
new_nodes.detail: One compact board accepting 100-240 V at 50/60 Hz and outputting regulated high voltage with no large HV capacitor.

new_nodes.label: Continuous full-power magnetron drive (no on/off cycling)
new_nodes.detail: Holds the magnetron at steady full output instead of pulsing, so each minute of set power delivers more energy.

new_edges.to: Continuous full-power magnetron drive (no on/off cycling)

new_edges.from: Continuous full-power magnetron drive (no on/off cycling)
Continuous full-power magnetron drive (no on/off cycling)

ideas.rationale: Running at steady full power instead of cycling shortens reheat time at the same wattage, and a universal-input supply keeps the oven equally fast in any mains region.

ideas.title: Electronic Beam-Steered Feeds Replace the Turntable

new_nodes.label: Multi-port phase-controlled RF feeding
new_nodes.detail: Two or more RF ports driven with programmed phase offsets that sweep the hot spot electronically.

new_nodes.label: Phased-array feed ring (fixed cavity floor)
new_nodes.detail: A flat cavity floor with four PCB antenna ports replaces the glass tray, roller ring and turntable motor.

new_nodes.label: Electronic hot-spot sweeping (no moving parts)
new_nodes.detail: Moves the standing-wave pattern across the food in software, so nothing has to rotate or be stopped and restirred.

ideas.rationale: Sweeping the hot spot electronically removes the wait for a turntable and the stop-and-stir cycles, so a whole plate heats in one pass.

ideas.title: Plate-as-Cavity: The Serving Dish Becomes the Resonator

new_nodes.label: Conductive-rim resonator (plate-scale cavity)
new_nodes.detail: A metallised dish rim forms a small resonant cavity over a flat RF launcher tuned to 2.45 GHz.

new_nodes.label: Metal-rimmed single-serve dish (resonant cavity)
new_nodes.detail: The dish is the cooking cavity, with a mica lid that couples energy in from below.

new_nodes.label: Confines 2.45 GHz energy to one serving
new_nodes.detail: Puts the full 700 W into one plate instead of heating 20 L of air and steel walls.

new_nodes.label: Rim-gap leakage risk from open dish resonator
new_nodes.detail: An exposed rim gap can leak RF unless it is interlocked to meet FCC/FDA limits.

new_edges.to: Confines 2.45 GHz energy to one serving

new_edges.from: Confines 2.45 GHz energy to one serving
Confines 2.45 GHz energy to one serving

new_edges.to: Rim-gap leakage risk from open dish resonator

new_edges.from: Rim-gap leakage risk from open dish resonator

ideas.rationale: A dish-sized resonator concentrates all the power on one serving and skips heating a 20 L box, which serves single-person households that need a quick reheat.

new_nodes.label: Passive NFC tag communication (13.56 MHz)
new_nodes.detail: A battery-free tag powered by the reader field, readable through paper and plastic packaging.

new_nodes.label: Auto-sets time, power and stir steps from package
new_nodes.detail: One tap replaces dialling, so the user never reads or adjusts a dial.

ideas.title: Solid-state RF amplifier replaces magnetron and high-voltage chain

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state 2.45 GHz RF power amplifier
new_nodes.detail: Transistor modules replace the magnetron, giving continuously adjustable 0-700 W output with no filament and no kV rail.

new_nodes.label: GaN HEMT RF amplification at 2.45 GHz
new_nodes.detail: Wide-bandgap transistors amplify a synthesized 2.45 GHz signal efficiently across power levels.

new_nodes.label: Low-voltage switched-mode PSU (about 50 V DC)
new_nodes.detail: A small high-frequency converter replaces the HV transformer, voltage doubler and HV capacitor, so it is cheaper and has fewer parts.

new_nodes.label: High-frequency switched-mode conversion
new_nodes.detail: Mains is rectified and chopped at tens of kHz, so the supply is compact and lightweight.

new_nodes.label: Continuously modulated microwave power
new_nodes.detail: Sets average power by analogue amplitude control instead of on/off duty cycling.

new_edges.to: GaN HEMT RF amplification at 2.45 GHz

GaN solid-state 2.45 GHz RF power amplifier

ideas.rationale: Solid-state amplification removes magnetron filament standby and HV transformer losses and allows continuous power control, so less mains energy is wasted on conversion and on/off cycling.

ideas.title: Vapour sensor cook-to-done replaces the timer knob and bell

new_nodes.label: Cavity vapour sensor with piezo chirp
new_nodes.detail: A metal-oxide humidity/gas sensor watches steam rise and plateau, and one piezo buzzer replaces the knob, cam switch and bell.

new_nodes.label: Metal-oxide gas sensing of food vapour
new_nodes.detail: The resistance of a heated oxide film changes with humidity and volatiles, signalling when food is done.

new_nodes.label: Ends heating at the cook-complete point
new_nodes.detail: Stops RF as soon as sensed vapour plateaus, replacing a guessed cooking time.

new_nodes.label: Heat-pipe keep-warm plate
new_nodes.detail: Copper heat pipes carry magnetron waste heat from the tube fins to a flat plate under the turntable that holds food warm.

new_nodes.label: Passive two-phase heat-pipe heat transport
new_nodes.detail: An evaporating and condensing working fluid moves heat with no moving parts and no fan power.

new_nodes.label: Keeps cooked food warm from recovered magnetron heat
new_nodes.detail: Turns heat that is currently vented into holding temperature, avoiding re-heating cycles.

new_edges.to: Keeps cooked food warm from recovered magnetron heat

new_edges.from: Keeps cooked food warm from recovered magnetron heat

ideas.rationale: Removing the fan and reusing magnetron waste heat for keep-warm cuts the motor's power draw and stops energy from being thrown out of the vents.

ideas.title: Susceptor ceramic turntable recaptures stray microwave energy

new_nodes.label: Magnetically coupled SiC susceptor disc
new_nodes.detail: One silicon-carbide ceramic disc turns on a magnetic coupling, replacing the glass plate, roller ring and drive coupler.

new_nodes.label: Silicon-carbide microwave susceptor ceramic
new_nodes.detail: A lossy ceramic absorbs microwaves that pass through thin food and re-radiates them as surface heat, with no metal to arc.

new_nodes.label: Recaptures stray microwave energy as surface heat
new_nodes.detail: Converts energy that would otherwise be absorbed by cavity walls or pass through thin foods into crisping heat.

new_edges.to: Recaptures stray microwave energy as surface heat

Recaptures stray microwave energy as surface heat

ideas.rationale: Turning microwaves that would otherwise be lost into useful surface heat lets food brown without a separate heating element, so the energy is used rather than wasted.

new_nodes.label: Micro-prism total-internal-reflection light guiding
new_nodes.detail: Light enters at the edge and is extracted by prisms, so the cavity is lit with no filament.

new_nodes.label: Lights cavity from room light or 0.2 W backup
new_nodes.detail: Keeps food visible at a fraction of the lamp's 20-25 W draw.

ideas.title: 27 MHz solid-state thaw plates

new_nodes.label: Solid-state 27 MHz RF oscillator (GaN/LDMOS)
new_nodes.detail: Low-voltage transistor RF source that replaces the magnetron and high-voltage chain and runs at any continuous power level.

new_nodes.label: Capacitive RF field between electrode plates
new_nodes.detail: The field passes between two plates and penetrates the full thickness of a frozen block, not just its surface.

new_nodes.label: Solid-state RF thaw generator
new_nodes.detail: Small low-voltage module that replaces the transformer, capacitor, diode and magnetron.

new_nodes.label: Thaw electrode plates
new_nodes.detail: Insulated metal plates molded into the tray that replace the waveguide and cavity heating path.

new_nodes.label: Delivers RF through full food thickness
new_nodes.detail: Uniform volumetric field through a frozen block at 27 MHz, avoiding surface-only heating.

new_edges.to: Capacitive RF field between electrode plates

new_edges.from: Delivers RF through full food thickness
Delivers RF through full food thickness

ideas.rationale: A 27 MHz capacitive field penetrates frozen blocks evenly and continuously, so M4 is served faster and with less hot-edge and cold-centre waste than 2.45 GHz cavity heating.

ideas.title: Static graded-loss thaw tray

new_nodes.label: Graded lossy-ceramic absorber film
new_nodes.detail: Resistive ceramic-loaded film printed in a pattern that absorbs excess energy at the edges and passes it toward the centre.

new_nodes.label: Static graded-loss thaw tray
new_nodes.detail: Single molded tray that replaces the glass turntable, roller ring, coupler and motor.

new_nodes.label: Balances heating across footprint without moving parts
new_nodes.detail: The edge-absorbing pattern equalises thaw rate across the whole food footprint.

new_edges.to: Balances heating across footprint without moving parts

new_edges.from: Balances heating across footprint without moving parts

Balances heating across footprint without moving parts

ideas.rationale: Removing the motor and rotating parts and using an edge-absorbing static tray stops frozen edges from cooking while the centre is still solid, so the whole block thaws faster and more evenly.

ideas.title: Reflected-power self-stopping thaw

new_nodes.label: Reflected-power sensing via waveguide diode tap
new_nodes.detail: A directional coupler and detector diode read back-reflected RF, which falls as the food starts absorbing energy.

new_nodes.label: Reflected-power diode tap
new_nodes.detail: Small coupler on the waveguide feeding a detector diode.

new_nodes.label: Thaw-state controller (MCU)
new_nodes.detail: Adjusts the duty cycle automatically and stops at the thaw point, replacing the knob cam and clockwork timer.

ideas.title: 27 MHz Electrode Thaw Cavity (magnetron-free)

new_nodes.label: 27.12 MHz solid-state RF generator
new_nodes.detail: LDMOS amplifier at the ISM 27.12 MHz band (~11 m wavelength) replaces the 2.45 GHz magnetron and its ~4 kV DC chain.

new_nodes.label: Parallel-plate RF electrode shelves
new_nodes.detail: Two conductive shelves sandwich the food in the cavity, giving a quasi-uniform field that penetrates the frozen core.

new_nodes.label: Deep uniform RF thaw field
new_nodes.detail: Penetrates the full food thickness with no standing-wave hot and cold spots, so thaw is even and fast.

ideas.rationale: Swapping the 2.45 GHz magnetron for a 27.12 MHz electrode field thaws frozen food deeply and evenly with no standing-wave cold spots, serving M4 faster and more safely than the magnetron chain.

ideas.title: Load-Signature Thaw Sensing (no timer, no power cam)

new_nodes.label: Closed-loop reflected-power duty-cycle control
new_nodes.detail: A microcontroller gates the magnetron from a live load measurement, replacing the mechanical cam and synchronous timer motor.

new_nodes.label: Reflected-power sensing MCU board
new_nodes.detail: A small directional coupler on the waveguide feeds an MCU that tracks load shifts as ice melts into water.

new_nodes.label: Self-timing thaw by sensed load
new_nodes.detail: Sets thaw duration and duty cycle from the food's real dielectric state instead of a guessed time and power level.

ideas.rationale: A closed-loop controller reads the real thaw state from the magnetron's own load and modulates power, so frozen food thaws in the least time without cooking the edges, serving M4 with no dial for the user to guess.

ideas.title: Package-Tap Thaw Programs (NFC tags instead of knobs)

new_nodes.label: Passive NFC thaw-program tags
new_nodes.detail: A printed low-cost NFC tag on each frozen pack stores weight, food type and its thaw profile.

new_nodes.label: Fascia NFC tap pad
new_nodes.detail: A reader pad in the plastic control fascia, outside the metal cavity, that the user taps the pack against.

new_nodes.label: One-tap per-food thaw program
new_nodes.detail: Loads the exact time and power for that specific food so the user never sets a dial.

new_nodes.label: Metal and foil packaging detunes NFC tags
new_nodes.detail: Aluminium trays and foil shield the tag, so it must sit on a non-metal sleeve or label.

new_edges.to: Metal and foil packaging detunes NFC tags

ideas.rationale: Each frozen pack tells the oven its own thaw program with a single tap, so M4 is met without any guessing at time or power.

ideas.title: Tesla-Disc Airflow Turntable (motorless rotor)

new_nodes.label: Tesla-disc viscous-drag turbine
new_nodes.detail: Closely spaced smooth discs spin from air drag alone, so no blades, motor or drive coupler are needed.

new_nodes.label: Stacked-disc turntable rotor
new_nodes.detail: A disc stack under the glass tray, driven by cooling air the existing fan already moves through the cavity.

ideas.rationale: A motorless disc rotor spun by the existing cooling air keeps frozen food turning evenly, which shortens the time to a thawed core for M4 while removing the motor and coupler.

ideas.title: Thermal Thaw Map (lamp replaced by IR imaging)

new_nodes.label: Long-wave infrared (8-14 µm) thermal imaging
new_nodes.detail: Reads the food's own heat emission, so thaw state is visible with no light source at all.

new_nodes.label: Micro thermal-IR sensor array
new_nodes.detail: A low-cost thermopile array behind the door mesh; sub-wavelength holes stop microwaves but pass LWIR.

new_nodes.label: Real-time thaw heat map
new_nodes.detail: Shows cold frozen cores and warm thawed edges on a small display or app, so the user knows when to stop.

ideas.rationale: A thermal heat map shows exactly where the frozen core has thawed, so the user can stop at the right moment, serving M4 while replacing a bulb that burns out.

ideas.rationale: Continuous low-power RF from electronically controlled solid-state modules thaws the frozen core steadily without hot-cold duty cycling, and 915 MHz penetrates a frozen block more deeply for a faster, more even thaw.

ideas.title: Phased-Array Beam Steering (the food stays still, the field moves)

new_nodes.label: Four-element phased-array feed
new_nodes.detail: Four independently phased feed antennas on the cavity walls replace the turntable motor and roller ring, with no moving parts.

new_nodes.label: Electronic beam steering via per-element phase control
new_nodes.detail: Shifting the phase between feeds moves the hot spot across a stationary frozen block.

new_nodes.label: Steers RF to cold spots without rotation
new_nodes.detail: Sweeps the energy pattern over a fixed load and tracks the thaw front.

ideas.title: Cavity-Wall Slot Radiators (the walls become the antenna)

new_nodes.label: Cavity-wall slot radiator array
new_nodes.detail: Coax-fed slots cut into the steel cavity walls radiate from every side, replacing the waveguide duct.

new_nodes.label: Enamel liner over radiator slots
new_nodes.detail: A thin enamel-coated liner covers the slots and keeps splatter out, replacing the mica sheet.

new_nodes.label: Slot-antenna radiation from a metal cavity wall
new_nodes.detail: Slots in a conductive wall act as distributed radiators that feed the cavity from many faces at once.

new_nodes.label: Distributes RF from all faces at once
new_nodes.detail: Illuminates the frozen load from all sides simultaneously.

ideas.title: Recipe-Stamped Packs (the food tells the oven how to defrost it)

new_nodes.label: NFC defrost-recipe tag on frozen-meal pack
new_nodes.detail: A passive printed tag encodes the food's mass, type and a defrost power curve, costs pennies and needs no battery.

new_nodes.label: Tap-to-load NFC reader on fascia
new_nodes.detail: The user taps the pack on the fascia to load its curve, replacing the 5-step power knob.

new_nodes.label: Passive NFC (13.56 MHz) backscatter
new_nodes.detail: The pack-powered tag responds to the reader's magnetic field at a range of a few centimetres.

new_nodes.label: Loads per-food defrost profile automatically
new_nodes.detail: Sets the power ramp from the pack's own data rather than from a guessed dial position.

ideas.rationale: Each pack carries a defrost curve matched to its own mass and food type, so the oven starts the right power ramp first time instead of the guess-and-restart that slows thawing.

ideas.title: Silicon-Carbide Thaw Plate (microwaves heat the tray, the tray heats the frozen base)

new_nodes.label: Silicon-carbide thaw plate
new_nodes.detail: A microwave-absorbing SiC ceramic tray heats under RF and conducts heat into the frozen underside, replacing the glass tray.

new_nodes.label: Microwave-absorbing SiC ceramic (dielectric-loss heating)
new_nodes.detail: SiC absorbs RF through dielectric loss and re-radiates it as conducted heat. It is non-metallic, so arcing risk is minimal.

new_nodes.label: Conducts heat into frozen underside
new_nodes.detail: Adds contact thawing alongside RF to speed the cold base of a pack and gives the underside some browning.

ideas.rationale: Conduction from a heated SiC plate attacks the frozen underside in parallel with RF, so the cold base of a pack thaws faster than RF alone can achieve.

ideas.title: Solid-State Heart: GaN Amplifiers on a 48 V Bus

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state RF amplifier array (2.45 GHz)
new_nodes.detail: Transistor amplifiers replace the vacuum tube, with per-stage phase and power control.

new_nodes.label: GaN HEMT power amplification at 2.45 GHz
new_nodes.detail: Gallium-nitride transistors amplify a low-voltage RF signal up to cooking power.

new_nodes.label: 48 V DC bus switch-mode supply
new_nodes.detail: A compact SMPS replaces the 2 kV transformer and voltage-doubler chain.

new_nodes.label: Load-matched RF power delivery
new_nodes.detail: Phase and power adjust to the food's impedance so less energy is reflected back.

GaN solid-state RF amplifier array (2.45 GHz)

new_edges.to: GaN solid-state RF amplifier array (2.45 GHz)

new_edges.from: GaN solid-state RF amplifier array (2.45 GHz)

ideas.rationale: Replacing the lossy high-voltage transformer and doubler chain with a 48 V bus and transistor amplifiers removes core and copper losses, while load-matched delivery cuts the energy reflected back into the source.

ideas.title: Ghost Turntable: Phase-Steered Hot Spots

new_nodes.label: Phased-array beam steering at 2.45 GHz
new_nodes.detail: Independent phase shifts across antenna elements move the hot-spot pattern through a fixed cavity; requires a solid-state RF source (see Solid-State Heart).

new_nodes.label: Patch antenna array on cavity walls
new_nodes.detail: Flush antennas in the cavity walls replace the turntable's motor and roller ring.

new_nodes.label: Electronic hot-spot sweep
new_nodes.detail: The field sweeps across the food electronically, with no moving parts.

new_edges.from: Patch antenna array on cavity walls
Patch antenna array on cavity walls

Patch antenna array on cavity walls

ideas.rationale: Removing the 5 rpm motor, its drive coupling and the roller ring eliminates their continuous draw and friction losses, and electronically steered hot spots reduce the reheats that uneven cooking forces.

ideas.title: Thermal Eye Replaces the 25 W Lamp

new_nodes.label: Interior incandescent lamp (20-25 W)
new_nodes.detail: Draws 20-25 W throughout every cook cycle and dumps the heat into the cavity.

new_nodes.label: Uncooled microbolometer thermal camera
new_nodes.detail: A sub-watt infrared sensor behind the mesh window sees food heat, so the cavity stays dark.

new_nodes.label: Microbolometer infrared sensing
new_nodes.detail: Heat-sensitive pixels read infrared from food; the mesh's 1 mm holes pass IR but block microwaves.

new_nodes.label: Infrared & thermal sensing
new_nodes.detail: Engineering discipline covering IR detection and thermal imaging.

new_nodes.label: Shows food temperature map without light
new_nodes.detail: Reveals hot and cold spots to the user with no lamp power.

new_edges.to: Shows food temperature map without light

new_edges.from: Shows food temperature map without light
Shows food temperature map without light

ideas.rationale: Dropping the 20-25 W lamp that runs through every cook cycle in favour of a sub-watt thermal sensor that needs no light cuts a constant load while showing where the food is actually heating.

ideas.title: Cook-Until-Done: A Microwave That Listens to the Food

new_nodes.label: Ends cooking at target doneness
new_nodes.detail: The magnetron stops when the food reaches a set state, not when a fixed timer runs out.

new_nodes.label: Reflected-power and dielectric-impedance sensing
new_nodes.detail: Monitors how much RF the load absorbs and how its impedance shifts as moisture heats.

new_nodes.label: Digital doneness controller
new_nodes.detail: A microcontroller and sensing front end replace the clockwork timer knob and bell.

new_nodes.label: Clockwork timer knob (0-30 min)
new_nodes.detail: A mechanical timer that runs for a fixed time whatever the state of the food.

ideas.rationale: Stopping the magnetron the moment food reaches doneness, rather than after a fixed time, eliminates the overshoot energy and reheat cycles that a clockwork timer wastes.

ideas.title: Waste-Heat Vault: Stop Venting the Magnetron

new_nodes.label: Vent louvres and cooling fan
new_nodes.detail: The airflow path that exhausts magnetron and transformer heat into the kitchen.

new_nodes.label: Liquid-cooled magnetron jacket
new_nodes.detail: A coolant loop draws anode heat off the tube, reducing its thermal stress.

new_nodes.label: Recovers magnetron waste heat
new_nodes.detail: Captured heat is held for warming food instead of being vented to the room.

new_nodes.label: Phase-change heat store
new_nodes.detail: A compact salt-hydrate pack stores recovered heat at a steady temperature.

new_nodes.label: Phase-change thermal storage
new_nodes.detail: Latent heat in a salt-hydrate or paraffin compound holds energy for later use.

ideas.rationale: Capturing the magnetron's waste heat instead of venting it, then storing it to hold or pre-warm food, lowers the net energy that each cook and each hold costs.

new_nodes.detail: A few-cent sensor in the cavity roof tracks the steam curve rising from the food.

ideas.title: Slide-In Drawer: one push loads the plate and seals the cavity

new_nodes.label: Sliding drawer tray
new_nodes.detail: A shallow drawer on low-friction rails replaces the hinged door and slides out to a full-width loading plate.

new_nodes.label: Sliding λ/4 choke seal
new_nodes.detail: A telescoping quarter-wave channel in the drawer frame keeps RF contained while the drawer moves.

new_nodes.label: Magnetic detent with reed-switch interlock
new_nodes.detail: Magnets hold the drawer shut and a reed switch cuts RF when it opens, replacing the push-button lever and hooks.

new_nodes.label: One-motion slide loading
new_nodes.detail: A light push opens the drawer with no swing clearance, so the dish goes in and out in one motion.

ideas.rationale: Loading becomes one push-and-slide motion with no door swing and no lever to hold, so a busy household can load and unload a dish without clearing counter space or pausing.

ideas.title: Stirrer Vane: a metal paddle on the cooling-fan shaft replaces the turntable

new_nodes.label: Metal mode-stirrer vane
new_nodes.detail: A bent metal paddle in the cavity roof continuously reshuffles the standing-wave pattern so the whole plate heats at once.

new_nodes.label: Field stirring by rotating conductor
new_nodes.detail: A moving conductor changes the field pattern in real time, removing hot and cold spots without moving the food.

new_nodes.label: Fan-shaft RF-choke coupling
new_nodes.detail: The existing cooling-fan motor drives the stirrer through a λ/4 bushing, so no separate turntable motor is needed.

new_nodes.label: Uniform heating in one uninterrupted run
new_nodes.detail: The full dish heats evenly in a single run, with no pause-and-turn and no cold rim at the edge of the plate.

new_edges.from: Uniform heating in one uninterrupted run

ideas.rationale: Because the whole plate is stirred continuously instead of rotated, there is no stop-and-turn pause and no cold rim, so the meal reaches serving temperature in one uninterrupted run.

ideas.title: Phase-Change Heat Sink: waste heat stored in a salt pouch warms the dish from below

new_nodes.label: Sodium-acetate phase-change heat sink
new_nodes.detail: A sealed pouch of sodium acetate trihydrate absorbs magnetron and transformer waste heat as it melts at about 58 °C.

new_nodes.label: Latent-heat thermal storage
new_nodes.detail: Melting stores large amounts of heat at a near-constant temperature, released again when the salt re-solidifies on a nucleation trigger.

new_nodes.label: Heated cavity floor plate
new_nodes.detail: A thin ceramic floor plate conducts the stored heat up into the base of the dish during reheat.

new_nodes.label: Hybrid conductive plus dielectric reheat
new_nodes.detail: Food heats from inside by microwave and from below by stored heat at the same time.

ideas.rationale: Waste heat that a fan currently vents is stored and returned as a warm floor under the dish, so food heats from below while the microwaves work from inside and reaches serving temperature sooner.

new_nodes.detail: Two portions reheat in parallel, so the second item needs no queue.

new_nodes.label: Cooks food with steam, no added fat, no nutrient leaching
new_nodes.detail: Steam cooking keeps water-soluble vitamins and minerals in the food instead of draining them into cooking water.

new_nodes.label: Sealed perforated steam-basket insert
new_nodes.detail: Microwave-transparent basket with a pressure-relief valve replaces open dry heating in the cavity.

ideas.rationale: Steam cooking retains water-soluble nutrients and needs no oil, so the dry-heat dielectric method is replaced by a method that protects the food's vitamins and fat content.

ideas.title: Solid-State GaN Power Cartridge

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state RF amplifier at 2.45 GHz
new_nodes.detail: Transistor amplifier with no filament and no high-voltage transformer, modulated continuously in phase and amplitude.

new_nodes.label: Continuously variable, precise power delivery
new_nodes.detail: Sets any power level continuously so delicate foods can be held at low, gentle heat rather than cycled on and off.

new_nodes.detail: Modular amplifier blocks replace the magnetron, HV transformer and rectifier diode with one sealed module.

new_edges.from: GaN solid-state RF amplifier at 2.45 GHz

ideas.rationale: Continuous low-power control gives gentler cooking that preserves heat-sensitive nutrients, and the lack of a filament removes the magnetron wear that limits a typical oven's life.

ideas.title: Thermal Vision Door Panel

new_nodes.label: Shows cold spots and overheated zones in real time

new_nodes.label: Door-mounted thermal sensor module

ideas.title: Butter Sentinel: Melt-Detecting Bell

ideas.title: Phase-Change Heat Puck

new_nodes.label: Phase-change heat puck
new_nodes.detail: A salt-hydrate puck absorbs microwave energy and releases heat at a fixed 36–40°C plateau, so it cannot overheat.

new_nodes.label: Latent-heat storage (phase-change material)
new_nodes.detail: The puck stores energy as it changes phase and releases it steadily, which holds a temperature without a controller.

new_nodes.label: Melt without scorching at a fixed temperature
new_nodes.detail: Butter, chocolate or eggs are warmed to a set temperature with no power settings to choose.

new_edges.to: Melt without scorching at a fixed temperature

new_edges.from: Melt without scorching at a fixed temperature

ideas.rationale: Melting butter and tempering eggs for a cake become foolproof because the puck holds a safe temperature regardless of how the user sets the controls.

ideas.title: Stir-While-Melt Magnetic Rotor

new_nodes.label: Magnetic stir rotor
new_nodes.detail: A magnet-coupled paddle beneath the glass drives a whisk inside the bowl while the bowl heats.

new_nodes.label: Magnetic coupling through glass
new_nodes.detail: A magnet under the glass turns a paddle inside the bowl with no seal or shaft.

new_nodes.label: Melt and blend in one step
new_nodes.detail: Butter melts while it is stirred into sugar or batter, so a separate mixing bowl is not needed.

new_edges.to: Melt and blend in one step

new_edges.from: Melt and blend in one step

ideas.rationale: The turntable's job of evening out heat is replaced by a rotor that melts and whisks the butter in the same bowl, which shortens the cake's prep chain.

ideas.title: Heat-Map Window

new_nodes.label: Thermal sensor array
new_nodes.detail: A low-resolution thermal sensor behind the door reads heat across the bowl without needing any light.

new_nodes.label: Electrochromic door display
new_nodes.detail: The door glass changes tint to overlay a colour heat map showing where butter is still solid.

new_nodes.label: Micro-bolometer thermal imaging
new_nodes.detail: Each pixel measures infrared emission, so the cavity can be read in total darkness.

new_nodes.label: See cold spots in melting butter
new_nodes.detail: The baker sees which parts of the butter are still solid without opening the door.

new_edges.from: See cold spots in melting butter

ideas.rationale: The lamp's job of letting the baker see inside is replaced by a thermal map that shows the melt state of the butter, which matters more than seeing the food's colour.

ideas.title: Floury-Knee Door Opener

new_nodes.label: Knee-sweep proximity pad
new_nodes.detail: A capacitive pad in the lower door frame opens the door when a knee or elbow approaches.

new_nodes.label: Capacitive proximity sensing
new_nodes.detail: The pad senses a body near it without touch, so it works with buttery or floury hands.

new_nodes.label: Open door with messy hands
new_nodes.detail: The door can be opened during baking without touching a button with sticky hands.

ideas.rationale: The push button is replaced by a touchless pad, so the baker can keep moving butter and batter without wiping their hands between steps.

ideas.title: Plate-as-Program

new_nodes.detail: Reads the dish and sets time and power with no user input.

new_nodes.detail: Glass turntable with a load cell and IR sensor that estimates food mass and surface temperature.

new_nodes.detail: Maps the door's open or closed state to start and pause.

ideas.rationale: Closing the door is already a natural action, so starting the oven by doing it removes the need for a start button and its learning curve.

ideas.title: Pack-Is-the-Panel

ideas.title: Self-Sensing Doneness via Reflected RF

new_nodes.detail: Small coupler on the waveguide feed that continuously measures forward and reflected microwave power.

new_nodes.label: Reflected-power impedance doneness sensing
new_nodes.detail: As food heats and its dielectric load changes, the reflected-power curve signals completion, so no time has to be set.

new_nodes.label: Auto-terminates cooking at detected doneness
new_nodes.detail: Cuts RF power and alerts the user when the food reaches the target state, without a user-set timer.

ideas.rationale: Replacing the guessed timer with sensed doneness means the user never has to estimate cooking time, so food is finished on the first try with no re-heating.

ideas.title: Solid-State RF Amplifier Replaces Magnetron

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state 2.45 GHz RF amplifier
new_nodes.detail: Transistor-based amplifier producing 700 W-class microwave power at 2.45 GHz from low-voltage DC.

new_nodes.label: GaN high-electron-mobility transistor RF amplification
new_nodes.detail: Semiconductor amplification removes the vacuum tube, its ferrite magnets and the kilovolt-level supply.

new_nodes.label: Continuous, instantly variable RF power
new_nodes.detail: Power is set continuously within milliseconds, so the on/off duty-cycle dead time disappears.

ideas.rationale: Continuous, instantly responsive power removes the warm-up and cycling waste of a magnetron, so food reaches the target temperature sooner.

ideas.title: Phase-Steered Field Replaces Turntable

new_nodes.label: Four-port phased feed array
new_nodes.detail: Multiple phase-controlled microwave feeds around the cavity that sweep the standing-wave hot spots.

new_nodes.label: Phase-steered multi-port microwave feeding
new_nodes.detail: Electronic phase control moves the field pattern so energy lands everywhere without any mechanical rotation.

new_nodes.label: Even heating without turntable rotation
new_nodes.detail: Eliminates cold spots and the stop-and-stir step, with no moving parts needed.

ideas.rationale: Even heating with no stop-and-stir step means one uninterrupted cycle yields a fully heated meal.

ideas.title: Package-Read Programming Replaces Control Knobs

new_nodes.label: NFC/RFID reader in control fascia
new_nodes.detail: Reader built into the front panel that replaces the timer and power knobs.

new_nodes.label: Passive NFC/RFID tag programming
new_nodes.detail: Packaging tag stores power profile, duration and end condition, and needs no battery.

new_nodes.label: Auto-programmed cooking from package scan
new_nodes.detail: One tap on the package sets power, time and end alert, with no manual dialling.

ideas.rationale: Scanning the package to start cooking removes the setup step entirely, so a student can have a meal running in one tap.

ideas.title: Dielectric-Matched Single-Pass Thawing

new_nodes.label: Frequency-agile dielectric-matched RF thawing
new_nodes.detail: Tunes the RF output to the food's dielectric loss so frozen mass absorbs energy evenly in one continuous pass.

new_nodes.label: Thaws frozen food in a single continuous pass
new_nodes.detail: Replaces low-power on/off defrost cycles, which can cut total thaw time roughly in half.

new_edges.from: Thaws frozen food in a single continuous pass

Thaws frozen food in a single continuous pass

ideas.rationale: Thawing in one continuous pass rather than many low-power cycles gets a frozen meal ready far sooner, which is the most common time sink for single-person households.

ideas.title: Cold-Light Waveguide Window

new_nodes.label: Interior incandescent lamp (original)
new_nodes.detail: 20-25 W filament bulb inside the RF cavity; hot glass and filament are burn and heat hazards.

new_nodes.label: Sealed fiber light pipe with cold LED
new_nodes.detail: Sub-1 W LED outside the cavity feeds a below-cutoff light pipe through the wall, so no heat source sits inside.

new_nodes.label: Visual inspection of food
new_nodes.detail: Lets the user check cooking progress without opening the door.

new_nodes.label: Total internal reflection optics
new_nodes.detail: Light is guided through a channel far smaller than the microwave wavelength, which RF cannot pass.

new_nodes.label: Optics
new_nodes.detail: Guided propagation of light.

new_edges.from: Sealed fiber light pipe with cold LED
Sealed fiber light pipe with cold LED
Sealed fiber light pipe with cold LED

ideas.rationale: Removing the heat-producing filament from the cavity eliminates the burn source and keeps the user's view of the food without any hot surface to touch.

ideas.title: Acoustic Levitation Cooking Field

new_nodes.label: Glass turntable and roller ring (original)
new_nodes.detail: Heavy hot glass plate the user must lift out, which risks burns and breakage.

new_nodes.label: Ultrasonic standing-wave emitter array
new_nodes.detail: Phased transducers in the cavity walls hold and slowly rotate food in mid-air.

new_nodes.label: Even heating through food movement
new_nodes.detail: Keeps food moving so heating is uniform, without needing a plate.

new_nodes.label: Acoustic levitation
new_nodes.detail: Ultrasonic standing waves create pressure nodes that trap small or light objects.

new_nodes.label: Acoustics
new_nodes.detail: Study of sound and pressure waves.

new_nodes.label: Levitation limited to light items
new_nodes.detail: Heavy or wet items may fall, so the design needs a weight and mass threshold.

ideas.rationale: With no hot plate to lift, the user never reaches into a hot cavity, which removes the most common burn moment in everyday microwave use.

new_nodes.label: Floating 5 V control board with gesture sensor

new_nodes.label: Select cooking power level
new_nodes.detail: User chooses one of five power steps.

new_nodes.label: Optocoupled safety extra-low voltage (SELV) control
new_nodes.detail: Galvanic isolation keeps user-facing circuits at a non-hazardous voltage.

new_nodes.label: Electrical safety engineering
new_nodes.detail: Design of circuits to prevent shock and fault exposure.

new_edges.from: Floating 5 V control board with gesture sensor

Floating 5 V control board with gesture sensor

ideas.title: Doneness-Sensing Auto-Stop

new_nodes.detail: Stops heating at the right point and prevents overheating.

new_nodes.detail: Heat transfer and temperature measurement.

new_edges.from: Mechanical clockwork timer knob with bell (original)

ideas.title: Dual-Channel Magnetic Door Interlock

new_nodes.detail: Stops microwave emission whenever the door is open or unsealed.

new_nodes.label: Redundant solid-state interlock
new_nodes.detail: Two independent sensing paths with no moving contacts; a single fault cannot energize the magnetron with the door open.

Door push-release button and microswitch interlocks (original)

ideas.title: Spectral Doneness Eye

new_nodes.detail: Milliwatt NIR/visible sensor behind a sealed window that replaces the lamp's visibility role and reads surface moisture and browning.

ideas.title: Gravity Fat-Drain Cradle

new_nodes.label: Passive gravity fat separation

ideas.title: Nutrient Budget Clock

new_nodes.label: Stop at nutrient-retention threshold

ideas.rationale: Stopping on a computed vitamin-loss budget instead of a fixed time keeps nutrients intact across different foods and portion sizes, serving M12.

new_nodes.label: Moisture retention without added fat

ideas.title: RF Plate Defrost

new_nodes.label: 2.45 GHz magnetron
new_nodes.detail: Current heat source; couples weakly to ice, so thawing starts slowly and then runs away on liquid pockets.

new_nodes.label: 27 MHz RF solid-state oscillator
new_nodes.detail: Low-cost GaN generator at 27.12 MHz that replaces the magnetron as the energy source.

new_nodes.label: Parallel RF electrode plates
new_nodes.detail: Metal plates on either side of the food, so the field penetrates ice evenly through its full thickness.

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state RF amplification
new_nodes.detail: Cool-running, precisely tunable RF power from inexpensive semiconductors.

new_nodes.label: Industrial RF dielectric heating
new_nodes.detail: Physics already used in factory RF thawing lines, shrunk to a countertop.

new_nodes.label: Volumetric uniform thawing
new_nodes.detail: Heats the core and rim together, avoiding a cooked outside with a frozen centre.

new_nodes.label: Ice absorbs little 2.45 GHz energy
new_nodes.detail: Microwave-frequency thawing is slow at first and uneven throughout.

ideas.rationale: Replacing the microwave source with RF electrodes lets the field penetrate ice evenly, so frozen food thaws faster and without cooked edges.

ideas.title: Thaw-Sense Auto-Stop

new_nodes.label: Mechanical clockwork timer knob
new_nodes.detail: Guesses defrost time from a dial and ignores load mass, temperature and thaw state.

new_nodes.label: Dielectric permittivity sensor
new_nodes.detail: Electrodes read the shift in dielectric properties as ice turns to water, which indicates thaw state.

new_nodes.label: Thermopile IR array
new_nodes.detail: Low-cost surface thermal map that shows cold spots across the load in real time.

new_nodes.label: Bell
new_nodes.detail: Audible end-of-cycle signal fixed to the timer knob.

new_nodes.label: Phone alert module
new_nodes.detail: Wi-Fi notification that replaces the bell when the food is thawed.

new_nodes.label: Permittivity and thermopile sensing
new_nodes.detail: Inexpensive sensing that reads thaw state directly instead of inferring it from elapsed time.

new_nodes.label: Sensor physics
new_nodes.detail: Dielectric spectroscopy and infrared thermometry.

new_nodes.label: Thaw-state detection
new_nodes.detail: Knows when food is soft enough, not merely when time has passed.

new_nodes.label: Automatic stop at thaw point
new_nodes.detail: Ends the cycle at the right moment, preventing overcooked edges.

ideas.rationale: Sensing the actual thaw state replaces guesswork with an automatic stop, so frozen food is defrosted fully without overcooking.

ideas.title: Acoustic Spin Tray

new_nodes.label: Glass turntable
new_nodes.detail: Rotates the food so the microwave field evens out across the load.

new_nodes.label: Turntable drive motor
new_nodes.detail: Mechanical spinner needed only to rotate the glass turntable.

new_nodes.label: Piezo ultrasonic transducer tray
new_nodes.detail: Solid ceramic plate that spins and vibrates the food using standing-wave acoustic forces.

new_nodes.label: Piezoelectric ultrasound drive
new_nodes.detail: Cheap, silent actuation with no moving parts.

new_nodes.label: Acoustics
new_nodes.detail: Standing-wave and radiation-pressure physics.

new_nodes.label: Acoustic agitation thawing
new_nodes.detail: Vibration disturbs the ice-water boundary and speeds heat transfer into the food.

new_nodes.label: Even heat distribution
new_nodes.detail: Keeps the load moving so heating stays uniform.

ideas.rationale: Ultrasonic agitation replaces a mechanical spinner and speeds heat transfer into ice, so the food thaws faster and more evenly.

ideas.title: Thaw-Map Window

new_nodes.label: 20-25 W incandescent lamp
new_nodes.detail: Lights the cavity so the user can monitor progress; it wastes energy as heat.

new_nodes.label: Thermochromic thaw-zone window
new_nodes.detail: Door window with a dye layer that changes colour wherever food is still frozen.

new_nodes.label: Leuco dye thermochromic film
new_nodes.detail: Passive, self-powered colour-shifting film with no electronics.

new_nodes.label: Materials chemistry
new_nodes.detail: Reversible colour change in dye-polymer films.

new_nodes.label: Visual thaw-zone mapping
new_nodes.detail: Shows at a glance which parts are still frozen, so the user can rearrange or stop.

new_nodes.label: Metal coatings arc in microwave cavity
new_nodes.detail: Conventional conductive heating or visibility films cannot sit inside the field.

new_edges.to: Metal coatings arc in microwave cavity

ideas.rationale: A thaw-map window shows the user exactly which zones remain frozen, so they can reposition food and finish defrosting quickly.

ideas.title: Brine Ohmic Thaw

new_nodes.label: Microwave cavity and magnetron
new_nodes.detail: Field-based heating chamber that heats from the surface inward.

new_nodes.label: Brine bath with electrode pair
new_nodes.detail: Shallow food-grade salt-water bath; electrodes pass current directly through the food.

new_nodes.label: Conductive food pouch
new_nodes.detail: Sealed pouch of food in brine that carries current evenly to the frozen core.

new_nodes.label: Ohmic electrical heating
new_nodes.detail: Current flowing through a conductor generates heat throughout its volume.

new_nodes.label: Electrochemistry
new_nodes.detail: Electrolyte conduction and electrode design.

new_nodes.label: Direct volumetric thawing
new_nodes.detail: Heat is generated throughout the food rather than entering from the outside.

new_nodes.label: Frozen food is an electrical insulator
new_nodes.detail: Ice blocks current until the load partially thaws.

new_edges.to: Frozen food is an electrical insulator

new_edges.from: Frozen food is an electrical insulator

ideas.rationale: Passing current directly through a brine-coupled pouch heats frozen food throughout its volume, so it thaws far faster than surface-first microwaving.

new_nodes.label: Cup-base IR sensing puck

new_nodes.label: Closed-loop stop at target drink temperature

new_edges.to: Closed-loop stop at target drink temperature

new_edges.from: Closed-loop stop at target drink temperature

ideas.title: Solid-State Gentle Warmer: GaN Amplifier Replaces Transformer and Magnetron

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state RF amplifier module
new_nodes.detail: Transistor-based 2.45 GHz amplifier replaces the high-voltage transformer and magnetron as the RF source.

new_nodes.label: Gallium-nitride power transistors at 2.45 GHz
new_nodes.detail: Semiconductor RF amplifiers with no filament and no cathode wear.

new_nodes.label: Continuously variable RF power 0-100%
new_nodes.detail: Smooth power control lets milk warm gently instead of in on/off bursts.

ideas.rationale: Continuous low-power heating keeps milk from scalding or forming a skin, and it removes the magnetron wear that shortens the appliance's life.

new_nodes.label: One-tap selection of milk-warming recipe

ideas.rationale: A tap on the bottle lets a parent with young children start a safe warm drink one-handed in the morning rush, with no fiddly knobs for a child to turn.

new_nodes.label: Photonics
new_nodes.detail: Study of guiding and manipulating light with passive optical structures.

new_nodes.label: Fiber-optic light piping
new_nodes.detail: Collects room light at the door frame and channels it through an acrylic light guide into the cavity.

new_nodes.label: Interior illumination for food viewing

ideas.title: Doneness-Sensing Auto-Stop

new_nodes.label: Sensor fusion
new_nodes.detail: Combining thermal, gas and optical signals to infer physical state.

new_nodes.label: Infrared thermal and VOC sensing
new_nodes.detail: Reads surface temperature and steam or volatile-compound signatures from the food.

new_nodes.label: Multispectral doneness sensor
new_nodes.detail: Compact sensor array that replaces the mechanical clockwork timer and bell.

new_nodes.label: Automatic cook-end detection
new_nodes.detail: Ends the cycle when food reaches target state, so no energy is spent overcooking.

new_nodes.label: Completion notification

ideas.title: Solid-State Continuous Power Modulator

new_nodes.label: Power electronics
new_nodes.detail: Switching and control of electrical power at high efficiency.

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state RF amplification
new_nodes.detail: Gallium nitride amplifiers that generate microwave energy with fine, continuous control.

new_nodes.label: Solid-state power modulator
new_nodes.detail: Continuously matches output to load, replacing the 5-step duty-cycle cam and its knob.

new_nodes.label: Load-matched power delivery
new_nodes.detail: Delivers exactly the power the food can absorb, avoiding reflected energy and off-cycle waste.

new_nodes.label: Higher unit cost at 700 W
new_nodes.detail: Solid-state RF hardware is currently more expensive than a magnetron-based drive.

ideas.rationale: Continuous load-matched power removes the on-off duty-cycle losses of the cam design, so each joule goes into the food rather than into cycling and reflection.

ideas.title: Electronic Field Steering Without Turntable

new_nodes.label: Electromagnetics
new_nodes.detail: Shaping and directing electromagnetic fields inside a cavity.

new_nodes.label: Phased-array dual-feed RF control
new_nodes.detail: Two or more feeds with controlled phase shift that move the hot spots electronically.

new_nodes.label: Electronic field-steering array
new_nodes.detail: Feed network that replaces the glass turntable and its drive motor.

new_nodes.label: Uniform heating without rotation
new_nodes.detail: Spreads energy evenly across the cavity so no mechanical rotation is needed.

new_nodes.label: Requires dual-feed hardware
new_nodes.detail: Needs extra RF feeds and phase control electronics, adding complexity.

ideas.rationale: Eliminating the turntable motor removes its continuous draw and friction losses while avoiding cold spots that force users to reheat food and waste additional energy.

ideas.title: Magnetron Waste-Heat Recovery Loop

new_nodes.label: Thermodynamics
new_nodes.detail: Heat transfer and energy recovery in closed systems.

new_nodes.label: Heat-pipe thermal transport
new_nodes.detail: Sealed passive heat pipes that move heat from the magnetron to a storage point without pumps.

new_nodes.label: Heat-pipe recovery loop
new_nodes.detail: Replaces the cooling fan and exhaust vent, routing magnetron heat into a water reservoir.

new_nodes.label: Water preheating
new_nodes.detail: Warms water or food-prep liquid using energy that would otherwise be vented.

new_nodes.label: Recovery limited by temperature difference
new_nodes.detail: Usable heat depends on the temperature gap, so recovered energy is partial.

new_edges.to: magnetron cooling fan and exhaust vent

ideas.rationale: Capturing heat that a fan currently exhausts as waste turns a loss into a useful input, so the appliance delivers more useful heat per kilowatt-hour drawn from the wall.

ideas.title: Just Heat: Sense It Done

new_nodes.label: Gas and infrared food-state sensing
new_nodes.detail: Volatile-compound and infrared sensors detect steam and surface temperature rise and stop heating when food is ready.

new_nodes.label: Single-button Just Heat sensor pod

new_nodes.label: Ends heating at food-ready state
new_nodes.detail: Replaces the user's guesswork about time and power level.

ideas.rationale: The user presses one button and the oven decides time and power by sensing the food, so there is nothing to learn.

new_nodes.detail: Touch on any part of the glass is detected through the glass and triggers release.

new_nodes.label: Magnetic self-opening door latch
new_nodes.detail: A magnet and spring cam hold the door shut; interlock release springs it open, so no button or lever is needed.

new_nodes.detail: Low-cost humidity and volatile-organic sensors that detect when food reaches doneness.

new_nodes.detail: Ends the cycle automatically once the food is ready, so no time has to be guessed.

ideas.rationale: Stopping at doneness instead of at a guessed time removes both the time spent estimating and the reheats needed when food is undercooked or overcooked.

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state RF amplifier (2.45 GHz)
new_nodes.detail: Transistor power amplifier replaces the magnetron, HV transformer and voltage doubler; output is set by gate bias on a low-voltage DC rail.

new_nodes.label: Continuously variable RF power (0-100%)
new_nodes.detail: Smooth power control lets defrost run at a gentle, steady level instead of on/off duty cycling.

ideas.rationale: Continuous low-power output lets frozen food thaw gently without the hot-spot runaway that on/off cycling causes, which directly speeds up quality defrosting.

ideas.title: Steam Pot Microwave

new_nodes.label: Water-reservoir steam module
new_nodes.detail: Sealed cavity where microwave energy boils a small water reservoir, producing steam that cooks food from all sides.

new_nodes.label: 700 W RF dry-heat generator (original)
new_nodes.detail: Original base-product heating source, replaced for steam-cooked dishes; it can still run when needed.

new_nodes.label: Moist-heat cooking without added fat
new_nodes.detail: Cooks by steam, so no oil or butter is needed and water-soluble vitamins leach less than in boiling.

new_nodes.label: Microwave-to-steam heat transfer
new_nodes.detail: Microwave energy is absorbed by a water film and converted to steam rather than heating the food directly.

ideas.rationale: Steam cooking removes the need for added fat and keeps water-soluble nutrients in the food, which directly supports M12.

ideas.title: Nutrient-Kinetics Sensor replaces the timer

new_nodes.label: Volatile-compound gas sensor array
new_nodes.detail: Detects the aroma signature of cooking food and estimates its thermal state without a user-set time.

new_nodes.label: Clockwork timer knob (original)
new_nodes.detail: Original base-product timer, replaced by sensor-driven control that ends cooking at the right point.

new_nodes.label: Stop cooking at peak nutrient retention
new_nodes.detail: Ends the cycle when the food is fully heated but before heat-labile vitamins such as C and folate degrade.

new_nodes.label: Nutrient-degradation kinetics model
new_nodes.detail: Models vitamin loss over time and temperature to choose the stop point for each food.

Stop cooking at peak nutrient retention

ideas.rationale: Stopping at the moment of peak nutrient retention, instead of at a guessed time, keeps more vitamins in the food.

new_nodes.label: Tilted perforated drainage rack
new_nodes.detail: A slanted, perforated tray with a fat channel that lets rendered fat run off meat during heating.

new_nodes.label: Glass turntable (original)
new_nodes.detail: Original base-product turntable for even heating; the drain rack replaces its role for meats that release fat.

new_nodes.label: Render and drain fat from food
new_nodes.detail: Melts and separates fat from meat or poultry so it drains away from the food as it cooks.

new_nodes.label: Fat is retained in meat when cooked in a flat dish
new_nodes.detail: Without a drainage path, rendered fat stays in the dish and is reabsorbed by the food.

new_nodes.detail: Projects a live nutrient-retention score and vitamin map onto the food, visible through the door.

new_nodes.label: 20-25 W incandescent lamp (original)

new_nodes.label: Real-time nutrient-retention display

new_nodes.label: Spectral food-composition estimation
new_nodes.detail: Estimates the nutrient content of food from its spectral signature to drive the display.

ideas.rationale: A visible nutrient score during cooking helps users pick settings that preserve nutrients, serving M12 more directly than a plain light.

ideas.title: Solid-State Pulse Cooker replaces the magnetron power knob

new_nodes.label: Solid-state GaN RF amplifier array
new_nodes.detail: Replaces the magnetron with many low-power amplifiers that can switch on and off in microseconds to set heat precisely.

new_nodes.label: 5-step power knob, duty-cycle cam (original)
new_nodes.detail: Original base-product power control, replaced by fine-grained digital control of heat delivery.

new_nodes.label: Low-temperature pulsed cooking
new_nodes.detail: Delivers energy in short, gentle pulses so food avoids the hot spots that destroy heat-labile vitamins.

new_nodes.label: Phase-modulated RF power control
new_nodes.detail: Shapes microwave output in fine steps, so power can be dosed to match each food's needs.

ideas.rationale: Pulsed, low-temperature heating avoids the overheated spots that break down vitamins, supporting nutrient retention for M12.

new_nodes.detail: Replaces the magnetron and the 5-step cam with a dial-controlled amplifier that holds a steady, gentle power level.

new_nodes.label: Gallium-nitride RF power amplification at 2.45 GHz
new_nodes.detail: Transistor amplifiers give continuous power control with no filament or cathode to wear out.

new_nodes.label: Delivers continuous low-power cooking without on/off cycling
new_nodes.detail: Steady low wattage avoids the hot-spot overcooking that destroys heat-sensitive vitamins.

new_nodes.label: Steam-cooks food with no added fat and minimal nutrient leaching

new_nodes.label: Gas and humidity sensor array
new_nodes.detail: Metal-oxide and humidity sensors track moisture loss and aroma compounds to estimate doneness.

new_nodes.label: Electronic-nose doneness sensing
new_nodes.detail: Pattern recognition on sensor data predicts when the food reaches target doneness.

new_nodes.label: Haptic and app-push doneness alert
new_nodes.detail: A vibration in the handle or a phone notification replaces the mechanical bell.

new_nodes.label: Stops cooking at optimal doneness and signals the user
new_nodes.detail: Prevents overcooking, which degrades vitamins, and tells the user the food is ready.

Stops cooking at optimal doneness and signals the user

ideas.title: Low-pressure cavity cooking

new_nodes.label: Vacuum-rated elastomer door gasket with latch
new_nodes.detail: Replaces the machined quarter-wave choke seal with a gasket that holds a partial vacuum of about 0.3 bar in the cavity.

new_nodes.label: Compact diaphragm vacuum pump
new_nodes.detail: Pulls the cavity to partial vacuum so water boils at about 65 °C instead of 100 °C.

new_nodes.label: Reduced-pressure low-temperature cooking
new_nodes.detail: Lowering the pressure drops the boiling point, so food cooks at a gentler temperature.

new_nodes.label: Cooks at lower temperature to preserve heat-sensitive nutrients
new_nodes.detail: Gentler cooking retains vitamin C and B vitamins better than atmospheric boiling.

new_nodes.label: Low-pressure arcing and plasma risk

ideas.title: Dielectric Feedback Auto-Thaw

new_nodes.label: RF measurement science
new_nodes.detail: Study of how electromagnetic energy is reflected and absorbed by materials.

new_nodes.label: Real-time dielectric reflectance sensing
new_nodes.detail: Measures reflected and absorbed RF power to infer the ice-to-water ratio of the load.

new_nodes.label: Self-terminating defrost
new_nodes.detail: Adjusts duty cycle automatically and stops when the target thaw state is reached, with no user timing.

ideas.rationale: Replacing guesswork timing with live sensing lets the oven stop at the exact thaw point, so frozen food defrosts fast without overcooking edges.

ideas.title: Conductive Thaw Stakes

new_nodes.label: Materials chemistry
new_nodes.detail: Design and synthesis of engineered composite materials.

new_nodes.label: Graphite-loaded composite stakes
new_nodes.detail: Lossy microwave-absorbing spikes that heat from the inside of a frozen block outward.

new_nodes.label: Thaw stake array
new_nodes.detail: Retractable grid of stakes that is pressed into frozen food to bring energy to the core.

new_nodes.label: Core-first thawing
new_nodes.detail: Thaws the dense centre of frozen food first, where ice is slowest to melt.

ideas.rationale: Delivering heat into the core of the block instead of relying on the surface speeds up the slowest part of the thaw, which is the frozen centre.

ideas.title: Thermochromic Thaw Window

new_nodes.label: Photochemistry and colour science
new_nodes.detail: Study of materials that change colour under light, heat, or chemical stimulus.

new_nodes.label: Thermochromic ink film
new_nodes.detail: Ink on the door glass that shifts colour when the nearby food crosses set temperature bands.

new_nodes.label: Thermochromic thaw window
new_nodes.detail: Door glass coated with a colour-shifting film, with no bulb and no electrical load.

new_nodes.label: Passive thaw-progress display
new_nodes.detail: Shows from outside the oven how far the food has thawed, without any light source.

ideas.rationale: A colour-shifting window tells the user when the food is ready to cook or refreeze, which removes the need to open the door and guess, and it draws zero power.

ideas.title: Solid-State Distributed Feed

new_nodes.label: Power electronics
new_nodes.detail: Engineering of semiconductor devices that switch and amplify electrical power.

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state RF amplifiers
new_nodes.detail: Gallium nitride transistors that generate microwave energy at many points with independent phase control.

new_nodes.label: Distributed amplifier array
new_nodes.detail: Dozens of small RF emitters placed around the cavity walls in place of one central magnetron.

new_nodes.label: Uniform volumetric defrost
new_nodes.detail: Delivers energy from many directions at once so the whole load thaws evenly with no hot spots.

ideas.rationale: Feeding energy in from many points at once shortens thaw time and removes the cold spots that force users to pause and flip food.

ideas.title: Steam-Latent Thaw Chamber

new_nodes.label: Thermodynamics
new_nodes.detail: Study of heat, energy transfer, and phase change.

new_nodes.label: Steam condensation heat transfer
new_nodes.detail: Steam releases large amounts of latent heat when it condenses on cold food surfaces.

new_nodes.label: Saturated steam reservoir
new_nodes.detail: Small water tank that fills the cavity with low-pressure steam before and during defrost.

new_nodes.label: Latent-heat surface thawing
new_nodes.detail: Transfers heat to the food surface through condensation, which warms and softens the ice quickly.

ideas.rationale: Steam condensing on frozen food adds far more heat per second than dry air does, and the food stays moist, so defrosting is faster and the texture holds up.

new_nodes.label: Peel-away splatter film roll
new_nodes.detail: Disposable microwave-transparent PTFE film dispensed inside the cavity; when soiled, the user tears off the top layer like kitchen paper.

new_nodes.label: Shields cavity and waveguide from splatter
new_nodes.detail: Keeps food residue off the waveguide and cavity walls so nothing bakes on.

new_nodes.label: Low-loss PTFE dielectric film
new_nodes.detail: Film that passes microwaves with negligible loss and tolerates cooking temperatures.

new_nodes.detail: Fully sealed membrane control with no knob, shaft, or crevices, safe to wipe or rinse under a tap.
